+ "github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/project"
+ "github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/workflow/model"
+)
+
+func dependency(modules []project.Module,from,to string,seen map[string]bool) bool {if from==to{return false};if seen[from]{return false};seen[from]=true;for _,m:=range modules {if m.Name!=from{continue};for _,d:=range m.DependsOn {if d==to||dependency(modules,d,to,seen){return true}}};return false}
+func waitingFor(root string,q []project.Change,i int) (string,string) {
+ candidate:=q[i];snap,e:=project.Project(root,candidate.Slug);if e!=nil{return "",""}
+ for _,prior:=range q[:i] {if frontString(prior.Document,"phase")!="blocked" {continue};if candidate.Module==prior.Module{return prior.Slug,"same_module"};if dependency(snap.Modules,candidate.Module,prior.Module,map[string]bool{}) {return prior.Slug,"depends_on_blocked"};if section(candidate.Document,"Interface")!=""&&dependency(snap.Modules,prior.Module,candidate.Module,map[string]bool{}) {return prior.Slug,"interface_dependency"}}
+ return "",""
+}
+func Eligible(root string) ([]project.Change,error) {info,e:=rootInfo(root);if e!=nil{return nil,e};q,e:=queue(info.Root);if e!=nil{return nil,e};out:=[]project.Change{};for i,c:=range q {if frontString(c.Document,"phase")=="blocked" {continue};if on,_:=waitingFor(info.Root,q,i);on!="" {continue};out=append(out,c)};return out,nil}
+func newRun() string {b:=make([]byte,16);_,_ = rand.Read(b);return hex.EncodeToString(b)}
+var localID=regexp.MustCompile(`new:[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_-]*`)
+func allocateIDs(root string,c *project.Change) error {
+ snap,e:=project.Load(root);if e!=nil{return e};prefix:="";used:=map[int]bool{};for _,m:=range snap.Modules {if m.Name!=c.Module{continue};prefix=m.IDPrefix;s:=section(m.Document,"Specs");items,_:=contracts.ParseItems(s);for _,it:=range items {if strings.HasPrefix(it.ID,prefix+"-"){n,_:=strconv.Atoi(strings.TrimPrefix(it.ID,prefix+"-"));used[n]=true}}};if prefix=="" {return fmt.Errorf("module %s not found",c.Module)}
+ for _,q:=range mustQueue(root) {if q.Path==c.Path{continue};for _,it:=range q.Added {if strings.HasPrefix(it.ID,prefix+"-"){n,_:=strconv.Atoi(strings.TrimPrefix(it.ID,prefix+"-"));used[n]=true}}}
+ body:=c.Document.Body;replacements:=map[string]string{};for _,it:=range c.Added {if !localID.MatchString(it.ID){continue};if _,ok:=replacements[it.ID];ok{continue};n:=1;for used[n] {n++};used[n]=true;replacements[it.ID]=fmt.Sprintf("%s-%03d",prefix,n)}
+ for old,newID:=range replacements {body=strings.ReplaceAll(body,old,newID)};c.Document.Body=body;return nil
+}
+func mustQueue(root string) []project.Change {q,_:=queue(root);return q}
+func startPreconditions(root,selector string) (gitstore.Repository,project.Change,error) {
+ info,e:=rootInfo(root);if e!=nil{return info,project.Change{},e};q,e:=queue(info.Root);if e!=nil{return info,project.Change{},e};if selector!="" {if _,e=selectChange(q,selector);e!=nil{return info,project.Change{},e}}
+ d,e:=dirty(info.Root);if e!=nil{return info,project.Change{},e};if d{return info,project.Change{},coded("P01","start requires clean worktree")}
+ eligible,e:=Eligible(info.Root);if e!=nil{return info,project.Change{},e};if len(eligible)==0{return info,project.Change{},coded("P01","no eligible change")};selected:=eligible[0];if selector!="" {wanted,_:=selectChange(q,selector);if wanted.Path!=selected.Path{return info,project.Change{},coded("P01","change is not eligible queue head")}}
+ if _,_,exists,e:=readClaim(info.Root,selected.Slug);e!=nil{return info,selected,e}else if exists{return info,selected,coded("P02","claim already held: update-ref %s",claimRef(selected.Slug))}
+ return info,selected,nil
+}
+func Start(root,selector string) (model.State,error) {
+ info,c,e:=startPreconditions(root,selector);if e!=nil{return model.State{},e};c,e=parseChange(info.Root,c);if e!=nil{return model.State{},e};if e=checkStale(info.Root,c);e!=nil{return model.State{},e}
+ snap,e:=project.Load(info.Root);if e!=nil{return model.State{},e};limit:=cfgInt(snap,"authoring","max_unapproved",5);unapproved,base,baseErr:=unapprovedCount(info.Root,snap);if baseErr==nil&&unapproved>=limit {d:=project.Diagnostic{Code:"P07",Message:fmt.Sprintf("unapproved archive count %d reaches limit %d",unapproved,limit)};return model.State{Diagnostics:[]project.Diagnostic{d}},coded("P07","%s",d.Message)}
+ original:=c.Document;wasUnstarted:=frontString(c.Document,"phase")=="";if wasUnstarted {if e=allocateIDs(info.Root,&c);e!=nil{return model.State{},e};phase:="evals";if len(c.Added)==0&&len(c.Modified)==0&&len(c.Removed)==0&&frontString(c.Document,"fixes")==""&&frontString(c.Document,"eval_fix")=="" {phase="impl"};if frontBool(c.Document,"regenerate") {phase="impl"};c.Document.Frontmatter["phase"]=phase;c.Document.Frontmatter["run"]=newRun()}
+ if e=renderChange(info.Root,c);e!=nil{return model.State{},e};projected,e:=project.Project(info.Root,c.Slug);if e!=nil { _=renderOriginal(info.Root,c.Path,original);if strings.Contains(e.Error(),"stale base"){return model.State{},coded("P05","%v",e)};return model.State{},e};c,e=parseChange(info.Root,c);if e!=nil{return model.State{},e}
+ cl:=claim{Owner:info.Root,Slug:c.Slug,Path:c.Path,Run:frontString(c.Document,"run"),Phase:frontString(c.Document,"phase"),Base:info.Head,Snapshot:projected,Approved:c.Document};if cl.Run=="" {cl.Run=newRun();c.Document.Frontmatter["run"]=cl.Run;cl.Approved=c.Document;_=renderChange(info.Root,c)}
+ oid,e:=saveClaim(info.Root,cl,"");if e!=nil {_=renderOriginal(info.Root,c.Path,original);return model.State{},coded("P02","claim already held: update-ref %v",e)}
+ s:=state(info.Root,c,cl,oid);if baseErr==nil&&base!="" {if _,e:=gitstore.ReadAt(info.Root,base,c.Path);e!=nil {if _,e2:=gitstore.ReadAt(info.Root,"main",c.Path);e2!=nil {s.Diagnostics=append(s.Diagnostics,project.Diagnostic{Code:"P04",Message:"change absent from local and shared base",Warning:true})}}}
+ if wasUnstarted&&frontBool(c.Document,"regenerate") {if e=deleteDisposable(info.Root,projected,c.Module);e!=nil{return s,e};if !newerPassingDrill(info.Root,c.Module) {s.Diagnostics=append(s.Diagnostics,project.Diagnostic{Code:"P10",Message:"no passing drill after latest implementation",Warning:true})}}
+ return s,nil
+}
+func renderOriginal(root,path string,d contracts.Document) error {s,e:=contracts.RenderDocument(d);if e!=nil{return e};return writeText(root,path,s)}
+func unapprovedCount(root string,s project.Snapshot) (int,string,error) {baseName:=frontConfig(s,"base","main");remote:=frontConfig(s,"remote","origin");base,e:=gitstore.BaseRef(root,remote,baseName);if e!=nil{return 0,"",e};paths,e:=filepath.Glob(filepath.Join(root,"changes/archive/*.md"));if e!=nil{return 0,base,e};n:=0;for _,p:=range paths {rel,_:=filepath.Rel(root,p);if _,e:=gitstore.ReadAt(root,base,filepath.ToSlash(rel));e!=nil{n++}};return n,base,nil}
+func frontConfig(s project.Snapshot,key,def string) string {if v:=s.Config[key];v!=nil{return fmt.Sprint(v)};return def}
+func deleteDisposable(root string,s project.Snapshot,name string) error {for _,m:=range s.Modules {if m.Name!=name{continue};return filepath.WalkDir(filepath.Join(root,m.Dir),func(path string,d os.DirEntry,e error) error {if e!=nil{return e};if d.IsDir(){return nil};rel,_:=filepath.Rel(filepath.Join(root,m.Dir),path);if contracts.ResolveZone(filepath.ToSlash(rel),m.Zones)=="disposable" {return os.Remove(path)};return nil})};return nil}
+func newerPassingDrill(root,module string) bool {refs,_:=gitRefList(root,"refs/fireweed/drills/"+module);return len(refs)>0}

new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..9fb468583e3c9c7fadacedb2ce9208f03930bd09

+++ b/packages/workflow/internal/lifecycle/verify.go
@@ -0,0 +1,52 @@
+package lifecycle
+
+import (
+ "context"
+ "encoding/json"
+ "fmt"
+ "os"
+ "path/filepath"
+ "sort"
+ "strings"
+ "time"
+
+ "github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/checks"
+ "github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/contracts"
+ "github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/project"
+ "github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/workflow/model"
+)
+
+func module(s project.Snapshot,name string) (project.Module,bool) {for _,m:=range s.Modules {if m.Name==name{return m,true}};return project.Module{},false}
+func moduleSpecs(m project.Module) []contracts.Item {items,_:=contracts.ParseItems(section(m.Document,"Specs"));return items}

package evals_test

import (
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"reflect"
	"strings"

	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/project"

func status(t *testing.T, root string) workflow.StatusReport {
	t.Helper()
	r, err := workflow.Status(root)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("Status: %v", err)
	}
	return r
}

func statusEntry(t *testing.T, r workflow.StatusReport, numberedSlug string) workflow.StatusEntry {
	t.Helper()
	for _, entry := range r.Queue {
		if strings.TrimSuffix(filepath.Base(entry.Path), ".md") == numberedSlug {
			return entry
		}
	}
	t.Fatalf("Status queue has no %s: %#v", numberedSlug, r.Queue)
	return workflow.StatusEntry{}
}

func waiting(t *testing.T, r workflow.StatusReport, slug, on, rule string) {
	t.Helper()
	e := statusEntry(t, r, slug)
	if e.WaitingOn != on || e.WaitingRule != rule {
		t.Errorf("%s waiting = %q/%q, want %q/%q", slug, e.WaitingOn, e.WaitingRule, on, rule)
	}
}

func Test_FLOW_106_FLOW_107_FLOW_108_StatusModuleMetadata(t *testing.T) {
	root := fixture(t, "", "", "", "", "")
	alpha := readFile(t, root, "packages/alpha/SPEC.md")
	alpha = strings.Replace(alpha, "depends_on: []\n", "depends_on: []\nboundaries_opt_out: approved fixture exception\n", 1)
	alpha = strings.Replace(alpha, "### ALP-002\n", "### ALP-002 [quarantine: intermittent fixture]\n", 1)
	write(t, root, "packages/alpha/SPEC.md", alpha)
	write(t, root, "packages/delta/SPEC.md", "---\nname: delta\nid_prefix: DEL\ndepends_on: []\n---\n# Delta\n\n## Specs\n\n### DEL-001 [quarantine: unavailable service]\nDelta MUST work.\n")
	commit(t, root, "module metadata")
	snapshot, err := project.Load(root)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	r := status(t, root)
	if !reflect.DeepEqual(r.Modules, snapshot.Modules) {
		t.Errorf("modules = %#v, want discovered %#v", r.Modules, snapshot.Modules)
	}
	byName := map[string]project.Module{}
	for _, m := range r.Modules {
		byName[m.Name] = m
	}
	if len(byName) != 4 || byName["alpha"].IDPrefix != "ALP" || byName["alpha"].Dir != "packages/alpha" || !reflect.DeepEqual(byName["gamma"].DependsOn, []string{"beta"}) || !reflect.DeepEqual(byName["beta"].Zones.Interface, []string{"api.go"}) || !reflect.DeepEqual(byName["alpha"].Zones.Disposable, []string{"internal/**"}) {
		t.Errorf("discovered identity/dependencies/zones = %#v", byName)
	}
	wantQ := []workflow.Quarantine{{Module: "alpha", ID: "ALP-002", Reason: "intermittent fixture"}, {Module: "delta", ID: "DEL-001", Reason: "unavailable service"}}
	if !reflect.DeepEqual(r.Quarantines, wantQ) {
		t.Errorf("quarantines = %#v, want %#v", r.Quarantines, wantQ)
	}
	if !reflect.DeepEqual(r.BoundaryOptOuts, []workflow.BoundaryOptOut{{Module: "alpha", Reason: "approved fixture exception"}}) {
		t.Errorf("opt-outs = %#v", r.BoundaryOptOuts)
	}
}

	archivedImpl(t, root, "0004-alpha-new", "alpha", "2026-06-11T12:00:00Z")
	archivedImpl(t, root, "0005-alpha-newer", "alpha", "2026-06-12T12:00:00Z")
	archivedImpl(t, root, "0006-alpha-newest", "alpha", "2026-06-13T12:00:00Z")
	write(t, root, ".fireweed/drills/alpha.md", fmt.Sprintf("---\ndate: 2026-06-10T12:00:00Z\nbase_commit: %s\nagent: fixture\nmodel: fixture\nresult: fail\n---\n", head(t, root)))
	write(t, root, ".fireweed/drills/beta.md", fmt.Sprintf("---\ndate: 2026-06-14T12:00:00Z\nbase_commit: %s\nagent: fixture\nmodel: fixture\nresult: fail\n---\n", head(t, root)))

	git(t, root, "symbolic-ref", "refs/remotes/origin/HEAD", "refs/remotes/origin/stable")
	if got := status(t, root).Unapproved; got != 1 {
		t.Errorf("default base via origin/HEAD unapproved = %d, want 1", got)
	}
}

+package lifecycle
+

+
+ "github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/contracts"
+ "github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/gitstore"
+ "github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/project"
+ "github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/workflow/model"
+)
+
+type claim struct {
+ Owner string
+ Slug string
+ Path string
+ Run string
+ Phase string
+ Base string
+ Snapshot project.Snapshot
+ Approved contracts.Document
+}
+
+func coded(code, format string, args ...any) error { return fmt.Errorf("%s: %s", code, fmt.Sprintf(format,args...)) }
+func rootInfo(root string) (gitstore.Repository,error) { return gitstore.Inspect(root) }
+func runGit(root string, args ...string) (string,error) {
+ c:=exec.Command("git",args...); c.Dir=root
+ b,e:=c.CombinedOutput(); if e!=nil { return "",fmt.Errorf("git %s: %w: %s",strings.Join(args," "),e,strings.TrimSpace(string(b))) }; return strings.TrimSpace(string(b)),nil
+}
+func gitBytes(root string,args ...string) ([]byte,error) { c:=exec.Command("git",args...);c.Dir=root; b,e:=c.Output();return b,e }
+func dirty(root string) (bool,error) { s,e:=runGit(root,"status","--porcelain","--untracked-files=all");return s!="",e }
+func claimRef(slug string) string { return "refs/fireweed/claims/"+slug }
+func readClaim(root,slug string) (claim,string,bool,error) {
+ oid,ok,e:=gitstore.Ref(root,claimRef(slug));if e!=nil||!ok{return claim{},"",ok,e}
+ b,e:=gitstore.ReadBlob(root,oid);if e!=nil{return claim{},"",false,e};var c claim;e=json.Unmarshal(b,&c);return c,oid,true,e
+}

+ if len(found)==1{return found[0],nil}

+package lifecycle
+
+import (
+ "context"
+ "crypto/sha256"
+ "encoding/hex"
+ "fmt"
+ "os"
+ "path/filepath"

+
+var findingRE=regexp.MustCompile(`(?m)^\s*-\s*(\[untestable\]\s*)?([A-Z][A-Z0-9]*-[0-9]+):\s*"([^"]+)"[^\n]*`)

+func auditSubmission(c project.Change,cl claim) ([]string,error) {
+ body:=section(c.Document,"Audit");if body=="" {return nil,coded("P09","missing audit submission")};m,_:=module(cl.Snapshot,c.Module);specs:=map[string]string{};for _,it:=range moduleSpecs(m) {specs[it.ID]=it.Body};prior:=map[string]bool{};for _,x:=range findingRE.FindAllStringSubmatch(section(cl.Approved,"Audit"),-1){prior[x[2]]=true}
+ kept:=[]string{};for _,x:=range findingRE.FindAllStringSubmatch(body,-1){if !strings.Contains(specs[x[2]],x[3]){continue};if frontInt(c.Document,"audit_rounds")>0&&len(prior)>0&&!prior[x[2]]{continue};kept=append(kept,strings.TrimSpace(x[0]))}
+ if len(kept)>0{return kept,nil}
+ if !strings.Contains(body,"No findings") {return nil,coded("P09","audit submission needs No findings or valid findings")};match:=checkedRE.FindStringSubmatch(body);if len(match)<2 {return nil,coded("P09","No findings requires checked IDs")};checked:=map[string]bool{};for _,part:=range strings.FieldsFunc(match[1],func(r rune)bool{return r==','||r==' '||r=='\t'}){checked[part]=true};for _,id:=range targetIDs(c) {if !checked[id] {return nil,coded("P09","No findings missing checked ID %s",id)}};return nil,nil
+}
+func normalizeAudit(c *project.Change,findings []string) {if len(findings)>0 {c.Document.Body=contracts.ReplaceSection(c.Document.Body,"Audit",strings.Join(findings,"\n")+"\n")} else {body:=section(c.Document,"Audit");lines:=[]string{};for _,line:=range strings.Split(body,"\n") {if strings.HasPrefix(strings.TrimSpace(line),"-"){continue};lines=append(lines,line)};c.Document.Body=contracts.ReplaceSection(c.Document.Body,"Audit",strings.Join(lines,"\n")+"\n")}}
+func provenance(c *project.Change,req model.Request,phase string,reports map[string]checks.Report) {
+ agent:=req.Agent;if agent==""{agent="manual"};book,_:=assets.Playbook(phase);if phase=="impl"&&frontBool(c.Document,"regenerate"){book,_=assets.Playbook("regenerate")};h:=sha256.Sum256([]byte(book));total,passing,failing:=0,0,0;for _,r:=range reports {for _,tc:=range r.Cases {total++;if tc.Result=="pass"{passing++} else if tc.Result=="fail"||tc.Result=="error"{failing++}}};line:=fmt.Sprintf("- %s %s agent=%s fireweed=%s playbook=%s tests=%d failing=%d passing=%d",phase,nowUTC().Format("2006-01-02T15:04:05Z07:00"),agent,assets.Version(),hex.EncodeToString(h[:]),total,failing,passing);old:=section(c.Document,"Provenance");if old!=""{old+="\n"};c.Document.Body=contracts.ReplaceSection(c.Document.Body,"Provenance",old+line+"\n")

+func applySpec(root string,c project.Change) error {
+ path:=filepath.Join(root,"packages",c.Module,"SPEC.md");for _,m:=range mustModules(root) {if m.Name==c.Module {path=filepath.Join(root,m.Dir,"SPEC.md")}}
+ b,e:=os.ReadFile(path);if e!=nil{return e};doc,e:=contracts.ParseDocument(string(b));if e!=nil{return e};items,e:=contracts.ParseItems(section(doc,"Specs"));if e!=nil{return e};byID:=map[string]contracts.Item{};order:=[]string{};for _,it:=range items {byID[it.ID]=it;order=append(order,it.ID)};for _,it:=range c.Removed{delete(byID,it.ID)};for _,it:=range c.Modified {byID[it.ID]=it};for _,it:=range c.Added {if _,ok:=byID[it.ID];!ok{order=append(order,it.ID)};byID[it.ID]=it};rendered:=[]string{};for _,id:=range order {if it,ok:=byID[id];ok{rendered=append(rendered,strings.TrimSpace(contracts.RenderItem(it)))}};doc.Body=contracts.ReplaceSection(doc.Body,"Specs",strings.Join(rendered,"\n\n")+"\n")
+ if set:=mapAt(c.Document.Frontmatter,"set");set!=nil {for k,v:=range set {doc.Frontmatter[k]=v}}
+ decisions:=section(doc,"Decisions");for _,line:=range strings.Split(section(c.Document,"Removed decisions"),"\n") {line=strings.TrimSpace(line);if line!="" {decisions=strings.ReplaceAll(decisions,line,"")}};decisions=strings.TrimSpace(decisions);for _,line:=range strings.Split(section(c.Document,"Decisions"),"\n") {line=strings.TrimSpace(line);if line!=""{if decisions!=""{decisions+="\n"};decisions+="- "+c.Slug+": "+strings.TrimPrefix(line,"- ")}};doc.Body=contracts.ReplaceSection(doc.Body,"Decisions",decisions+"\n")

+ c,cl,oid,e:=owned(req.Root,req.Change);if e!=nil{return model.Result{},e};req.Quick=false;r,e:=evaluate(ctx,req,c,cl,oid);if e!=nil{return r,e};phase:=cl.Phase;var findings []string;if phase=="audit" {findings,e=auditSubmission(c,cl);if e!=nil{return r,e};normalizeAudit(&c,findings)}
+ if phase=="evals" {if cfgBool(cl.Snapshot,"audit","enabled",true) {c.Document.Frontmatter["phase"]="audit"} else {c.Document.Frontmatter["phase"]="impl"}}
+ if phase=="audit" {if len(findings)==0 {c.Document.Frontmatter["phase"]="impl"} else {limit:=cfgInt(cl.Snapshot,"audit","max_rounds",2);if frontInt(c.Document,"audit_rounds")>=limit||strings.Contains(section(c.Document,"Audit"),"[untestable]") {c.Document.Frontmatter["phase"]="blocked";c.Document.Frontmatter["blocked"]="audit findings";c.Document.Body=contracts.ReplaceSection(c.Document.Body,"Questions",strings.Join(findings,"\n")+"\n")} else {c.Document.Frontmatter["phase"]="evals";c.Document.Frontmatter["audit_rounds"]=frontInt(c.Document,"audit_rounds")+1}}}
+ if phase=="impl" {if e=applySpec(cl.Owner,c);e!=nil{return r,e};if e=diagnosticsError(project.Check(cl.Owner));e!=nil{return r,e};c.Document.Frontmatter["phase"]="applied"}
+ provenance(&c,req,phase,r.Reports);if e=renderChange(cl.Owner,c);e!=nil{return r,e};if phase=="impl" {archive:=filepath.Join(cl.Owner,"changes/archive",filepath.Base(c.Path));if e=os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(archive),0755);e!=nil{return r,e};if e=os.Rename(filepath.Join(cl.Owner,c.Path),archive);e!=nil{return r,e};c.Path=filepath.ToSlash(filepath.Join("changes/archive",filepath.Base(c.Path)))}

+}
+func specIDs(c project.Change) []string {ids:=targetIDs(c);sort.Strings(ids);return ids}

+func Context(root,selector string,full bool) (string,error) {c,cl,_,e:=owned(root,selector);if e!=nil{return "",e};m,ok:=module(cl.Snapshot,c.Module);if !ok{return "",fmt.Errorf("module %s missing",c.Module)};name:=cl.Phase;if name=="impl"&&frontBool(c.Document,"regenerate"){name="regenerate"};book,e:=assets.Playbook(name);if e!=nil{return "",e};var b strings.Builder;fmt.Fprintf(&b,"# Change\n%s\n\n# Projected spec\n%s\n\n# SYSTEM\n",c.Document.Body,m.Document.Body);system,_:=os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(cl.Owner,"SYSTEM.md"));b.Write(system);fmt.Fprintf(&b,"\n# Playbook\n%s\n\n# Interface\n",book);_ = filepath.WalkDir(filepath.Join(cl.Owner,m.Dir),func(path string,d os.DirEntry,e error) error {if e!=nil||d.IsDir(){return nil};rel,_:=filepath.Rel(filepath.Join(cl.Owner,m.Dir),path);zone:=contracts.ResolveZone(filepath.ToSlash(rel),m.Zones);if zone!="interface" {return nil};data,_:=os.ReadFile(path);fmt.Fprintf(&b,"\n%s\n%s\n",filepath.ToSlash(filepath.Join(m.Dir,rel)),data);return nil});fmt.Fprintf(&b,"\n# Other files\n");_ = filepath.WalkDir(filepath.Join(cl.Owner,m.Dir),func(path string,d os.DirEntry,e error) error {if e!=nil||d.IsDir(){return nil};rel,_:=filepath.Rel(filepath.Join(cl.Owner,m.Dir),path);zone:=contracts.ResolveZone(filepath.ToSlash(rel),m.Zones);if zone=="interface"||rel=="SPEC.md"{return nil};info,_:=d.Info();if info==nil{return nil};fmt.Fprintf(&b,"%s %d bytes\n",filepath.ToSlash(filepath.Join(m.Dir,rel)),info.Size());if full {data,_:=os.ReadFile(path);b.Write(data);b.WriteString("\n")};return nil});return b.String(),nil}
+var quarantineRE=regexp.MustCompile(`(?i)quarantine:\s*([^\]]+)`)

model.StatusReport{},e};q,e:=queue(info.Root);if e!=nil{return model.StatusReport{},e};r:=model.StatusReport{Modules:snap.Modules,Queue:[]model.StatusEntry{},Quarantines:[]model.Quarantine{},BoundaryOptOuts:[]model.BoundaryOptOut{},DriftSinceDrill:map[string]int{},PhaseCommits:map[string]int{},Costs:[]model.ModuleCost{}};for i,c:=range q {phase:=frontString(c.Document,"phase");if phase==""{phase="queued"};blocked:=frontString(c.Document,"blocked");entry:=model.StatusEntry{Slug:c.Slug,Path:c.Path,Module:c.Module,Phase:phase,Blocked:blocked,AuditRounds:frontInt(c.Document,"audit_rounds")};if blocked=="" {entry.WaitingOn,entry.WaitingRule=waitingFor(info.Root,q,i)};r.Queue=append(r.Queue,entry)};archives:=archiveChanges(info.Root);for _,m:=range snap.Modules {for _,it:=range moduleSpecs(m) {if x:=quarantineRE.FindStringSubmatch(it.Tag);len(x)>1 {r.Quarantines=append(r.Quarantines,model.Quarantine{Module:m.Name,ID:it.ID,Reason:strings.TrimSpace(x[1])})}};if reason:=frontString(m.Document,"boundaries_opt_out");reason!="" {r.BoundaryOptOuts=append(r.BoundaryOptOuts,model.BoundaryOptOut{Module:m.Name,Reason:reason})};reportDate:=time.Time{};p:=filepath.Join(info.Root,".fireweed/drills",m.Name+".md");if b,e:=os.ReadFile(p);e==nil {if d,e:=contracts.ParseDocument(string(b));e==nil {reportDate,_=time.Parse(time.RFC3339Nano,frontString(d,"date"))}};n:=0;for _,c:=range archives {if changes",name,n),Warning:true})}};baseCount,_,_:=unapprovedCount(info.Root,snap);r.Unapproved=baseCount;for _,c:=range archives {commits,_:=Commits(info.Root,c.Path);r.PhaseCommits[strings.TrimSuffix(filepath.Base(c.Path),".md")]=len(commits)};snapshots,_:=Costs(info.Root);latest:=map[string]model.CostSnapshot{};latestCost:=map[string]model.ModuleCost{};for _,s:=range snapshots {for _,cost:=range s.Modules {if old,ok:=latest[cost.Module];!ok||!s.RecordedAt.Before(old.RecordedAt){latest[cost.Module]=s;latestCost[cost.Module]=cost}}};names:=[]string{};for +package lifecycle
+
+import (
+ "crypto/rand"
+ "encoding/hex"
+ "fmt"
+ "os"
+ "path/filepath"
+ "regexp"
+ "strconv"
+ "strings"
+
+ "github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/contracts"

+
+func dependency(modules []project.Module,from,to string,seen map[string]bool) bool {if from==to{return false};if seen[from]{return false};seen[from]=true;for _,m:=range modules {if m.Name!=from{continue};for _,d:=range m.DependsOn {if d==to||dependency(modules,d,to,seen){return true}}};return false}

+package lifecycle
+
+import (
+ "context"

+var findingRE=regexp.MustCompile(`(?m)^\s*-\s*(\[untestable\]\s*)?([A-Z][A-Z0-9]*-[0-9]+):\s*"([^"]+)"[^\n]*`)

+func auditSubmission(c project.Change,cl claim) ([]string,error) {
+ body:=section(c.Document,"Audit");if body=="" {return nil,coded("P09","missing audit submission")};m,_:=module(cl.Snapshot,c.Module);specs:=map[string]string{};for _,it:=range moduleSpecs(m) {specs[it.ID]=it.Body};prior:=map[string]bool{};for _,x:=range findingRE.FindAllStringSubmatch(section(cl.Approved,"Audit"),-1){prior[x[2]]=true}
+ kept:=[]string{};for _,x:=range findingRE.FindAllStringSubmatch(body,-1){if !strings.Contains(specs[x[2]],x[3]){continue};if frontInt(c.Document,"audit_rounds")>0&&len(prior)>0&&!prior[x[2]]{continue};kept=append(kept,strings.TrimSpace(x[0]))}
+ if len(kept)>0{return kept,nil}
+ if !strings.Contains(body,"No findings") {return nil,coded("P09","audit submission needs No findings or valid findings")};match:=checkedRE.FindStringSubmatch(body);if len(match)<2 {return nil,coded("P09","No findings requires checked IDs")};checked:=map[string]bool{};for _,part:=range strings.FieldsFunc(match[1],func(r rune)bool{return r==','||r==' '||r=='\t'}){checked[part]=true};for _,id:=range targetIDs(c) {if !checked[id] {return nil,coded("P09","No findings missing checked ID %s",id)}};return nil,nil
+}
+func normalizeAudit(c *project.Change,findings []string) {if len(findings)>0 {c.Document.Body=contracts.ReplaceSection(c.Document.Body,"Audit",strings.Join(findings,"\n")+"\n")} else {body:=section(c.Document,"Audit");lines:=[]string{};for _,line:=range strings.Split(body,"\n") {if strings.HasPrefix(strings.TrimSpace(line),"-"){continue};lines=append(lines,line)};c.Document.Body=contracts.ReplaceSection(c.Document.Body,"Audit",strings.Join(lines,"\n")+"\n")}}
+func provenance(c *project.Change,req model.Request,phase string,reports map[string]checks.Report) {
+ agent:=req.Agent;if agent==""{agent="manual"};book,_:=assets.Playbook(phase);if phase=="impl"&&frontBool(c.Document,"regenerate"){book,_=assets.Playbook("regenerate")};h:=sha256.Sum256([]byte(book));total,passing,failing:=0,0,0;for _,r:=range reports {for _,tc:=range r.Cases {total++;if tc.Result=="pass"{passing++} else if tc.Result=="fail"||tc.Result=="error"{failing++}}};line:=fmt.Sprintf("- %s %s agent=%s fireweed=%s playbook=%s tests=%d failing=%d passing=%d",phase,nowUTC().Format("2006-01-02T15:04:05Z07:00"),agent,assets.Version(),hex.EncodeToString(h[:]),total,failing,passing);old:=section(c.Document,"Provenance");if old!=""{old+="\n"};c.Document.Body=contracts.ReplaceSection(c.Document.Body,"Provenance",old+line+"\n")
+}
+func applySpec(root string,c project.Change) error {
+ path:=filepath.Join(root,"packages",c.Module,"SPEC.md");for _,m:=range mustModules(root) {if m.Name==c.Module {path=filepath.Join(root,m.Dir,"SPEC.md")}}
+ b,e:=os.ReadFile(path);if e!=nil{return e};doc,e:=contracts.ParseDocument(string(b));if e!=nil{return e};items,e:=contracts.ParseItems(section(doc,"Specs"));if e!=nil{return e};byID:=map[string]contracts.Item{};order:=[]string{};for _,it:=range items {byID[it.ID]=it;order=append(order,it.ID)};for _,it:=range c.Removed{delete(byID,it.ID)};for _,it:=range c.Modified {byID[it.ID]=it};for _,it:=range c.Added {if _,ok:=byID[it.ID];!ok{order=append(order,it.ID)};byID[it.ID]=it};rendered:=[]string{};for _,id:=range order {if it,ok:=byID[id];ok{rendered=append(rendered,strings.TrimSpace(contracts.RenderItem(it)))}};doc.Body=contracts.ReplaceSection(doc.Body,"Specs",strings.Join(rendered,"\n\n")+"\n")
+ if set:=mapAt(c.Document.Frontmatter,"set");set!=nil {for k,v:=range set {doc.Frontmatter[k]=v}}
+ decisions:=section(doc,"Decisions");for _,line:=range strings.Split(section(c.Document,"Removed decisions"),"\n") {line=strings.TrimSpace(line);if line!="" {decisions=strings.ReplaceAll(decisions,line,"")}};decisions=strings.TrimSpace(decisions);for _,line:=range strings.Split(section(c.Document,"Decisions"),"\n") {line=strings.TrimSpace(line);if line!=""{if decisions!=""{decisions+="\n"};decisions+="- "+c.Slug+": "+strings.TrimPrefix(line,"- ")}};doc.Body=contracts.ReplaceSection(doc.Body,"Decisions",decisions+"\n")
+ out,e:=contracts.RenderDocument(doc);if e!=nil{return e};return os.WriteFile(path,[]byte(out),0644)
+}
+func mustModules(root string) []project.Module {s,_:=project.Load(root);return s.Modules}
+func commitAll(root,subject string) (string,error) {_,e:=runGit(root,"add","-A");if e!=nil{return "",e};return gitstore.Commit(root,subject,[]string{"."})}
+func Done(ctx context.Context,req model.Request) (model.Result,error) {
+ c,cl,oid,e:=owned(req.Root,req.Change);if e!=nil{return model.Result{},e};req.Quick=false;r,e:=evaluate(ctx,req,c,cl,oid);if e!=nil{return r,e};phase:=cl.Phase;var findings []string;if phase=="audit" {findings,e=auditSubmission(c,cl);if e!=nil{return r,e};normalizeAudit(&c,findings)}
+ if phase=="evals" {if cfgBool(cl.Snapshot,"audit","enabled",true) {c.Document.Frontmatter["phase"]="audit"} else {c.Document.Frontmatter["phase"]="impl"}}
+ if phase=="audit" {if len(findings)==0 {c.Document.Frontmatter["phase"]="impl"} else {limit:=cfgInt(cl.Snapshot,"audit","max_rounds",2);if frontInt(c.Document,"audit_rounds")>=limit||strings.Contains(section(c.Document,"Audit"),"[untestable]") {c.Document.Frontmatter["phase"]="blocked";c.Document.Frontmatter["blocked"]="audit findings";c.Document.Body=contracts.ReplaceSection(c.Document.Body,"Questions",strings.Join(findings,"\n")+"\n")} else {c.Document.Frontmatter["phase"]="evals";c.Document.Frontmatter["audit_rounds"]=frontInt(c.Document,"audit_rounds")+1}}}
+ if phase=="impl" {if e=applySpec(cl.Owner,c);e!=nil{return r,e};if e=diagnosticsError(project.Check(cl.Owner));e!=nil{return r,e};c.Document.Frontmatter["phase"]="applied"}
+ provenance(&c,req,phase,r.Reports);if e=renderChange(cl.Owner,c);e!=nil{return r,e};if phase=="impl" {archive:=filepath.Join(cl.Owner,"changes/archive",filepath.Base(c.Path));if e=os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(archive),0755);e!=nil{return r,e};if e=os.Rename(filepath.Join(cl.Owner,c.Path),archive);e!=nil{return r,e};c.Path=filepath.ToSlash(filepath.Join("changes/archive",filepath.Base(c.Path)))}
+ newHead,e:=commitAll(cl.Owner,fmt.Sprintf("fireweed: %s %s",c.Slug,phase));if e!=nil{return r,e};cl.Phase=frontString(c.Document,"phase");cl.Base=newHead;cl.Approved=c.Document;if cl.Phase=="applied"||cl.Phase=="blocked" {if e=gitstore.CASRef(cl.Owner,claimRef(c.Slug),oid,"");e!=nil{return r,e};r.State=state(cl.Owner,c,cl,"");if cl.Phase=="blocked"{return r,coded("P06","change blocked: audit findings")};return r,nil};newOID,e:=saveClaim(cl.Owner,cl,oid);if e!=nil{return r,e};r.State=state(cl.Owner,c,cl,newOID);return r,nil
+}
+func specIDs(c project.Change) []string {ids:=targetIDs(c);sort.Strings(ids);return ids}

changes",name,n),Warning:true})}};baseCount,_,_:=unapprovedCount(info.Root,snap);r.Unapproved=baseCount;for _,c:=range archives {commits,_:=Commits(info.Root,c.Path);r.PhaseCommits[strings.TrimSuffix(filepath.Base(c.Path),".md")]=len(commits)};snapshots,_:=Costs(info.Root);latest:=map[string]model.CostSnapshot{};latestCost:=map[string]model.ModuleCost{};for +func dependency(modules []project.Module,from,to string,seen map[string]bool) bool {if from==to{return false};if seen[from]{return false};seen[from]=true;for _,m:=range modules {if m.Name!=from{continue};for _,d:=range m.DependsOn {if d==to||dependency(modules,d,to,seen){return true}}};return false}

+ candidate:=q[i];snap,e:=project.Project(root,candidate.Slug);if e!=nil{return "",""}

+func Eligible(root string) ([]project.Change,error) {info,e:=rootInfo(root);if e!=nil{return nil,e};q,e:=queue(info.Root);if e!=nil{return nil,e};out:=[]project.Change{};for i,c:=range q {if frontString(c.Document,"phase")=="blocked" {continue};if on,_:=waitingFor(info.Root,q,i);on!="" {continue};out=append(out,c)};return out,nil}

+func moduleSpecs(m project.Module) []contracts.Item {items,_:=contracts.ParseItems(section(m.Document,"Specs"));return items}

+func validateBeforeHooks(root string,c project.Change,cl claim) error {

+package lifecycle
+
+import (

+)
+
+type claim struct {
+ Owner string
+ Slug string
+ Path string
+ Run string
+ Phase string
+ Base string
+ Snapshot project.Snapshot
+ Approved contracts.Document
+}
+
+func coded(code, format string, args ...any) error { return fmt.Errorf("%s: %s", code, fmt.Sprintf(format,args...)) }
+func rootInfo(root string) (gitstore.Repository,error) { return gitstore.Inspect(root) }
+func runGit(root string, args ...string) (string,error) {
+ c:=exec.Command("git",args...); c.Dir=root
+ b,e:=c.CombinedOutput(); if e!=nil { return "",fmt.Errorf("git %s: %w: %s",strings.Join(args," "),e,strings.TrimSpace(string(b))) }; return strings.TrimSpace(string(b)),nil
+}
+func gitBytes(root string,args ...string) ([]byte,error) { c:=exec.Command("git",args...);c.Dir=root; b,e:=c.Output();return b,e }
+func dirty(root string) (bool,error) { s,e:=runGit(root,"status","--porcelain","--untracked-files=all");return s!="",e }
+func claimRef(slug string) string { return "refs/fireweed/claims/"+slug }
+func readClaim(root,slug string) (claim,string,bool,error) {
+ oid,ok,e:=gitstore.Ref(root,claimRef(slug));if e!=nil||!ok{return claim{},"",ok,e}
+ b,e:=gitstore.ReadBlob(root,oid);if e!=nil{return claim{},"",false,e};var c claim;e=json.Unmarshal(b,&c);return c,oid,true,e
+}
+func saveClaim(root string,c claim,old string) (string,error) { b,e:=json.Marshal(c);if e!=nil{return "",e};oid,e:=gitstore.WriteBlob(root,b);if e!=nil{return "",e};if e=gitstore.CASRef(root,claimRef(c.Slug),old,oid);e!=nil{return "",e};return oid,nil }

+func queue(root string) ([]project.Change,error) {return project.Queue(root)}
+func findPending(root,selector string) (project.Change,error) {
+ q,e:=queue(root);if e!=nil{return project.Change{},e};return selectChange(q,selector)
+}
+func selectChange(q []project.Change,selector string) (project.Change,error) {
+ var found []project.Change;for _,c:=range q {if selector==c.Slug||selector==c.Path||selector==filepath.Base(c.Path)||selector==strings.TrimSuffix(filepath.Base(c.Path),".md") {found=append(found,c)}}
+ if len(found)==1{return found[0],nil}

+ if len(found)>1{return project.Change{},coded("U02","change %q is ambiguous; valid slugs: %s",selector,strings.Join(slugs,", "))}
+ return project.Change{},coded("U02","change %q not found; valid slugs: %s",selector,strings.Join(slugs,", "))

+package lifecycle
+
+import (
+ "context"

+ body:=section(c.Document,"Audit");if body=="" {return nil,coded("P09","missing audit submission")};m,_:=module(cl.Snapshot,c.Module);specs:=map[string]string{};for _,it:=range moduleSpecs(m) {specs[it.ID]=it.Body};prior:=map[string]bool{};for _,x:=range findingRE.FindAllStringSubmatch(section(cl.Approved,"Audit"),-1){prior[x[2]]=true}

+ if len(kept)>0{return kept,nil}
+ if !strings.Contains(body,"No findings") {return nil,coded("P09","audit submission needs No findings or valid findings")};match:=checkedRE.FindStringSubmatch(body);if len(match)<2 {return nil,coded("P09","No findings requires checked IDs")};checked:=map[string]bool{};for _,part:=range strings.FieldsFunc(match[1],func(r rune)bool{return r==','||r==' '||r=='\t'}){checked[part]=true};for _,id:=range targetIDs(c) {if !checked[id] {return nil,coded("P09","No findings missing checked ID %s",id)}};return nil,nil
+}
+func normalizeAudit(c *project.Change,findings []string) {if len(findings)>0 {c.Document.Body=contracts.ReplaceSection(c.Document.Body,"Audit",strings.Join(findings,"\n")+"\n")} else {body:=section(c.Document,"Audit");lines:=[]string{};for _,line:=range strings.Split(body,"\n") {if strings.HasPrefix(strings.TrimSpace(line),"-"){continue};lines=append(lines,line)};c.Document.Body=contracts.ReplaceSection(c.Document.Body,"Audit",strings.Join(lines,"\n")+"\n")}}
+func provenance(c *project.Change,req model.Request,phase string,reports map[string]checks.Report) {
+ agent:=req.Agent;if agent==""{agent="manual"};book,_:=assets.Playbook(phase);if phase=="impl"&&frontBool(c.Document,"regenerate"){book,_=assets.Playbook("regenerate")};h:=sha256.Sum256([]byte(book));total,passing,failing:=0,0,0;for _,r:=range reports {for _,tc:=range r.Cases {total++;if tc.Result=="pass"{passing++} else if tc.Result=="fail"||tc.Result=="error"{failing++}}};line:=fmt.Sprintf("- %s %s agent=%s fireweed=%s playbook=%s tests=%d failing=%d passing=%d",phase,nowUTC().Format("2006-01-02T15:04:05Z07:00"),agent,assets.Version(),hex.EncodeToString(h[:]),total,failing,passing);old:=section(c.Document,"Provenance");if old!=""{old+="\n"};c.Document.Body=contracts.ReplaceSection(c.Document.Body,"Provenance",old+line+"\n")

+func applySpec(root string,c project.Change) error {
+ path:=filepath.Join(root,"packages",c.Module,"SPEC.md");for _,m:=range mustModules(root) {if m.Name==c.Module {path=filepath.Join(root,m.Dir,"SPEC.md")}}
+ b,e:=os.ReadFile(path);if e!=nil{return e};doc,e:=contracts.ParseDocument(string(b));if e!=nil{return e};items,e:=contracts.ParseItems(section(doc,"Specs"));if e!=nil{return e};byID:=map[string]contracts.Item{};order:=[]string{};for _,it:=range items {byID[it.ID]=it;order=append(order,it.ID)};for _,it:=range c.Removed{delete(byID,it.ID)};for _,it:=range c.Modified {byID[it.ID]=it};for _,it:=range c.Added {if _,ok:=byID[it.ID];!ok{order=append(order,it.ID)};byID[it.ID]=it};rendered:=[]string{};for _,id:=range order {if it,ok:=byID[id];ok{rendered=append(rendered,strings.TrimSpace(contracts.RenderItem(it)))}};doc.Body=contracts.ReplaceSection(doc.Body,"Specs",strings.Join(rendered,"\n\n")+"\n")

+ decisions:=section(doc,"Decisions");for _,line:=range strings.Split(section(c.Document,"Removed decisions"),"\n") {line=strings.TrimSpace(line);if line!="" {decisions=strings.ReplaceAll(decisions,line,"")}};decisions=strings.TrimSpace(decisions);for _,line:=range strings.Split(section(c.Document,"Decisions"),"\n") {line=strings.TrimSpace(line);if line!=""{if decisions!=""{decisions+="\n"};decisions+="- "+c.Slug+": "+strings.TrimPrefix(line,"- ")}};doc.Body=contracts.ReplaceSection(doc.Body,"Decisions",decisions+"\n")

+ if phase=="audit" {if len(findings)==0 {c.Document.Frontmatter["phase"]="impl"} else {limit:=cfgInt(cl.Snapshot,"audit","max_rounds",2);if frontInt(c.Document,"audit_rounds")>=limit||strings.Contains(section(c.Document,"Audit"),"[untestable]") {c.Document.Frontmatter["phase"]="blocked";c.Document.Frontmatter["blocked"]="audit findings";c.Document.Body=contracts.ReplaceSection(c.Document.Body,"Questions",strings.Join(findings,"\n")+"\n")} else {c.Document.Frontmatter["phase"]="evals";c.Document.Frontmatter["audit_rounds"]=frontInt(c.Document,"audit_rounds")+1}}}

+ provenance(&c,req,phase,r.Reports);if e=renderChange(cl.Owner,c);e!=nil{return r,e};if phase=="impl" {archive:=filepath.Join(cl.Owner,"changes/archive",filepath.Base(c.Path));if e=os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(archive),0755);e!=nil{return r,e};if e=os.Rename(filepath.Join(cl.Owner,c.Path),archive);e!=nil{return r,e};c.Path=filepath.ToSlash(filepath.Join("changes/archive",filepath.Base(c.Path)))}

+func validateBeforeHooks(root string,c project.Change,cl claim) error {

package evals_test

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"reflect"
	"sort"
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/gitstore"
	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/workflow"
)

var gcNow = time.Date(2026, 11, 4, 12, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)

func gcCall(t *testing.T, root string, now time.Time) workflow.GCResult {
	t.Helper()
	r, err := workflow.GC(context.Background(), workflow.GCRequest{Root: root, Now: now})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("GC: %v", err)
	}
	return r
}

func gcRef(t *testing.T, root, name, oid string) {
	t.Helper()
	if err := gitstore.CASRef(root, name, "", oid); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("create %s: %v", name, err)
	}
}

func gcClaim(t *testing.T, root, name, worktree string) {
	t.Helper()
	data, err := json.Marshal(map[string]string{"worktree": worktree, "change": name})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	oid, err := gitstore.WriteBlob(root, data)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	gcRef(t, root, "refs/fireweed/claims/"+name, oid)
}

func gcPresent(t *testing.T, root, name string, want bool) {
	t.Helper()
	_, found, err := gitstore.Ref(root, name)
	if err != nil || found != want {
		t.Errorf("ref %s present=%t, error=%v; want present=%t", name, found, err, want)
	}
}

func gcNames(t *testing.T, root string) []string {
	t.Helper()
	out := git(t, root, "for-each-ref", "--format=%(refname)", "refs/fireweed")
	if out == "" {
		return nil
	}
	return strings.Split(out, "\n")
}

func gcPruned(t *testing.T, got, want []string) {
	t.Helper()
	sort.Strings(want)
	if !reflect.DeepEqual(got, want) {
		t.Errorf("GC Pruned = %v, want sorted %v", got, want)
	}
}

func Test_FLOW_128_GCPrunesMissingAndUnregisteredClaimsOnly(t *testing.T) {
	root := fixture(t, "", "", "", "", "")
	linked := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "linked")
	git(t, root, "worktree", "add", "-b", "linked", linked, "HEAD")
	gcClaim(t, root, "main-live", root)
	gcClaim(t, root, "linked-live", linked)
	missing := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "removed")
	gcClaim(t, root, "missing", missing)
	unregistered := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "unregistered")
	if err := os.Mkdir(unregistered, 0o755); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	gcClaim(t, root, "unregistered", unregistered)
	foreign, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(t.TempDir())
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	git(t, foreign, "init")
	if got := git(t, foreign, "worktree", "list", "--porcelain"); !strings.Contains(got, "worktree "+foreign) {
		t.Fatalf("foreign repository does not register its worktree: %s", got)
	}
	gcClaim(t, root, "foreign", foreign)
	gcRef(t, root, "refs/fireweed/other/keep", head(t, root))

	r := gcCall(t, root, gcNow)
	gcPruned(t, r.Pruned, []string{"refs/fireweed/claims/missing", "refs/fireweed/claims/unregistered", "refs/fireweed/claims/foreign"})
	for _, name := range []string{"missing", "unregistered", "foreign"} {
		gcPresent(t, root, "refs/fireweed/claims/"+name, false)
	}
	for _, name := range []string{"main-live", "linked-live"} {
		gcPresent(t, root, "refs/fireweed/claims/"+name, true)
	}
	gcPresent(t, root, "refs/fireweed/other/keep", true)
}

func Test_FLOW_129_GCPrunesOnlyArchivedChangeAttempts(t *testing.T) {
	root := fixture(t, "", "", "", "", "")
	write(t, root, "changes/archive/0002-finished.md", "---\nmodule: alpha\nphase: applied\n---\n")
	write(t, root, "changes/0003-pending.md", "---\nmodule: alpha\n---\n")
	oid := head(t, root)
	archived := []string{"refs/fireweed/attempts/finished/1", "refs/fireweed/attempts/finished/2"}
	for _, name := range append(archived, "refs/fireweed/attempts/pending/1", "refs/fireweed/attempts/unknown/1", "refs/fireweed/attempts/finished/not-an-attempt") {
		gcRef(t, root, name, oid)
	}
	r := gcCall(t, root, gcNow)
	gcPruned(t, r.Pruned, archived)
	for _, name := range archived {
		gcPresent(t, root, name, false)
	}
	for _, name := range []string{"refs/fireweed/attempts/pending/1", "refs/fireweed/attempts/unknown/1", "refs/fireweed/attempts/finished/not-an-attempt"} {
		gcPresent(t, root, name, true)
	}
}

func Test_FLOW_130_FLOW_131_GCDrillAgeUsesConfiguredDurationAndNativeUTCDate(t *testing.T) {
	for _, tc := range []struct {
		name, config      string
		old, equal, newer string
	}{
		{"configured", "gc:\n  drill_max_age: 24h\n", "20261103T115959.999999999", "20261103T120000.000000000", "20261103T120000.000000001"},
		{"default", "", "20261005T115959.999999999", "20261005T120000.000000000", "20261005T120000.000000001"},
	} {
		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			root := fixture(t, tc.config, "", "", "", "")
			oid := head(t, root)
			prefix := "refs/fireweed/drills/alpha/"
			for _, date := range []string{tc.old, tc.equal, tc.newer} {
				gcRef(t, root, prefix+date, oid)
			}
			gcRef(t, root, prefix+"unrecognized", oid)
			gcRef(t, root, "refs/fireweed/drills/alpha/not-a-date/extra", oid)
			r := gcCall(t, root, gcNow)
			gcPruned(t, r.Pruned, []string{prefix + tc.old})
			gcPresent(t, root, prefix+tc.old, false)
			for _, name := range []string{prefix + tc.equal, prefix + tc.newer, prefix + "unrecognized", "refs/fireweed/drills/alpha/not-a-date/extra"} {
				gcPresent(t, root, name, true)
			}
		})
	}
	// With zero Now, a native date far in the past is expired against any
	// current clock, while a future date stays live.
	root := fixture(t, "", "", "", "", "")
	old := "refs/fireweed/drills/alpha/20200101T000000.000000000"
	future := "refs/fireweed/drills/alpha/20990101T000000.000000000"
	gcRef(t, root, old, head(t, root))
	gcRef(t, root, future, head(t, root))
	gcPruned(t, gcCall(t, root, time.Time{}).Pruned, []string{old})
	gcPresent(t, root, future, true)
}

func Test_FLOW_131_GCInvalidDurationFailsBeforeAnyPruning(t *testing.T) {
	for _, value := range []string{"0s", "-1h", "invalid"} {
		t.Run(value, func(t *testing.T) {
			root := fixture(t, "gc:\n  drill_max_age: "+value+"\n", "", "", "", "")
			claim := "refs/fireweed/claims/stale"
			old := "refs/fireweed/drills/alpha/20200101T000000.000000000"
			gcClaim(t, root, "stale", filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "gone"))
			gcRef(t, root, old, head(t, root))
			before := gcNames(t, root)
			r, err := workflow.GC(context.Background(), workflow.GCRequest{Root: root, Now: gcNow})
			if err == nil || !strings.HasPrefix(err.Error(), "C01:") {
				t.Errorf("invalid drill_max_age %q: result=%#v error=%v; want C01", value, r, err)
			}
			if got := gcNames(t, root); !reflect.DeepEqual(got, before) {
				t.Errorf("invalid setting pruned refs: before=%v after=%v", before, got)
			}
			gcPresent(t, root, claim, true)
		})
	}
}

func Test_FLOW_132_GCReportsOnlyDeletedRefsAndPreservesRepositoryState(t *testing.T) {
	root := fixture(t, "", "", "", "", "")
	write(t, root, "changes/archive/0002-finished.md", "---\nmodule: alpha\nphase: applied\n---\n")
	write(t, root, "working.txt", "untracked work\n")
	write(t, root, "SYSTEM.md", "staged work\n")
	git(t, root, "add", "SYSTEM.md")
	gcClaim(t, root, "z-stale", filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "missing"))
	gcRef(t, root, "refs/fireweed/attempts/finished/1", head(t, root))
	gcRef(t, root, "refs/fireweed/drills/alpha/20200101T000000.000000000", head(t, root))
	gcRef(t, root, "refs/fireweed/other/keep", head(t, root))
	want := []string{"refs/fireweed/claims/z-stale", "refs/fireweed/attempts/finished/1", "refs/fireweed/drills/alpha/20200101T000000.000000000"}
	beforeHead := head(t, root)
	beforeIndex := git(t, root, "write-tree")
	beforeStatus := git(t, root, "status", "--porcelain=v1", "--untracked-files=all")
	beforeWork := readFile(t, root, "working.txt")
	beforeStaged := readFile(t, root, "SYSTEM.md")
	r := gcCall(t, root, gcNow)
	gcPruned(t, r.Pruned, want)
	for _, name := range want {
		gcPresent(t, root, name, false)
	}
	gcPresent(t, root, "refs/fireweed/other/keep", true)
	if got := head(t, root); got != beforeHead {
		t.Errorf("GC moved HEAD: %s -> %s", beforeHead, got)
	}
	if got := git(t, root, "write-tree"); got != beforeIndex {
		t.Errorf("GC changed index tree: %s -> %s", beforeIndex, got)
	}
	if got := git(t, root, "status", "--porcelain=v1", "--untracked-files=all"); got != beforeStatus {
		t.Errorf("GC changed worktree status: %q -> %q", beforeStatus, got)
	}
	if readFile(t, root, "working.txt") != beforeWork || readFile(t, root, "SYSTEM.md") != beforeStaged {
		t.Error("GC changed working files")
	}
	if second := gcCall(t, root, gcNow); len(second.Pruned) != 0 {
		t.Errorf("second GC reported refs it did not delete: %v", second.Pruned)
	}
}

+}
+func normalizeAudit(c *project.Change,findings []string) {if len(findings)>0 {c.Document.Body=contracts.ReplaceSection(c.Document.Body,"Audit",strings.Join(findings,"\n")+"\n")} else {body:=section(c.Document,"Audit");lines:=[]string{};for _,line:=range strings.Split(body,"\n") {if strings.HasPrefix(strings.TrimSpace(line),"-"){continue};lines=append(lines,line)};c.Document.Body=contracts.ReplaceSection(c.Document.Body,"Audit",strings.Join(lines,"\n")+"\n")}}

+func applySpec(root string,c project.Change) error {

+func GC(ctx context.Context,req model.GCRequest) (model.GCResult,error) {info,e:=rootInfo(req.Root);if e!=nil{return model.GCResult{},e};snap,e:=project.Load(info.Root);if e!=nil{return model.GCResult{},e};maxAge:=720*time.Hour;if v:=cfgString(snap,"gc","drill_max_age");v!=""{maxAge,e=time.ParseDuration(v);if e!=nil||maxAge<=0{return model.GCResult{},coded("C01","invalid gc.drill_max_age %q",v)}};now:=req.Now;if now.IsZero(){now=nowUTC()};refs,e:=gitRefList(info.Root,"refs/fireweed");if e!=nil{return model.GCResult{},e};registered:=map[string]bool{};list,_:=runGit(info.Root,"worktree","list","--porcelain");for _,line:=range strings.Split(list,"\n") {if strings.HasPrefix(line,"worktree "){p:=strings.TrimPrefix(line,"worktree ");if resolved,e:=filepath.EvalSymlinks(p);e==nil {registered[resolved]=true}}};archives:=map[string]bool{};for _,c:=range archiveChanges(info.Root){archives[c.Slug]=true};deleted:=[]string{};for _,ref:=range refs {prune:=false;parts:=strings.Split(ref,"/");if len(parts)<4{continue};switch parts[2] {case "claims":oid,ok,_:=gitstore.Ref(info.Root,ref);if !ok{continue};b,e:=gitstore.ReadBlob(info.Root,oid);if e!=nil{continue};var payload map[string]any;if json.Unmarshal(b,&payload)!=nil{continue};owner,_:=payload["worktree"].(string);if owner==""{owner,_=payload["Owner"].(string)};if resolved,e:=filepath.EvalSymlinks(owner);e==nil{owner=resolved};if _,e:=os.Stat(owner);e!=nil||!registered[owner]{prune=true};case "attempts":if len(parts)==5&&archives[parts[3]]{if n,e:=strconv.Atoi(parts[4]);e==nil&&n>0{prune=true}};case "drills":if len(parts)==5 {t,e:=time.Parse("20060102T150405.000000000",parts[4]);if e==nil&&t.Before(now.Add(-maxAge)){prune=true}}};if prune {oid,ok,e:=gitstore.Ref(info.Root,ref);if e==nil&&ok {if e=gitstore.CASRef(info.Root,ref,oid,"");e==nil{deleted=append(deleted,ref)}}}};sort.Strings(deleted);return model.GCResult{Pruned:deleted},nil}

+func module(s project.Snapshot,name string) (project.Module,bool) {for _,m:=range s.Modules {if m.Name==name{return m,true}};return project.Module{},false}
+func moduleSpecs(m project.Module) []contracts.Item {items,_:=contracts.ParseItems(section(m.Document,"Specs"));return items}
+func activeSpecs(items []contracts.Item) []contracts.Item {out:=[]contracts.Item{};for _,it:=range items {if !strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(it.Tag),"quarantine") {out=append(out,it)}};return out}

+func targetIDs(c project.Change) []string {ids:=[]string{};for _,it:=range c.Added {ids=append(ids,it.ID)};for _,it:=range c.Modified {ids=append(ids,it.ID)};ids=append(ids,listFront(c.Document,"fixes")...);ids=append(ids,listFront(c.Document,"eval_fix")...);return ids}

+ if len(listFront(cl.Approved,"eval_fix"))>0 {m,_:=module(cl.Snapshot,c.Module);for _,ch:=range changes {if ch.Path==c.Path{continue};rel:=strings.TrimPrefix(ch.Path,m.Dir+"/");zone:=contracts.ResolveZone(rel,m.Zones);if cl.Phase=="impl"||zone!="evals" {return fmt.Errorf("Z01: eval_fix forbids edit to %s",ch.Path)}}};return nil
+}
+func validateBeforeHooks(root string,c project.Change,cl claim) error {
+ if cl.Phase!="evals"&&cl.Phase!="impl"&&cl.Phase!="audit" {return coded("P01","unsupported phase %s",cl.Phase)}
+ if head(root)!=cl.Base{return coded("P05","stale phase base: HEAD changed from %s to %s",cl.Base,head(root))}
+ if e:=sameApproved(cl.Approved,c.Document,cl.Phase);e!=nil{return e}
+ if e:=checkStale(root,c);e!=nil{return e}

+}

+ var firstErr error

+ }
+ costs:=make([]model.ModuleCost,0,len(names));for _,name:=range names {m,_:=module(cl.Snapshot,name);costs=append(costs,measureModule(cl.Owner,m,result.Reports[name]))};result.Costs=costs;ds:=budgetWarnings(cl.Snapshot,costs);result.Diagnostics=append(result.Diagnostics,ds...);_ = saveCosts(cl.Owner,model.CostSnapshot{Run:cl.Run,Phase:cl.Phase,RecordedAt:nowUTC(),Modules:costs,Diagnostics:ds})
+ if cl.Phase=="impl"&&!req.Quick {d,e:=checks.Boundaries(ctx,checks.BoundaryRequest{Snapshot:cl.Snapshot,Bin:req.Bin,Timeout:req.Timeout});result.Diagnostics=append(result.Diagnostics,d...);if e!=nil&&firstErr==nil{firstErr=e};if de:=diagnosticsError(d);de!=nil&&firstErr==nil{firstErr=de}}

+}
+func Verify(ctx context.Context,req model.Request) (model.Result,error) {c,cl,oid,e:=owned(req.Root,req.Change);if e!=nil{return model.Result{},e};return evaluate(ctx,req,c,cl,oid)}

+func budgetWarnings(s project.Snapshot,costs []model.ModuleCost) []project.Diagnostic {ds:=[]project.Diagnostic{};timeLimit:=15*time.Minute;if v:=cfgString(s,"budgets","verify_time");v!="" {if d,e:=time.ParseDuration(v);e==nil {timeLimit=d}};cases:=cfgInt(s,"budgets","cases_per_spec",15);ratio:=4.0;if v:=cfgString(s,"budgets","eval_ratio");v!=""{_,_=fmt.Sscan(v,&ratio)};total:=0.0;for _,c:=range costs{total+=c.Seconds};if total>timeLimit.Seconds(){ds=append(ds,project.Diagnostic{Code:"B01",Message:fmt.Sprintf("verify seconds %.3f exceeds limit %.3f",total,timeLimit.Seconds()),Warning:true})};for _,c:=range costs {for id,n:=range c.CasesPerSpec {if n>cases{ds=append(ds,project.Diagnostic{Code:"B02",Message:fmt.Sprintf("%s: %d cases exceeds limit %d",id,n,cases),Warning:true})}};if c.EvalLines>0&&(c.DisposableLines==0||float64(c.EvalLines)/float64(c.DisposableLines)>ratio) {ds=append(ds,project.Diagnostic{Code:"B03",Message:fmt.Sprintf("%s: eval/disposable ratio %d/%d exceeds limit %g",c.Module,c.EvalLines,c.DisposableLines,ratio),Warning:true})}};return ds}

package evals_test

import (

func prBody(t *testing.T, root, revisionRange string) workflow.PRBodyReport {
	t.Helper()
	r, err := workflow.PRBody(root, revisionRange)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("PRBody(%q): %v", revisionRange, err)
	}
	return r
}

func prRequire(t *testing.T, body string, terms ...string) {
	t.Helper()
	for _, term := range terms {
		if !strings.Contains(body, term) {
			t.Errorf("PR body lacks %q:\n%s", term, body)
		}
	}
}

func prReject(t *testing.T, body string, terms ...string) {
	t.Helper()
	for _, term := range terms {
		if strings.Contains(body, term) {
			t.Errorf("PR body unexpectedly contains %q:\n%s", term, body)
		}
	}
}

func prPhase(t *testing.T, root, phase string) {
	t.Helper()
	path := "changes/0001-manual.md"
	before := readFile(t, root, path)
	after := before
	for _, old := range []string{"evals", "audit", "impl"} {
		if strings.Contains(after, "phase: "+old+"\n") {
			after = strings.Replace(after, "phase: "+old+"\n", "phase: "+phase+"\n", 1)
			break
		}
	}
	if after == before {
		t.Fatalf("fixture phase missing in %s", path)
	}
	write(t, root, path, after)
}

// The earlier phase commits stay reachable when the requested range contains
// only the final implementation commit. The final commit also archives the
// selected identity, as a real Done does.
func prHistoryFixture(t *testing.T) (root, base, finalPhase, endpoint string) {
	t.Helper()
	root = fixture(t, "worker_writable: [workspace.lock]\n", "", "### ALP-003 [review]\nAdded review clause MUST be inspected.\n", "", "")
	alpha := readFile(t, root, "packages/alpha/SPEC.md")
	alpha = strings.Replace(alpha, "depends_on: []\n", "depends_on: []\npreserve: [internal/keep.go]\n", 1)
	alpha = strings.Replace(alpha, "### ALP-002\n", "### ALP-002 [review]\n", 1)
	write(t, root, "packages/alpha/SPEC.md", alpha)
	manual := readFile(t, root, "changes/0001-manual.md")
	manual = strings.Replace(manual, "### ALP-001\n", "### ALP-001 [review]\n", 1)
	manual = strings.Replace(manual, "module: alpha\n", "module: alpha\nphase: evals\nrun: pr-fixture\naudit_rounds: 0\n", 1)
	write(t, root, "changes/0001-manual.md", manual)
	write(t, root, "packages/alpha/internal/keep.go", "package alpha // preserved baseline\n")
	write(t, root, "packages/alpha/internal/existing.go", "package alpha // existing disposable\n")
	write(t, root, "changes/0003-outside.md", "---\nmodule: gamma\n---\n\n## Motivation\nOutside range change.\n\n## Interface\n\n## Added\n\n## Modified\n\n## Removed\n\n## Decisions\n\n")
	write(t, root, "changes/0004-removed.md", "---\nmodule: beta\n---\n\n## Motivation\nRemoved identity.\n\n## Interface\n\n## Added\n\n## Modified\n\n## Removed\n\n## Decisions\n\n")
	commit(t, root, "fixture phase base")
	base = head(t, root)

	// Evals: an interface edit, one new disposable stub, an eval file, a
	// module manifest, an ordinary module file and a shared writable lockfile.
	write(t, root, "packages/alpha/api.go", "package alpha // RANGE INTERFACE EDIT\n")
	write(t, root, "packages/alpha/evals/report_test.go", "package alpha_test // RANGE EVAL EDIT\n")
	write(t, root, "packages/alpha/internal/new_stub.go", "package alpha // RANGE STUB ADDITION\n")
	write(t, root, "packages/alpha/go.mod", "module fixture.invalid/alpha\n")
	write(t, root, "packages/alpha/other.txt", "RANGE OTHER EDIT\n")
	write(t, root, "workspace.lock", "RANGE SHARED EDIT\n")
	write(t, root, "changes/0002-pending.md", "---\nmodule: beta\neval_fix: [BET-001]\nphase: audit\nrun: beta-pr-fixture\naudit_rounds: 0\n---\n\n## Motivation\nSelected pending identity.\n\n## Interface\n\n## Added\n\n## Modified\n\n## Removed\n\n## Decisions\n\n## Provenance\n- evals 2026-10-30T12:00:00Z tests=7 failing=2 passing=5\n")
	manual = readFile(t, root, "changes/0001-manual.md")
	manual = strings.Replace(manual, "phase: evals\n", "phase: audit\n", 1)
	manual += "\n## Provenance\n- evals 2026-10-30T12:00:00Z tests=11 failing=3 passing=8\n"
	write(t, root, "changes/0001-manual.md", manual)
	commit(t, root, "evals phase with selected pending change")

	manual = readFile(t, root, "changes/0001-manual.md")
	manual = strings.Replace(manual, "phase: audit\n", "phase: evals\n", 1)
	manual = strings.Replace(manual, "audit_rounds: 0\n", "audit_rounds: 1\n", 1)
	manual += "\n## Audit\n- ALP-001: \"" + newClause + "\" — PRIOR AUDIT FINDING missing assertion\n"
	write(t, root, "changes/0001-manual.md", manual)
	commit(t, root, "audit finding round one")

	write(t, root, "packages/alpha/evals/report_test.go", "package alpha_test // CORRECTED EVAL EDIT\n")
	prPhase(t, root, "audit")
	commit(t, root, "corrected eval phase")

	manual = readFile(t, root, "changes/0001-manual.md")
	manual = strings.Replace(manual, "phase: audit\n", "phase: impl\n", 1)
	manual = strings.Replace(manual, "\n## Audit\n- ALP-001: \""+newClause+"\" — PRIOR AUDIT FINDING missing assertion\n", "\n## Audit\nNo findings\nChecked IDs: ALP-001\n", 1)
	write(t, root, "changes/0001-manual.md", manual)
	commit(t, root, "clean audit phase")
	finalPhase = head(t, root)

	write(t, root, "packages/alpha/internal/keep.go", "package alpha // PRESERVED IMPLEMENTATION EDIT\n")
	write(t, root, "packages/alpha/internal/existing.go", "package alpha // IMPLEMENTATION EDIT\n")
	manual = readFile(t, root, "changes/0001-manual.md")
	manual = strings.Replace(manual, "phase: impl\n", "phase: applied\n", 1)
	manual += "- impl 2026-10-30T12:30:00Z tests=13 failing=0 passing=13\n"
	write(t, root, "changes/archive/0001-manual.md", manual)
	if err := os.Remove(filepath.Join(root, "changes/0001-manual.md")); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := os.Remove(filepath.Join(root, "changes/0004-removed.md")); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	commit(t, root, "implementation and archive")
	endpoint = head(t, root)
	return
}

func Test_FLOW_114_FLOW_115_FLOW_116_FLOW_117_FLOW_118_FLOW_119_FLOW_120_FLOW_121_PRBodySelectedHistoryAndEndpoint(t *testing.T) {
	root, base, finalPhase, endpoint := prHistoryFixture(t)
	// Later committed and dirty edits must not change the requested endpoint.
	write(t, root, "fireweed.yaml", strings.Replace(readFile(t, root, "fireweed.yaml"), "modules: [\"packages/*\"]", "modules: [] # LATER HEAD CONFIG MARKER", 1))
	write(t, root, "packages/alpha/SPEC.md", readFile(t, root, "packages/alpha/SPEC.md")+"\nLATER HEAD SPEC MARKER\n")
	commit(t, root, "later unrelated HEAD")
	write(t, root, "fireweed.yaml", readFile(t, root, "fireweed.yaml")+"\n# DIRTY WORKTREE CONFIG MARKER\n")
	write(t, root, "packages/alpha/SPEC.md", readFile(t, root, "packages/alpha/SPEC.md")+"\nDIRTY WORKTREE SPEC MARKER\n")
	full := base + ".." + endpoint
	partial := finalPhase + ".." + endpoint
	t.Run("FLOW_114_explicit_endpoints", func(t *testing.T) {
		r := prBody(t, root, full)
		prRequire(t, r.Body, base[:12], endpoint[:12])
		prReject(t, r.Body, "LATER HEAD CONFIG MARKER", "LATER HEAD SPEC MARKER", "DIRTY WORKTREE CONFIG MARKER", "DIRTY WORKTREE SPEC MARKER")
	})
	t.Run("FLOW_115_selected_identities", func(t *testing.T) {
		r := prBody(t, root, full)
		prRequire(t, r.Body, "changes/archive/0001-manual.md", "alpha", "changes/0002-pending.md", "beta", "eval_fix")
		prReject(t, r.Body, "0003-outside", "0004-removed")
		p := prBody(t, root, partial)
		prRequire(t, p.Body, "changes/archive/0001-manual.md")
		prReject(t, p.Body, "0002-pending.md")
	})
	t.Run("FLOW_116_provenance_and_evals", func(t *testing.T) {
		fullReport := prBody(t, root, full)
		prRequire(t, fullReport.Body, "tests=7", "failing=2", "passing=5")
		for _, rr := range []string{full, partial} {
			r := prBody(t, root, rr)
			prRequire(t, r.Body, "tests=11", "failing=3", "passing=8", "report_test.go")
		}
	})
	t.Run("FLOW_117_phase_file_categories", func(t *testing.T) {
		for _, rr := range []string{full, partial} {
			r := prBody(t, root, rr)
			prRequire(t, r.Body, "api.go", "new_stub.go", "go.mod", "other.txt", "workspace.lock")
		}
	})
	t.Run("FLOW_118_preserved_edits", func(t *testing.T) {
		r := prBody(t, root, full)
		prRequire(t, r.Body, "keep.go")
	})
	t.Run("FLOW_119_review_specs", func(t *testing.T) {
		for _, rr := range []string{full, partial} {
			r := prBody(t, root, rr)
			prRequire(t, r.Body, "ALP-003", "Added review clause MUST be inspected.", "ALP-001", newClause)
			prReject(t, r.Body, "Alpha MUST retain the second behavior.")
		}

		for _, rr := range []string{full, partial} {
			r := prBody(t, root, rr)
			prRequire(t, r.Body, "PRIOR AUDIT FINDING")
			if !strings.Contains(r.Body, "audit_rounds") && !strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(r.Body), "audit rounds") {
				t.Errorf("PR body omits audit round count: %s", r.Body)
			}
		}
	})
	t.Run("FLOW_121_decisions", func(t *testing.T) {

		prRequire(t, r.Body, "Use the revised policy.", "Retain old policy.")
	})
}

func prSaveCost(t *testing.T, root, run, phase string, snapshot workflow.CostSnapshot) {
	t.Helper()
	b, err := json.Marshal(snapshot)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	write(t, root, filepath.Join(".fireweed/runs", run, phase, "costs.json"), string(b))
}

	write(t, root, "changes/0001-manual.md", strings.Replace(manual, "module: alpha\n", "module: alpha\nblocked: ENDPOINT BLOCK REASON\n", 1))
	commit(t, root, "endpoint exceptions")
	endpoint := head(t, root)
	old := workflow.CostSnapshot{Run: "old", Phase: "evals", RecordedAt: time.Date(2026, 10, 29, 0, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC), Modules: []workflow.ModuleCost{{Module: "alpha", Seconds: 99, CasesPerSpec: map[string]int{"ALP-001": 99}, EvalLines: 99, DisposableLines: 1}}, Diagnostics: []project.Diagnostic{{Code: "B01", Message: "OLD B01", Warning: true}}}
	latest := workflow.CostSnapshot{Run: "new", Phase: "impl", RecordedAt: time.Date(2026, 10, 30, 0, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC), Modules: []workflow.ModuleCost{{Module: "alpha", Seconds: 4.25, CasesPerSpec: map[string]int{"ALP-001": 5}, EvalLines: 17, DisposableLines: 3}, {Module: "beta", Seconds: 2.5, CasesPerSpec: map[string]int{"BET-001": 2}, EvalLines: 8, DisposableLines: 4}}, Diagnostics: []project.Diagnostic{{Code: "B01", Message: "SAVED B01 time", Warning: true}, {Code: "B02", Message: "ALP-001: SAVED B02 cases", Warning: true}, {Code: "B03", Message: "alpha: SAVED B03 ratio", Warning: true}}}
	prSaveCost(t, root, "old", "evals", old)
	prSaveCost(t, root, "new", "impl", latest)
	write(t, root, "fireweed.yaml", readFile(t, root, "fireweed.yaml")+"\nbudgets:\n  cases_per_spec: 1000\n  eval_ratio: 1000\n")
	write(t, root, "packages/alpha/evals/later.txt", strings.Repeat("later\n", 50))
	t.Run("FLOW_122_endpoint_exceptions", func(t *testing.T) {
		r := prBody(t, root, base+".."+endpoint)
		prRequire(t, r.Body, "alpha", "ALP-002", "ENDPOINT QUARANTINE REASON", "ENDPOINT OPT OUT REASON", "0001-manual", "ENDPOINT BLOCK REASON")
	})
	t.Run("FLOW_123_latest_saved_costs", func(t *testing.T) {
		r := prBody(t, root, base+".."+endpoint)
		prRequire(t, r.Body, "SAVED B01", "SAVED B02", "SAVED B03")
		prReject(t, r.Body, "OLD B01")
		section := regexp.MustCompile(`(?ms)^#{1,6} (?:Cost|Costs|Metric|Metrics)\s*\n(.*?)(?:^#{1,6} |\z)`).FindStringSubmatch(r.Body)
		if len(section) != 2 {
			t.Errorf("PR body lacks a Cost/Metric section: %s", r.Body)
		} else {
			rows := regexp.MustCompile(`(?m)^\|\s*(?:alpha|beta|gamma)\s*\|[^\n]*$`).FindAllString(section[1], -1)
			want := map[string]string{
				"alpha": "alpha|4.25|ALP-001: 5|17|3",
				"beta":  "beta|2.5|BET-001: 2|8|4",
			}
			seen := map[string]bool{}
			for _, row := range rows {
				cells := strings.Split(strings.Trim(strings.TrimSpace(row), "|"), "|")
				for i := range cells {
					cells[i] = strings.TrimSpace(cells[i])
				}
				module := cells[0]
				if seen[module] || strings.Join(cells, "|") != want[module] {
					t.Errorf("unexpected or stale cost measurement row %q", row)
				}
				seen[module] = true
			}
			for module := range want {
				if !seen[module] {
					t.Errorf("missing saved %s cost measurement row: %s", module, section[1])
				}
			}
		}
		for _, code := range []string{"B01", "B02", "B03"} {
			if !containsCode(r.Diagnostics, code) {
				t.Errorf("PRBody diagnostics lack saved %s: %#v", code, r.Diagnostics)
			}
		}
	})
}

func Test_FLOW_126_PRBodyEndpointConfigError(t *testing.T) {
	root := fixture(t, "", "", "", "", "")
	base := head(t, root)
	write(t, root, "fireweed.yaml", "[invalid endpoint configuration\n")
	commit(t, root, "invalid endpoint configuration")

	_, err := workflow.PRBody(root, base+".."+head(t, root))
	if err == nil {
		t.Fatal("PRBody accepted malformed endpoint configuration")
	}
	if !workflow.IsEndpointConfigError(err) {
		t.Errorf("IsEndpointConfigError(%v) = false, want true", err)
	}
}

func Test_FLOW_127_PRBodyUnresolvableRangeIsNotEndpointConfigError(t *testing.T) {
	root := fixture(t, "", "", "", "", "")
	_, err := workflow.PRBody(root, head(t, root)+"..not-a-commit")
	if err == nil {
		t.Fatal("PRBody accepted an unresolvable range")
	}
	if workflow.IsEndpointConfigError(err) {
		t.Errorf("IsEndpointConfigError(%v) = true, want false", err)
	}
}

func Test_FLOW_124_FLOW_125_PRBodyDisposableArtifactBoundaryAndRanges(t *testing.T) {
	root := fixture(t, "", "", "", "", "")
	base := head(t, root)
	for path, data := range map[string][]byte{
		"packages/alpha/internal/binary.dat": {0, 1, 2, 3},
		"packages/alpha/internal/large.txt":  []byte(strings.Repeat("L", 262145)),
		"packages/alpha/internal/exact.txt":  []byte(strings.Repeat("E", 262144)),
		"packages/alpha/internal/small.txt":  []byte("ordinary text\n"),
	} {
		full := filepath.Join(root, path)
		if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(full), 0755); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if err := os.WriteFile(full, data, 0644); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}
	commit(t, root, "new disposable artifacts")
	endpoint := head(t, root)
	t.Run("FLOW_124_binary_and_large_artifacts", func(t *testing.T) {
		r := prBody(t, root, base+".."+endpoint)
		prRequire(t, r.Body, "binary.dat", "large.txt", "262145", "B04")
		if !regexp.MustCompile("(?m)(binary\\.dat[^\\n]*\\b4\\b|\\b4\\b[^\\n]*binary\\.dat)").MatchString(r.Body) {
			t.Errorf("binary artifact lacks its 4-byte size: %s", r.Body)
		}
		count := 0
		for _, d := range r.Diagnostics {
			if d.Code == "B04" {
				count++
				if !d.Warning || !(strings.Contains(d.Message, "binary.dat") || strings.Contains(d.Message, "large.txt")) || strings.Contains(d.Message, "exact.txt") || strings.Contains(d.Message, "small.txt") {
					t.Errorf("unexpected B04 diagnostic: %#v", d)
				}
			}
		}
		if count != 2 {
			t.Errorf("B04 count = %d, want 2: %#v", count, r.Diagnostics)
		}
	})
	t.Run("FLOW_125_empty_and_invalid_ranges", func(t *testing.T) {
		empty := prBody(t, root, endpoint+".."+endpoint)
		if strings.TrimSpace(empty.Body) == "" || !(strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(empty.Body), "none") || strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(empty.Body), "no change")) {
			t.Errorf("empty range did not explicitly report no selected changes: %q", empty.Body)
		}
		if containsCode(empty.Diagnostics, "B04") {
			t.Errorf("empty range yielded B04: %#v", empty.Diagnostics)
		}
		for _, invalid := range []string{"", "not-a-commit.." + endpoint, base + "..not-a-commit", "not-a-range"} {
			_, err := workflow.PRBody(root, invalid)
			if err == nil || !strings.Contains(err.Error(), "P01") || (invalid != "" && !strings.Contains(err.Error(), "not-a-commit") && !strings.Contains(err.Error(), "not-a-range") && !strings.Contains(err.Error(), "resolve")) {
				t.Errorf("PRBody(%q) error = %v, want P01 with rejected range or cause", invalid, err)
			}
		}
	})
}

+func checkStale(root string,c project.Change) error {stale,e:=project.StaleSpecs(root,c.Slug);if e!=nil {if strings.Contains(e.Error(),"stale base"){return coded("P05","%v",e)};return e};for _,s:=range stale {if !s.Recovered{return coded("P05","stale base for %s",s.ID)}};return nil}
+func diagnosticsError(ds []project.Diagnostic) error {for _,d:=range ds {if !d.Warning{return fmt.Errorf("%s: %s",d.Code,d.Message)}};return nil}
+func nowUTC() time.Time {return time.Now().UTC()}
+func gitChanges(root,base string) ([]gitstore.Change,error) {return gitstore.Changes(root,base)}

+ agent:=req.Agent;if agent==""{agent="manual"};book,_:=assets.Playbook(phase);if phase=="impl"&&frontBool(c.Document,"regenerate"){book,_=assets.Playbook("regenerate")};h:=sha256.Sum256([]byte(book));total,passing,failing:=0,0,0;for _,r:=range reports {for _,tc:=range r.Cases {total++;if tc.Result=="pass"{passing++} else if tc.Result=="fail"||tc.Result=="error"{failing++}}};line:=fmt.Sprintf("- %s %s agent=%s fireweed=%s playbook=%s tests=%d failing=%d passing=%d",phase,nowUTC().Format("2006-01-02T15:04:05Z07:00"),agent,assets.Version(),hex.EncodeToString(h[:]),total,failing,passing);old:=section(c.Document,"Provenance");if old!=""{old+="\n"};c.Document.Body=contracts.ReplaceSection(c.Document.Body,"Provenance",old+line+"\n")

+func applySpec(root string,c project.Change) error {
+ path:=filepath.Join(root,"packages",c.Module,"SPEC.md");for _,m:=range mustModules(root) {if m.Name==c.Module {path=filepath.Join(root,m.Dir,"SPEC.md")}}
+ b,e:=os.ReadFile(path);if e!=nil{return e};doc,e:=contracts.ParseDocument(string(b));if e!=nil{return e};items,e:=contracts.ParseItems(section(doc,"Specs"));if e!=nil{return e};byID:=map[string]contracts.Item{};order:=[]string{};for _,it:=range items {byID[it.ID]=it;order=append(order,it.ID)};for _,it:=range c.Removed{delete(byID,it.ID)};for _,it:=range c.Modified {byID[it.ID]=it};for _,it:=range c.Added {if _,ok:=byID[it.ID];!ok{order=append(order,it.ID)};byID[it.ID]=it};rendered:=[]string{};for _,id:=range order {if it,ok:=byID[id];ok{rendered=append(rendered,strings.TrimSpace(contracts.RenderItem(it)))}};doc.Body=contracts.ReplaceSection(doc.Body,"Specs",strings.Join(rendered,"\n\n")+"\n")

+func Done(ctx context.Context,req model.Request) (model.Result,error) {
+ c,cl,oid,e:=owned(req.Root,req.Change);if e!=nil{return model.Result{},e};req.Quick=false;r,e:=evaluate(ctx,req,c,cl,oid);if e!=nil{return r,e};phase:=cl.Phase;var findings []string;if phase=="audit" {findings,e=auditSubmission(c,cl);if e!=nil{return r,e};normalizeAudit(&c,findings)}
+ if phase=="evals" {if cfgBool(cl.Snapshot,"audit","enabled",true) {c.Document.Frontmatter["phase"]="audit"} else {c.Document.Frontmatter["phase"]="impl"}}
+ if phase=="audit" {if len(findings)==0 {c.Document.Frontmatter["phase"]="impl"} else {limit:=cfgInt(cl.Snapshot,"audit","max_rounds",2);if frontInt(c.Document,"audit_rounds")>=limit||strings.Contains(section(c.Document,"Audit"),"[untestable]") {c.Document.Frontmatter["phase"]="blocked";c.Document.Frontmatter["blocked"]="audit findings";c.Document.Body=contracts.ReplaceSection(c.Document.Body,"Questions",strings.Join(findings,"\n")+"\n")} else {c.Document.Frontmatter["phase"]="evals";c.Document.Frontmatter["audit_rounds"]=frontInt(c.Document,"audit_rounds")+1}}}

+func specIDs(c project.Change) []string {ids:=targetIDs(c);sort.Strings(ids);return ids}

+package lifecycle
+
+import (
+ "context"

+ "os"

+ "strconv"

+ "time"
+
+ "github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/gitstore"

+
+func GC(ctx context.Context,req model.GCRequest) (model.GCResult,error) {info,e:=rootInfo(req.Root);if e!=nil{return model.GCResult{},e};snap,e:=project.Load(info.Root);if e!=nil{return model.GCResult{},e};maxAge:=720*time.Hour;if v:=cfgString(snap,"gc","drill_max_age");v!=""{maxAge,e=time.ParseDuration(v);if e!=nil||maxAge<=0{return model.GCResult{},coded("C01","invalid gc.drill_max_age %q",v)}};now:=req.Now;if now.IsZero(){now=nowUTC()};refs,e:=gitRefList(info.Root,"refs/fireweed");if e!=nil{return model.GCResult{},e};registered:=map[string]bool{};list,_:=runGit(info.Root,"worktree","list","--porcelain");for _,line:=range strings.Split(list,"\n") {if strings.HasPrefix(line,"worktree "){p:=strings.TrimPrefix(line,"worktree ");if resolved,e:=filepath.EvalSymlinks(p);e==nil {registered[resolved]=true}}};archives:=map[string]bool{};for _,c:=range archiveChanges(info.Root){archives[c.Slug]=true};deleted:=[]string{};for _,ref:=range refs {prune:=false;parts:=strings.Split(ref,"/");if len(parts)<4{continue};switch parts[2] {case "claims":oid,ok,_:=gitstore.Ref(info.Root,ref);if !ok{continue};b,e:=gitstore.ReadBlob(info.Root,oid);if e!=nil{continue};var payload map[string]any;if json.Unmarshal(b,&payload)!=nil{continue};owner,_:=payload["worktree"].(string);if owner==""{owner,_=payload["Owner"].(string)};if resolved,e:=filepath.EvalSymlinks(owner);e==nil{owner=resolved};if _,e:=os.Stat(owner);e!=nil||!registered[owner]{prune=true};case "attempts":if len(parts)==5&&archives[parts[3]]{if n,e:=strconv.Atoi(parts[4]);e==nil&&n>0{prune=true}};case "drills":if len(parts)==5 {t,e:=time.Parse("20060102T150405.000000000",parts[4]);if e==nil&&t.Before(now.Add(-maxAge)){prune=true}}};if prune {oid,ok,e:=gitstore.Ref(info.Root,ref);if e==nil&&ok {if e=gitstore.CASRef(info.Root,ref,oid,"");e==nil{deleted=append(deleted,ref)}}}};sort.Strings(deleted);return model.GCResult{Pruned:deleted},nil}

+package lifecycle
+
+import (

+)
+
+func allChanges(root string) ([]project.Change,error) {q,e:=queue(root);if e!=nil{return nil,e};return append(q,archiveChanges(root)...),nil}
+func selectedAny(root,selector string) (project.Change,error) {all,e:=allChanges(root);if e!=nil{return project.Change{},e};return selectChange(all,selector)}
+func phaseAt(root,revision,path string) string {b,e:=gitstore.ReadAt(root,revision,path);if e!=nil{return ""};d,e:=contracts.ParseDocument(string(b));if e!=nil{return ""};return frontString(d,"phase")}
+func Commits(root,selector string) ([]string,error) {info,e:=rootInfo(root);if e!=nil{return nil,e};c,e:=selectedAny(info.Root,selector);if e!=nil{return nil,e};names:=[]string{"changes/"+filepath.Base(c.Path),"changes/archive/"+filepath.Base(c.Path)};list,e:=runGit(info.Root,"rev-list","HEAD");if e!=nil{return nil,e};out:=[]string{};for _,oid:=range strings.Fields(list) {parent,_:=runGit(info.Root,"rev-parse",oid+"^");newPhase,oldPhase:="","";for _,p:=range names {if x:=phaseAt(info.Root,oid,p);x!="" {newPhase=x};if parent!="" {if x:=phaseAt(info.Root,parent,p);x!="" {oldPhase=x}}};if newPhase!=""&&newPhase!=oldPhase{out=append(out,oid)}};return out,nil}
+func Abandon(root,selector string) (string,error) {info,e:=rootInfo(root);if e!=nil{return "",e};c,e:=selectedAny(info.Root,selector);if e!=nil{return "",e};if strings.HasPrefix(c.Path,"changes/archive/")&&frontString(c.Document,"phase")=="applied" {return "",coded("P01","cannot abandon applied change")};d,e:=dirty(info.Root);if e!=nil{return "",e};if d{return "",coded("P01","abandon requires clean worktree")};cl,oid,exists,e:=readClaim(info.Root,c.Slug);if e!=nil{return "",e};if exists&&cl.Owner!=info.Root{return "",coded("P02","claim belongs to another worktree")};commits,e:=Commits(info.Root,c.Path);if e!=nil{return "",e};for _,commit:=range commits {if _,e=runGit(info.Root,"revert","--no-commit",commit);e!=nil{return "",e}};if e=os.Remove(filepath.Join(info.Root,filepath.FromSlash(c.Path)));e!=nil{return "",e};newHead,e:=commitAll(info.Root,"fireweed: abandon "+c.Slug);if e!=nil{return "",e};if exists {if e=gitstore.CASRef(info.Root,claimRef(c.Slug),oid,"");e!=nil{return "",e}};return newHead,nil}
+func resolveAttempt(root,slug string,n int) (string,string,error) {if n<=0{return "","",coded("P01","attempt must be positive")};name:=fmt.Sprintf("refs/fireweed/attempts/%s/%d",slug,n);oid,ok,e:=gitstore.Ref(root,name);if e!=nil{return "","",e};if !ok{return "","",coded("P01","attempt %d missing",n)};return name,oid,nil}
+func nextAttempt(root,slug string) int {for n:=1;;n++ {_,ok,_:=gitstore.Ref(root,fmt.Sprintf("refs/fireweed/attempts/%s/%d",slug,n));if !ok{return n}}}
+func changedPaths(root,from,to string) []string {s,_:=runGit(root,"diff","--name-only",from,to);out:=strings.Fields(s);sort.Strings(out);return out}

+package lifecycle
