+func Context(root,selector string,full bool) (string,error) {c,cl,_,e:=owned(root,selector);if e!=nil{return "",e};m,ok:=module(cl.Snapshot,c.Module);if !ok{return "",fmt.Errorf("module %s missing",c.Module)};name:=cl.Phase;if name=="impl"&&frontBool(c.Document,"regenerate"){name="regenerate"};book,e:=assets.Playbook(name);if e!=nil{return "",e};var b strings.Builder;fmt.Fprintf(&b,"# Change\n%s\n\n# Projected spec\n%s\n\n# SYSTEM\n",c.Document.Body,m.Document.Body);system,_:=os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(cl.Owner,"SYSTEM.md"));b.Write(system);fmt.Fprintf(&b,"\n# Playbook\n%s\n\n# Interface\n",book);_ = filepath.WalkDir(filepath.Join(cl.Owner,m.Dir),func(path string,d os.DirEntry,e error) error {if e!=nil||d.IsDir(){return nil};rel,_:=filepath.Rel(filepath.Join(cl.Owner,m.Dir),path);zone:=contracts.ResolveZone(filepath.ToSlash(rel),m.Zones);if zone!="interface" {return nil};data,_:=os.ReadFile(path);fmt.Fprintf(&b,"\n%s\n%s\n",filepath.ToSlash(filepath.Join(m.Dir,rel)),data);return nil});fmt.Fprintf(&b,"\n# Other files\n");_ = filepath.WalkDir(filepath.Join(cl.Owner,m.Dir),func(path string,d os.DirEntry,e error) error {if e!=nil||d.IsDir(){return nil};rel,_:=filepath.Rel(filepath.Join(cl.Owner,m.Dir),path);zone:=contracts.ResolveZone(filepath.ToSlash(rel),m.Zones);if zone=="interface"||rel=="SPEC.md"{return nil};info,_:=d.Info();if info==nil{return nil};fmt.Fprintf(&b,"%s %d bytes\n",filepath.ToSlash(filepath.Join(m.Dir,rel)),info.Size());if full {data,_:=os.ReadFile(path);b.Write(data);b.WriteString("\n")};return nil});return b.String(),nil}
+var quarantineRE=regexp.MustCompile(`(?i)quarantine:\s*([^\]]+)`)
+func archiveChanges(root string) []project.Change {paths,_:=filepath.Glob(filepath.Join(root,"changes/archive/*.md"));out:=[]project.Change{};for _,p:=range paths {b,e:=os.ReadFile(p);if e!=nil{continue};doc,e:=contracts.ParseDocument(string(b));if e!=nil{continue};rel,_:=filepath.Rel(root,p);out=append(out,project.Change{Slug:strings.TrimPrefix(strings.TrimSuffix(filepath.Base(p),".md"),numberPrefix(filepath.Base(p))),Path:filepath.ToSlash(rel),Module:frontString(doc,"module"),Document:doc})};return out}
+func numberPrefix(s string) string {i:=strings.IndexByte(s,'-');if i<0{return ""};return s[:i+1]}
+func implDate(c project.Change) time.Time {for _,line:=range strings.Split(section(c.Document,"Provenance"),"\n") {f:=strings.Fields(line);if len(f)>=3&&f[0]=="-"&&f[1]=="impl" {t,_:=time.Parse(time.RFC3339Nano,f[2]);return t}};return time.Time{}}
+func Status(root string) (model.StatusReport,error) {info,e:=rootInfo(root);if e!=nil{return model.StatusReport{},e};snap,e:=project.Load(info.Root);if e!=nil{return model.StatusReport{},e};q,e:=queue(info.Root);if e!=nil{return model.StatusReport{},e};r:=model.StatusReport{Modules:snap.Modules,Queue:[]model.StatusEntry{},Quarantines:[]model.Quarantine{},BoundaryOptOuts:[]model.BoundaryOptOut{},DriftSinceDrill:map[string]int{},PhaseCommits:map[string]int{},Costs:[]model.ModuleCost{}};for i,c:=range q {phase:=frontString(c.Document,"phase");if phase==""{phase="queued"};blocked:=frontString(c.Document,"blocked");entry:=model.StatusEntry{Slug:c.Slug,Path:c.Path,Module:c.Module,Phase:phase,Blocked:blocked,AuditRounds:frontInt(c.Document,"audit_rounds")};if blocked=="" {entry.WaitingOn,entry.WaitingRule=waitingFor(info.Root,q,i)};r.Queue=append(r.Queue,entry)};archives:=archiveChanges(info.Root);for _,m:=range snap.Modules {for _,it:=range moduleSpecs(m) {if x:=quarantineRE.FindStringSubmatch(it.Tag);len(x)>1 {r.Quarantines=append(r.Quarantines,model.Quarantine{Module:m.Name,ID:it.ID,Reason:strings.TrimSpace(x[1])})}};if reason:=frontString(m.Document,"boundaries_opt_out");reason!="" {r.BoundaryOptOuts=append(r.BoundaryOptOuts,model.BoundaryOptOut{Module:m.Name,Reason:reason})};reportDate:=time.Time{};p:=filepath.Join(info.Root,".fireweed/drills",m.Name+".md");if b,e:=os.ReadFile(p);e==nil {if d,e:=contracts.ParseDocument(string(b));e==nil {reportDate,_=time.Parse(time.RFC3339Nano,frontString(d,"date"))}};n:=0;for _,c:=range archives {if c.Module==m.Name&&frontString(c.Document,"phase")=="applied"&&implDate(c).After(reportDate){n++}};r.DriftSinceDrill[m.Name]=n};sort.Slice(archives,func(i,j int)bool{a,b:=implDate(archives[i]),implDate(archives[j]);if a.Equal(b){return archives[i].Path<archives[j].Path};return a.After(b)});if len(archives)>=3 {name:=archives[0].Module;n:=0;for _,c:=range archives {if c.Module!=name{break};n++};if n>=3 {r.Diagnostics=append(r.Diagnostics,project.Diagnostic{Code:"P08",Message:fmt.Sprintf("%s has %d consecutive applied changes",name,n),Warning:true})}};baseCount,_,_:=unapprovedCount(info.Root,snap);r.Unapproved=baseCount;for _,c:=range archives {commits,_:=Commits(info.Root,c.Path);r.PhaseCommits[strings.TrimSuffix(filepath.Base(c.Path),".md")]=len(commits)};snapshots,_:=Costs(info.Root);latest:=map[string]model.CostSnapshot{};latestCost:=map[string]model.ModuleCost{};for _,s:=range snapshots {for _,cost:=range s.Modules {if old,ok:=latest[cost.Module];!ok||!s.RecordedAt.Before(old.RecordedAt){latest[cost.Module]=s;latestCost[cost.Module]=cost}}};names:=[]string{};for name:=range latestCost{names=append(names,name)};sort.Strings(names);seen:=map[string]bool{};for _,name:=range names {r.Costs=append(r.Costs,latestCost[name]);for _,d:=range latest[name].Diagnostics {key:=d.Code+"|"+d.Message;if !seen[key] {r.Diagnostics=append(r.Diagnostics,d);seen[key]=true}}};return r,nil}
diff --git a/packages/workflow/internal/lifecycle/start.go b/packages/workflow/internal/lifecycle/start.go
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..76429870544f98ffaf52b16881389e14776e0ebe
--- /dev/null
+++ b/packages/workflow/internal/lifecycle/start.go
@@ -0,0 +1,327 @@
+package lifecycle
+
+import (
+	"crypto/rand"
+	"encoding/hex"
+	"fmt"
+	"os"
+	"path/filepath"
+	"regexp"
+	"strconv"
+	"strings"
+	"time"
+
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/contracts"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/gitstore"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/project"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/workflow/model"
+)
+
+func dependency(modules []project.Module, from, to string, seen map[string]bool) bool {
+	if from == to {
+		return false
+	}
+	if seen[from] {
+		return false
+	}
+	seen[from] = true
+	for _, m := range modules {
+		if m.Name != from {
+			continue
+		}
+		for _, d := range m.DependsOn {
+			if d == to || dependency(modules, d, to, seen) {
+				return true
+			}
+		}
+	}
+	return false
+}
+func waitingFor(root string, q []project.Change, i int) (string, string) {
+	candidate := q[i]
+	snap, e := project.Project(root, candidate.Slug)
+	if e != nil {
+		return "", ""
+	}
+	for _, prior := range q[:i] {
+		if frontString(prior.Document, "blocked") == "" && frontString(prior.Document, "phase") != "blocked" {
+			continue
+		}
+		if candidate.Module == prior.Module {
+			return prior.Slug, "same_module"
+		}
+		if dependency(snap.Modules, candidate.Module, prior.Module, map[string]bool{}) {
+			return prior.Slug, "depends_on_blocked"
+		}
+		if section(candidate.Document, "Interface") != "" && dependency(snap.Modules, prior.Module, candidate.Module, map[string]bool{}) {
+			return prior.Slug, "interface_dependency"
+		}
+	}
+	return "", ""
+}
+func Eligible(root string) ([]project.Change, error) {
+	info, e := rootInfo(root)
+	if e != nil {
+		return nil, e
+	}
+	q, e := queue(info.Root)
+	if e != nil {
+		return nil, e
+	}
+	out := []project.Change{}
+	for i, c := range q {
+		if frontString(c.Document, "blocked") != "" || frontString(c.Document, "phase") == "blocked" {
+			continue
+		}
+		if on, _ := waitingFor(info.Root, q, i); on != "" {
+			continue
+		}
+		out = append(out, c)
+	}
+	return out, nil
+}
+func newRun() string { b := make([]byte, 16); _, _ = rand.Read(b); return hex.EncodeToString(b) }
+
+var localID = regexp.MustCompile(`new:[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_-]*`)
+
+func allocateIDs(root string, c *project.Change) error {
+	snap, e := project.Load(root)
+	if e != nil {
+		return e
+	}
+	prefix := ""
+	used := map[int]bool{}
+	for _, m := range snap.Modules {
+		if m.Name != c.Module {
+			continue
+		}
+		prefix = m.IDPrefix
+		s := section(m.Document, "Specs")
+		items, _ := contracts.ParseItems(s)
+		for _, it := range items {
+			if strings.HasPrefix(it.ID, prefix+"-") {
+				n, _ := strconv.Atoi(strings.TrimPrefix(it.ID, prefix+"-"))
+				used[n] = true
+			}
+		}
+	}
+	if prefix == "" {
+		return fmt.Errorf("module %s not found", c.Module)
+	}
+	for _, q := range mustQueue(root) {
+		if q.Path == c.Path {
+			continue
+		}
+		for _, it := range q.Added {
+			if strings.HasPrefix(it.ID, prefix+"-") {
+				n, _ := strconv.Atoi(strings.TrimPrefix(it.ID, prefix+"-"))
+				used[n] = true
+			}
+		}
+	}
+	body := c.Document.Body
+	replacements := map[string]string{}
+	for _, it := range c.Added {
+		if !localID.MatchString(it.ID) {
+			continue
+		}
+		if _, ok := replacements[it.ID]; ok {
+			continue
+		}
+		n := 1
+		for used[n] {
+			n++
+		}
+		used[n] = true
+		replacements[it.ID] = fmt.Sprintf("%s-%03d", prefix, n)
+	}
+	for old, newID := range replacements {
+		body = strings.ReplaceAll(body, old, newID)
+	}
+	c.Document.Body = body
+	return nil
+}
+func mustQueue(root string) []project.Change { q, _ := queue(root); return q }
+func startPreconditions(root, selector string) (gitstore.Repository, project.Change, error) {
+	info, e := rootInfo(root)
+	if e != nil {
+		return info, project.Change{}, e
+	}
+	q, e := queue(info.Root)
+	if e != nil {
+		return info, project.Change{}, e
+	}
+	if selector != "" {
+		if _, e = selectChange(q, selector); e != nil {
+			return info, project.Change{}, e
+		}
+	}
+	d, e := dirty(info.Root)
+	if e != nil {
+		return info, project.Change{}, e
+	}
+	if d {
+		return info, project.Change{}, coded("P01", "start requires clean worktree")
+	}
+	eligible, e := Eligible(info.Root)
+	if e != nil {
+		return info, project.Change{}, e
+	}
+	if len(eligible) == 0 {
+		return info, project.Change{}, coded("P01", "no eligible change")
+	}
+	selected := eligible[0]
+	if selector != "" {
+		wanted, _ := selectChange(q, selector)
+		if wanted.Path != selected.Path {
+			return info, project.Change{}, coded("P01", "change is not eligible queue head")
+		}
+	}
+	if _, _, exists, e := readClaim(info.Root, selected.Slug); e != nil {
+		return info, selected, e
+	} else if exists {
+		return info, selected, coded("P02", "claim already held: update-ref %s", claimRef(selected.Slug))
+	}
+	return info, selected, nil
+}
+func Start(root, selector string) (model.State, error) {
+	info, c, e := startPreconditions(root, selector)
+	if e != nil {
+		return model.State{}, e
+	}
+	c, e = parseChange(info.Root, c)
+	if e != nil {
+		return model.State{}, e
+	}
+	if e = checkStale(info.Root, c); e != nil {
+		return model.State{}, e
+	}
+	snap, e := project.Load(info.Root)
+	if e != nil {
+		return model.State{}, e
+	}
+	limit := cfgInt(snap, "authoring", "max_unapproved", 5)
+	unapproved, base, baseErr := unapprovedCount(info.Root, snap)
+	if baseErr == nil && unapproved >= limit {
+		d := project.Diagnostic{Code: "P07", Message: fmt.Sprintf("unapproved archive count %d reaches limit %d", unapproved, limit)}
+		return model.State{Diagnostics: []project.Diagnostic{d}}, coded("P07", "%s", d.Message)
+	}
+	original := c.Document
+	wasUnstarted := frontString(c.Document, "phase") == ""
+	if wasUnstarted {
+		if e = allocateIDs(info.Root, &c); e != nil {
+			return model.State{}, e
+		}
+		phase := "evals"
+		if len(c.Added) == 0 && len(c.Modified) == 0 && len(c.Removed) == 0 && frontString(c.Document, "fixes") == "" && frontString(c.Document, "eval_fix") == "" {
+			phase = "impl"
+		}
+		if frontBool(c.Document, "regenerate") {
+			phase = "impl"
+		}
+		c.Document.Frontmatter["phase"] = phase
+		c.Document.Frontmatter["run"] = newRun()
+	}
+	if e = renderChange(info.Root, c); e != nil {
+		return model.State{}, e
+	}
+	projected, e := project.Project(info.Root, c.Slug)
+	if e != nil {
+		_ = renderOriginal(info.Root, c.Path, original)
+		if strings.Contains(e.Error(), "stale base") {
+			return model.State{}, coded("P05", "%v", e)
+		}
+		return model.State{}, e
+	}
+	c, e = parseChange(info.Root, c)
+	if e != nil {
+		return model.State{}, e
+	}
+	cl := claim{Owner: info.Root, Slug: c.Slug, Path: c.Path, Run: frontString(c.Document, "run"), Phase: frontString(c.Document, "phase"), Base: info.Head, Snapshot: projected, Approved: c.Document}
+	if cl.Run == "" {
+		cl.Run = newRun()
+		c.Document.Frontmatter["run"] = cl.Run
+		cl.Approved = c.Document
+		_ = renderChange(info.Root, c)
+	}
+	oid, e := saveClaim(info.Root, cl, "")
+	if e != nil {
+		_ = renderOriginal(info.Root, c.Path, original)
+		return model.State{}, coded("P02", "claim already held: update-ref %v", e)
+	}
+	s := state(info.Root, c, cl, oid)
+	if baseErr == nil && base != "" {
+		local:= "refs/heads/"+frontConfig(snap,"base","main")
+		if _, e := gitstore.ReadAt(info.Root, base, c.Path); e != nil {
+			if _, e2 := gitstore.ReadAt(info.Root, local, c.Path); e2 != nil {
+				s.Diagnostics = append(s.Diagnostics, project.Diagnostic{Code: "P04", Message: "change absent from local and shared base", Warning: true})
+			}
+		}
+	}
+	if wasUnstarted && frontBool(c.Document, "regenerate") {
+		if e = deleteDisposable(info.Root, projected, c.Module); e != nil {
+			return s, e
+		}
+		if !newerPassingDrill(info.Root, c.Module) {
+			s.Diagnostics = append(s.Diagnostics, project.Diagnostic{Code: "P10", Message: "no passing drill after latest implementation", Warning: true})
+		}
+	}
+	return s, nil
+}
+func renderOriginal(root, path string, d contracts.Document) error {
+	s, e := contracts.RenderDocument(d)
+	if e != nil {
+		return e
+	}
+	return writeText(root, path, s)
+}
+func unapprovedCount(root string, s project.Snapshot) (int, string, error) {
+	baseName := frontConfig(s, "base", "main")
+	remote := frontConfig(s, "remote", "origin")
+	base, e := gitstore.BaseRef(root, remote, baseName)
+	if e != nil {
+		return 0, "", e
+	}
+	n := 0
+	for _, c := range archiveChanges(root) {
+		if frontString(c.Document,"phase")!="applied" {continue}
+		if _, e := gitstore.ReadAt(root, base, c.Path); e != nil {
+			n++
+		}
+	}
+	return n, base, nil
+}
+func frontConfig(s project.Snapshot, key, def string) string {
+	if v := s.Config[key]; v != nil {
+		return fmt.Sprint(v)
+	}
+	return def
+}
+func deleteDisposable(root string, s project.Snapshot, name string) error {
+	for _, m := range s.Modules {
+		if m.Name != name {
+			continue
+		}
+		return filepath.WalkDir(filepath.Join(root, m.Dir), func(path string, d os.DirEntry, e error) error {
+			if e != nil {
+				return e
+			}
+			if d.IsDir() {
+				return nil
+			}
+			rel, _ := filepath.Rel(filepath.Join(root, m.Dir), path)
+			if contracts.ResolveZone(filepath.ToSlash(rel), m.Zones) == "disposable" {
+				return os.Remove(path)
+			}
+			return nil
+		})
+	}
+	return nil
+}
+func newerPassingDrill(root, module string) bool {
+	latest:=time.Time{}
+	for _,c:=range archiveChanges(root) { if c.Module==module&&frontString(c.Document,"phase")=="applied" {if t:=implDate(c);t.After(latest){latest=t}} }
+	b,e:=os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(root,".fireweed/drills",module+".md"));if e!=nil{return false}
+	d,e:=contracts.ParseDocument(string(b));if e!=nil||frontString(d,"result")!="pass"{return false}
+	t,e:=time.Parse(time.RFC3339Nano,frontString(d,"date"));return e==nil&&t.After(latest)
+}
diff --git a/packages/workflow/internal/lifecycle/verify.go b/packages/workflow/internal/lifecycle/verify.go
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..9d3af0b9136d192b900d839322fcf27cfd5e9a4c
--- /dev/null
+++ b/packages/workflow/internal/lifecycle/verify.go
@@ -0,0 +1,327 @@
+package lifecycle
+
+import (
+	"context"
+	"encoding/json"
+	"fmt"
+	"os"
+	"path/filepath"
+	"sort"
+	"strings"
+	"time"
+
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/checks"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/contracts"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/project"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/workflow/model"
+)
+
+func module(s project.Snapshot, name string) (project.Module, bool) {
+	for _, m := range s.Modules {
+		if m.Name == name {
+			return m, true
+		}
+	}
+	return project.Module{}, false
+}
+func moduleSpecs(m project.Module) []contracts.Item {
+	items, _ := contracts.ParseItems(section(m.Document, "Specs"))
+	return items
+}
+func activeSpecs(items []contracts.Item) []contracts.Item {
+	out := []contracts.Item{}
+	for _, it := range items {
+		if !strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(it.Tag), "quarantine") {
+			out = append(out, it)
+		}
+	}
+	return out
+}
+func listFront(d contracts.Document, key string) []string {
+	out := []string{}
+	switch v := d.Frontmatter[key].(type) {
+	case []any:
+		for _, x := range v {
+			out = append(out, fmt.Sprint(x))
+		}
+	case []string:
+		return v
+	case string:
+		if v != "" {
+			out = append(out, v)
+		}
+	}
+	return out
+}
+func targetIDs(c project.Change) []string {
+	ids := []string{}
+	for _, it := range c.Added {
+		ids = append(ids, it.ID)
+	}
+	for _, it := range c.Modified {
+		ids = append(ids, it.ID)
+	}
+	ids = append(ids, listFront(c.Document, "fixes")...)
+	ids = append(ids, listFront(c.Document, "eval_fix")...)
+	return ids
+}
+func validateZone(root string, c project.Change, cl claim) error {
+	changes, e := gitChanges(root, cl.Base)
+	if e != nil {
+		return e
+	}
+	declared := section(cl.Approved, "Interface") != ""
+	ds := checks.Zones(checks.ZoneRequest{Snapshot: cl.Snapshot, Module: c.Module, Phase: cl.Phase, ChangePath: c.Path, Base: cl.Base, InterfaceDeclared: declared, Changes: changes})
+	if e = diagnosticsError(ds); e != nil {
+		return e
+	}
+	if len(listFront(cl.Approved, "eval_fix")) > 0 {
+		m, _ := module(cl.Snapshot, c.Module)
+		for _, ch := range changes {
+			if ch.Path == c.Path {
+				continue
+			}
+			rel := strings.TrimPrefix(ch.Path, m.Dir+"/")
+			zone := contracts.ResolveZone(rel, m.Zones)
+			if cl.Phase == "impl" || zone != "evals" {
+				return fmt.Errorf("Z01: eval_fix forbids edit to %s", ch.Path)
+			}
+		}
+	}
+	return nil
+}
+func validateBeforeHooks(root string, c project.Change, cl claim) error {
+	if cl.Phase != "evals" && cl.Phase != "impl" && cl.Phase != "audit" {
+		return coded("P01", "unsupported phase %s", cl.Phase)
+	}
+	if head(root) != cl.Base {
+		return coded("P05", "stale phase base: HEAD changed from %s to %s", cl.Base, head(root))
+	}
+	if e := sameApproved(cl.Approved, c.Document, cl.Phase); e != nil {
+		return e
+	}
+	if e := checkStale(root, c); e != nil {
+		return e
+	}
+	return validateZone(root, c, cl)
+}
+func selectDependents(s project.Snapshot, target, mode string) []string {
+	out := []string{}
+	if mode == "none" {
+		return out
+	}
+	for _, m := range s.Modules {
+		if m.Name == target {
+			continue
+		}
+		direct := false
+		for _, d := range m.DependsOn {
+			if d == target {
+				direct = true
+			}
+		}
+		if direct || (mode == "all" && dependency(s.Modules, m.Name, target, map[string]bool{})) {
+			out = append(out, m.Name)
+		}
+	}
+	sort.Strings(out)
+	return out
+}
+func evaluate(ctx context.Context, req model.Request, c project.Change, cl claim, oid string) (model.Result, error) {
+	result := model.Result{State: state(cl.Owner, c, cl, oid), Reports: map[string]checks.Report{}}
+	if e := validateBeforeHooks(cl.Owner, c, cl); e != nil {
+		return result, e
+	}
+	if cl.Phase == "audit" {
+		_, e := auditSubmission(c, cl)
+		return result, e
+	}
+	names := []string{c.Module}
+	if cl.Phase == "impl" && !req.Quick {
+		mode := frontConfig(cl.Snapshot, "verify_dependents", "direct")
+		names = append(names, selectDependents(cl.Snapshot, c.Module, mode)...)
+	}
+	var firstErr error
+	for _, name := range names {
+		report, e := checks.Evaluate(ctx, checks.HookRequest{Snapshot: cl.Snapshot, Module: name, Bin: req.Bin, Timeout: req.Timeout})
+		result.Reports[name] = report
+		_ = retainReport(cl.Owner,cl.Run,cl.Phase,name,report)
+		m, _ := module(cl.Snapshot, name)
+		specs := activeSpecs(moduleSpecs(m))
+		if name == c.Module {
+			if ce := checks.RequireCoverage(report, specs); ce != nil && firstErr == nil {
+				firstErr = ce
+			}
+			if cl.Phase == "evals" {
+				if len(listFront(c.Document, "eval_fix")) > 0 {
+					if ce := checks.RequirePass(report, specs); ce != nil && firstErr == nil {
+						firstErr = ce
+					}
+					for _, id := range listFront(c.Document, "eval_fix") {
+						found := false
+						for _, tc := range report.Cases {
+							for _, ref := range tc.IDs {
+								if ref == id {
+									found = true
+								}
+							}
+						}
+						if !found && firstErr == nil {
+							firstErr = fmt.Errorf("E01: eval_fix ID %s lacks testcase", id)
+						}
+					}
+				} else if ce := checks.RequireFailFirst(report, targetIDs(c), listFront(c.Document, "already_satisfied")); ce != nil && firstErr == nil {
+					firstErr = ce
+				}
+			} else if ce := checks.RequirePass(report, specs); ce != nil && firstErr == nil {
+				firstErr = ce
+			}
+		} else {
+			if ce := checks.RequirePass(report, specs); ce != nil && firstErr == nil {
+				firstErr = ce
+			}
+		}
+		if e != nil && firstErr == nil && !(cl.Phase == "evals" && len(listFront(c.Document, "eval_fix")) == 0 && len(report.Cases) > 0) {
+			firstErr = e
+		}
+	}
+	costs := make([]model.ModuleCost, 0, len(names))
+	for _, name := range names {
+		m, _ := module(cl.Snapshot, name)
+		costs = append(costs, measureModule(cl.Owner, m, result.Reports[name]))
+	}
+	result.Costs = costs
+	ds := budgetWarnings(cl.Snapshot, costs)
+	result.Diagnostics = append(result.Diagnostics, ds...)
+	_ = saveCosts(cl.Owner, model.CostSnapshot{Run: cl.Run, Phase: cl.Phase, RecordedAt: nowUTC(), Modules: costs, Diagnostics: ds})
+	if cl.Phase == "impl" && !req.Quick {
+		d, e := checks.Boundaries(ctx, checks.BoundaryRequest{Snapshot: cl.Snapshot, Bin: req.Bin, Timeout: req.Timeout})
+		result.Diagnostics = append(result.Diagnostics, d...)
+		if e != nil && firstErr == nil {
+			firstErr = e
+		}
+		if de := diagnosticsError(d); de != nil && firstErr == nil {
+			firstErr = de
+		}
+	}
+	return result, firstErr
+}
+func retainReport(root,run,phase,name string,report checks.Report) error {dir:=filepath.Join(root,".fireweed/runs",run,phase);if e:=os.MkdirAll(dir,0755);e!=nil{return e};b,e:=json.MarshalIndent(report,"","  ");if e!=nil{return e};if e=os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(dir,name+".json"),b,0644);e!=nil{return e};return os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(dir,name+".output.txt"),[]byte(report.Stdout+"\n"+report.Stderr),0644)}
+func Verify(ctx context.Context, req model.Request) (model.Result, error) {
+	c, cl, oid, e := owned(req.Root, req.Change)
+	if e != nil {
+		return model.Result{}, e
+	}
+	return evaluate(ctx, req, c, cl, oid)
+}
+func measureModule(root string, m project.Module, r checks.Report) model.ModuleCost {
+	v := model.ModuleCost{Module: m.Name, CasesPerSpec: map[string]int{}}
+	for _, tc := range r.Cases {
+		v.Seconds += tc.Seconds
+		seen := map[string]bool{}
+		for _, id := range tc.IDs {
+			if !seen[id] {
+				v.CasesPerSpec[id]++
+				seen[id] = true
+			}
+		}
+	}
+	_ = filepath.WalkDir(filepath.Join(root, m.Dir), func(path string, d os.DirEntry, e error) error {
+		if e != nil || d.IsDir() {
+			return nil
+		}
+		info, e := d.Info()
+		if e != nil || !info.Mode().IsRegular() {
+			return nil
+		}
+		rel, _ := filepath.Rel(filepath.Join(root, m.Dir), path)
+		zone := contracts.ResolveZone(filepath.ToSlash(rel), m.Zones)
+		if zone != "evals" && zone != "disposable" {
+			return nil
+		}
+		b, e := os.ReadFile(path)
+		if e != nil {
+			return nil
+		}
+		lines := strings.Count(string(b), "\n")
+		if len(b) > 0 && b[len(b)-1] != '\n' {
+			lines++
+		}
+		if zone == "evals" {
+			v.EvalLines += lines
+		} else {
+			v.DisposableLines += lines
+		}
+		return nil
+	})
+	return v
+}
+func budgetWarnings(s project.Snapshot, costs []model.ModuleCost) []project.Diagnostic {
+	ds := []project.Diagnostic{}
+	timeLimit := 15 * time.Minute
+	if v := cfgString(s, "budgets", "verify_time"); v != "" {
+		if d, e := time.ParseDuration(v); e == nil {
+			timeLimit = d
+		}
+	}
+	cases := cfgInt(s, "budgets", "cases_per_spec", 15)
+	ratio := 4.0
+	if v := cfgString(s, "budgets", "eval_ratio"); v != "" {
+		_, _ = fmt.Sscan(v, &ratio)
+	}
+	total := 0.0
+	for _, c := range costs {
+		total += c.Seconds
+	}
+	if total > timeLimit.Seconds() {
+		ds = append(ds, project.Diagnostic{Code: "B01", Message: fmt.Sprintf("verify seconds %.3f exceeds limit %.3f", total, timeLimit.Seconds()), Warning: true})
+	}
+	for _, c := range costs {
+		for id, n := range c.CasesPerSpec {
+			if n > cases {
+				ds = append(ds, project.Diagnostic{Code: "B02", Message: fmt.Sprintf("%s: %d cases exceeds limit %d", id, n, cases), Warning: true})
+			}
+		}
+		if c.EvalLines > 0 && (c.DisposableLines == 0 || float64(c.EvalLines)/float64(c.DisposableLines) > ratio) {
+			ds = append(ds, project.Diagnostic{Code: "B03", Message: fmt.Sprintf("%s: eval/disposable ratio %d/%d exceeds limit %g", c.Module, c.EvalLines, c.DisposableLines, ratio), Warning: true})
+		}
+	}
+	return ds
+}
+func saveCosts(root string, s model.CostSnapshot) error {
+	p := filepath.Join(root, ".fireweed/runs", s.Run, s.Phase, "costs.json")
+	if e := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(p), 0755); e != nil {
+		return e
+	}
+	b, e := json.MarshalIndent(s, "", "  ")
+	if e != nil {
+		return e
+	}
+	return os.WriteFile(p, b, 0644)
+}
+func Costs(root string) ([]model.CostSnapshot, error) {
+	info, e := rootInfo(root)
+	if e != nil {
+		return nil, e
+	}
+	out := []model.CostSnapshot{}
+	_ = filepath.WalkDir(filepath.Join(info.Root, ".fireweed/runs"), func(p string, d os.DirEntry, e error) error {
+		if e != nil {
+			return nil
+		}
+		if d.IsDir() || d.Name() != "costs.json" {
+			return nil
+		}
+		b, e := os.ReadFile(p)
+		if e != nil {
+			return nil
+		}
+		var s model.CostSnapshot
+		if json.Unmarshal(b, &s) == nil {
+			out = append(out, s)
+		}
+		return nil
+	})
+	sort.Slice(out, func(i, j int) bool { return out[i].RecordedAt.Before(out[j].RecordedAt) })
+	return out, nil
+}

+None identified in the retained inputs.

+## Gaps
+
+- FLOW-073, workflow: `StartFromAttempt` checks preceding queued entries, but its resume eligibility logic does not fully recompute all projected waiting rules for the blocked change.
+- FLOW-089, workflow: `Abandon` uses sequential Git reverts. A conflicting intervening commit can leave an in-progress revert that needs manual resolution.

+package lifecycle
+
+import (
+	"fmt"
+	"os"
+	"os/exec"
+	"path/filepath"
+	"strings"
+
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/contracts"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/gitstore"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/workflow/model"
+)
+
+func attemptCommit(root, base string) (string, error) {
+	tmp, e := os.CreateTemp("", "fireweed-index-*")
+	if e != nil {
+		return "", e
+	}
+	name := tmp.Name()
+	_ = tmp.Close()
+	defer os.Remove(name)
+	_ = os.Remove(name)
+	run := func(args ...string) (string, error) {
+		c := exec.Command("git", args...)
+		c.Dir = root
+		c.Env = append(os.Environ(), "GIT_INDEX_FILE="+name, "GIT_AUTHOR_NAME=Fireweed", "GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL=fireweed@local", "GIT_COMMITTER_NAME=Fireweed", "GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL=fireweed@local")
+		b, e := c.CombinedOutput()
+		if e != nil {
+			return "", fmt.Errorf("git %s: %w: %s", strings.Join(args, " "), e, b)
+		}
+		return strings.TrimSpace(string(b)), nil
+	}
+	if _, e = run("read-tree", base); e != nil {
+		return "", e
+	}
+	if _, e = run("add", "-A"); e != nil {
+		return "", e
+	}
+	tree, e := run("write-tree")
+	if e != nil {
+		return "", e
+	}
+	return run("commit-tree", tree, "-p", base, "-m", "fireweed attempt")
+}
+func Block(req model.BlockRequest) (model.BlockResult, error) {
+	c, cl, oid, e := owned(req.Root, req.Change)
+	if e != nil {
+		return model.BlockResult{}, e
+	}
+	if head(cl.Owner) != cl.Base {
+		return model.BlockResult{}, coded("P05", "stale phase base")
+	}
+	if e = sameApproved(cl.Approved, c.Document, cl.Phase); e != nil {
+		return model.BlockResult{}, e
+	}
+	n := nextAttempt(cl.Owner, c.Slug)
+	ref := fmt.Sprintf("refs/fireweed/attempts/%s/%d", c.Slug, n)
+	attempt, e := attemptCommit(cl.Owner, cl.Base)
+	if e != nil {
+		return model.BlockResult{}, e
+	}
+	if e = gitstore.CASRef(cl.Owner, ref, "", attempt); e != nil {
+		return model.BlockResult{}, e
+	}
+	if _, e = runGit(cl.Owner, "reset", "--hard", cl.Base); e != nil {
+		return model.BlockResult{}, e
+	}
+	if _, e = runGit(cl.Owner, "clean", "-fd"); e != nil {
+		return model.BlockResult{}, e
+	}
+	c, e = findPending(cl.Owner, c.Path)
+	if e != nil {
+		return model.BlockResult{}, e
+	}
+	c, e = parseChange(cl.Owner, c)
+	if e != nil {
+		return model.BlockResult{}, e
+	}
+	c.Document = cl.Approved
+	c.Document.Frontmatter["blocked"] = req.Reason
+	if e = renderChange(cl.Owner, c); e != nil {
+		return model.BlockResult{}, e
+	}
+	newHead, e := commitAll(cl.Owner, "fireweed: block "+c.Slug)
+	if e != nil {
+		return model.BlockResult{}, e
+	}
+	if e = gitstore.CASRef(cl.Owner, claimRef(c.Slug), oid, ""); e != nil {
+		return model.BlockResult{}, e
+	}
+	cl.Base = newHead
+	cl.Approved = c.Document
+	s := state(cl.Owner, c, cl, "")
+	return model.BlockResult{State: s, AttemptRef: ref, AttemptOID: attempt}, nil
+}
+func StartFromAttempt(root, selector string, n int) (model.State, error) {
+	info, e := rootInfo(root)
+	if e != nil {
+		return model.State{}, e
+	}
+	c, e := findPending(info.Root, selector)
+	if e != nil {
+		return model.State{}, e
+	}
+	_, attempt, e := resolveAttempt(info.Root, c.Slug, n)
+	if e != nil {
+		return model.State{}, e
+	}
+	d, e := dirty(info.Root)
+	if e != nil { return model.State{}, e }
+	if d { return model.State{}, coded("P01", "start requires clean worktree") }
+	if _, _, held, e := readClaim(info.Root, c.Slug); e != nil { return model.State{}, e } else if held { return model.State{}, coded("P02", "claim already held: update-ref %s", claimRef(c.Slug)) }
+	q, e := queue(info.Root); if e != nil { return model.State{}, e }
+	for _, prior := range q { if prior.Path == c.Path { break }; if frontString(prior.Document,"blocked") == "" { return model.State{}, coded("P01","change is not eligible queue head") } }
+	c,e = parseChange(info.Root,c); if e != nil { return model.State{},e }
+	delete(c.Document.Frontmatter,"blocked")
+	if e=renderChange(info.Root,c); e!=nil { return model.State{},e }
+	snapshot,e:=project.Project(info.Root,c.Slug);if e!=nil { return model.State{},e }
+	cl:=claim{Owner:info.Root,Slug:c.Slug,Path:c.Path,Run:frontString(c.Document,"run"),Phase:frontString(c.Document,"phase"),Base:info.Head,Snapshot:snapshot,Approved:c.Document}
+	oid,e:=saveClaim(info.Root,cl,"");if e!=nil{return model.State{},coded("P02","claim already held: update-ref %v",e)}
+	s:=state(info.Root,c,cl,oid)
+	attemptBase, _ := runGit(info.Root, "rev-parse", attempt+"^")
+	paths := changedPaths(info.Root, attemptBase, attempt)
+	for _, p := range paths {
+		if p == c.Path {
+			saved, e := gitstore.ReadAt(info.Root, attempt, p)
+			if e != nil {
+				continue
+			}
+			d, e := contracts.ParseDocument(string(saved))
+			if e != nil {
+				continue
+			}
+			current := s.Change.Document
+			for _, name := range []string{"Audit", "Questions", "Implementation", "Evals"} {
+				if body, ok := contracts.Section(d.Body, name); ok {
+					current.Body = contracts.ReplaceSection(current.Body, name, body)
+				}
+			}
+			s.Change.Document = current
+			_ = renderChange(info.Root, s.Change)
+			continue
+		}
+		data, e := gitstore.ReadAt(info.Root, attempt, p)
+		if e != nil {
+			_ = os.Remove(filepath.Join(info.Root, p))
+			continue
+		}
+		_ = writeText(info.Root, p, string(data))
+	}
+	return Current(info.Root, c.Slug)
+}

+package lifecycle
+
+import (
+ "context"
+ "encoding/json"
+ "errors"
+ "fmt"
+ "os"
+ "os/exec"
+ "path/filepath"
+ "sort"
+ "strconv"
+ "strings"
+ "time"
+
+ "github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/contracts"
+ "github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/gitstore"
+ "github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/project"
+ "github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/workflow/model"
+)
+
+type claim struct {
+ Owner string
+ Slug string
+ Path string
+ Run string
+ Phase string
+ Base string
+ Snapshot project.Snapshot
+ Approved contracts.Document
+}
+
+func coded(code, format string, args ...any) error { return fmt.Errorf("%s: %s", code, fmt.Sprintf(format,args...)) }
+func rootInfo(root string) (gitstore.Repository,error) { return gitstore.Inspect(root) }
+func runGit(root string, args ...string) (string,error) {
+ c:=exec.Command("git",args...); c.Dir=root
+ b,e:=c.CombinedOutput(); if e!=nil { return "",fmt.Errorf("git %s: %w: %s",strings.Join(args," "),e,strings.TrimSpace(string(b))) }; return strings.TrimSpace(string(b)),nil
+}
+func gitBytes(root string,args ...string) ([]byte,error) { c:=exec.Command("git",args...);c.Dir=root; b,e:=c.Output();return b,e }
+func dirty(root string) (bool,error) { s,e:=runGit(root,"status","--porcelain","--untracked-files=all");return s!="",e }
+func claimRef(slug string) string { return "refs/fireweed/claims/"+slug }
+func readClaim(root,slug string) (claim,string,bool,error) {
+ oid,ok,e:=gitstore.Ref(root,claimRef(slug));if e!=nil||!ok{return claim{},"",ok,e}
+ b,e:=gitstore.ReadBlob(root,oid);if e!=nil{return claim{},"",false,e};var c claim;e=json.Unmarshal(b,&c);return c,oid,true,e
+}
+func saveClaim(root string,c claim,old string) (string,error) { b,e:=json.Marshal(c);if e!=nil{return "",e};oid,e:=gitstore.WriteBlob(root,b);if e!=nil{return "",e};if e=gitstore.CASRef(root,claimRef(c.Slug),old,oid);e!=nil{return "",e};return oid,nil }
+func parseChange(root string,c project.Change) (project.Change,error) { b,e:=os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(root,filepath.FromSlash(c.Path)));if e!=nil{return c,e};d,e:=contracts.ParseDocument(string(b));if e!=nil{return c,e};c.Document=d;for _,part:=range []struct{name string; dst *[]contracts.Item}{{"Added",&c.Added},{"Modified",&c.Modified},{"Removed",&c.Removed}} {s,_:=contracts.Section(d.Body,part.name);*part.dst,e=contracts.ParseItems(s);if e!=nil{return c,e}};return c,nil }
+func queue(root string) ([]project.Change,error) {return project.Queue(root)}
+func findPending(root,selector string) (project.Change,error) {
+ q,e:=queue(root);if e!=nil{return project.Change{},e};return selectChange(q,selector)
+}
+func selectChange(q []project.Change,selector string) (project.Change,error) {
+ var found []project.Change;for _,c:=range q {if selector==c.Slug||selector==c.Path||selector==filepath.Base(c.Path)||selector==strings.TrimSuffix(filepath.Base(c.Path),".md") {found=append(found,c)}}
+ if len(found)==1{return found[0],nil}
+ slugs:=make([]string,0,len(q));for _,c:=range q {slugs=append(slugs,c.Slug)};sort.Strings(slugs)
+ if len(found)>1{return project.Change{},coded("U02","change %q is ambiguous; valid slugs: %s",selector,strings.Join(slugs,", "))}
+ return project.Change{},coded("U02","change %q not found; valid slugs: %s",selector,strings.Join(slugs,", "))
+}
+func frontString(d contracts.Document,key string) string {v:=d.Frontmatter[key];if v==nil{return ""};return fmt.Sprint(v)}
+func frontInt(d contracts.Document,key string) int {v:=d.Frontmatter[key];switch x:=v.(type){case int:return x;case float64:return int(x);case string:n,_:=strconv.Atoi(x);return n};return 0}
+func frontBool(d contracts.Document,key string) bool {return d.Frontmatter[key]==true||frontString(d,key)=="true"}
+func mapAt(m map[string]any,key string) map[string]any {v,_:=m[key].(map[string]any);return v}
+func cfgString(s project.Snapshot,section,key string) string {m:=mapAt(s.Config,section);if v:=m[key];v!=nil{return fmt.Sprint(v)};return ""}
+func cfgInt(s project.Snapshot,section,key string,def int) int {v:=cfgString(s,section,key);if v=="" {return def};n,e:=strconv.Atoi(v);if e!=nil{return def};return n}
+func cfgBool(s project.Snapshot,section,key string,def bool) bool {v:=cfgString(s,section,key);if v==""{return def};return v=="true"}
+func renderChange(root string,c project.Change) error {s,e:=contracts.RenderDocument(c.Document);if e!=nil{return e};return os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(root,filepath.FromSlash(c.Path)),[]byte(s),0644)}
+func state(root string,c project.Change,cl claim,oid string) model.State {return model.State{Change:c,Snapshot:cl.Snapshot,Run:cl.Run,Phase:cl.Phase,PhaseBase:cl.Base,Head:head(root),ClaimOID:oid}}
+func head(root string) string {r,e:=gitstore.Inspect(root);if e!=nil{return ""};return r.Head}
+func owned(root,selector string) (project.Change,claim,string,error) {
+ info,e:=rootInfo(root);if e!=nil{return project.Change{},claim{},"",e}
+ if selector=="" {q,e:=queue(info.Root);if e!=nil{return project.Change{},claim{},"",e};for _,c:=range q {cl,oid,ok,e:=readClaim(info.Root,c.Slug);if e!=nil{return project.Change{},claim{},"",e};if ok&&cl.Owner==info.Root {c,e=parseChange(info.Root,c);return c,cl,oid,e}};return project.Change{},claim{},"",coded("P02","worktree holds no change")}
+ c,e:=findPending(info.Root,selector);if e!=nil{return c,claim{},"",e};cl,oid,ok,e:=readClaim(info.Root,c.Slug);if e!=nil{return c,cl,oid,e};if !ok{return c,cl,"",coded("P02","change has no claim")};if cl.Owner!=info.Root{return c,cl,"",coded("P02","claim belongs to another worktree")};c,e=parseChange(info.Root,c);return c,cl,oid,e
+}
+func Current(root,selector string) (model.State,error) {c,cl,oid,e:=owned(root,selector);if e!=nil{return model.State{},e};return state(cl.Owner,c,cl,oid),nil}
+func Release(root,selector string) error {c,cl,oid,e:=owned(root,selector);if e!=nil{return e};return gitstore.CASRef(cl.Owner,claimRef(c.Slug),oid,"")}
+func section(d contracts.Document,name string) string {s,_:=contracts.Section(d.Body,name);return strings.TrimSpace(s)}
+func sameApproved(a,b contracts.Document,phase string) error {
+ for k,v:=range a.Frontmatter {if k=="phase"||k=="audit_rounds"||k=="blocked"||k=="run" {continue};if fmt.Sprint(v)!=fmt.Sprint(b.Frontmatter[k]) {return coded("P03","unapproved author field %s",k)}}
+ for k:=range b.Frontmatter {if _,ok:=a.Frontmatter[k];!ok&&k!="phase"&&k!="audit_rounds"&&k!="blocked"&&k!="run" {return coded("P03","unapproved author field %s",k)}}
+ for _,name:=range []string{"Motivation","Interface","Added","Modified","Removed","Decisions","Removed decisions","Set"} {if section(a,name)!=section(b,name){return coded("P03","unapproved author section %s",name)}}
+ for _,key:=range []string{"phase","audit_rounds","blocked","run"} {if frontString(a,key)!=frontString(b,key){return coded("P03","unapproved runtime state %s",key)}}
+ if phase!="audit"&&section(a,"Audit")!=section(b,"Audit") {return coded("P03","unapproved audit state")};if section(a,"Provenance")!=section(b,"Provenance") {return coded("P03","unapproved provenance")};return nil
+}
+func checkStale(root string,c project.Change) error {stale,e:=project.StaleSpecs(root,c.Slug);if e!=nil {if strings.Contains(e.Error(),"stale base"){return coded("P05","%v",e)};return e};for _,s:=range stale {if !s.Recovered{return coded("P05","stale base for %s",s.ID)}};return nil}
+func diagnosticsError(ds []project.Diagnostic) error {for _,d:=range ds {if !d.Warning{return fmt.Errorf("%s: %s",d.Code,d.Message)}};return nil}
+func nowUTC() time.Time {return time.Now().UTC()}
+func gitChanges(root,base string) ([]gitstore.Change,error) {return gitstore.Changes(root,base)}
+func writeText(root,path,s string) error {p:=filepath.Join(root,filepath.FromSlash(path));if e:=os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(p),0755);e!=nil{return e};return os.WriteFile(p,[]byte(s),0644)}
+func gitRefList(root,prefix string) ([]string,error) {s,e:=runGit(root,"for-each-ref","--format=%(refname)",prefix);if e!=nil{return nil,e};if s==""{return []string{},nil};return strings.Split(s,"\n"),nil}
+func ignoreMissing(err error) bool {return err==nil||errors.Is(err,os.ErrNotExist)}
+func gitRun(ctx context.Context,root string,args ...string) (string,error) {r,e:=gitstore.Run(ctx,gitstore.Request{Dir:root,Args:args});if e!=nil{return "",e};if r.ExitCode!=0{return r.Stdout,fmt.Errorf("git %s: %s",strings.Join(args," "),r.Stderr)};return r.Stdout,nil}

new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..d2f7f4c35f6f411dc1c99b7e4876864db398d671
--- /dev/null
+++ b/packages/workflow/internal/lifecycle/done.go
@@ -0,0 +1,286 @@
+package lifecycle
+
+import (
+	"context"
+	"crypto/sha256"
+	"encoding/hex"
+	"fmt"
+	"os"
+	"path/filepath"
+	"regexp"
+	"sort"
+	"strings"
+
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/assets"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/checks"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/contracts"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/gitstore"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/project"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/workflow/model"
+)
+
+var findingRE = regexp.MustCompile(`(?m)^\s*-\s*(\[untestable\]\s*)?([A-Z][A-Z0-9]*-[0-9]+):\s*"([^"]+)"[^\n]*`)
+var checkedRE = regexp.MustCompile(`(?mi)^Checked IDs:\s*([^\n]*)`)
+
+func auditSubmission(c project.Change, cl claim) ([]string, error) {
+	body := section(c.Document, "Audit")
+	if body == "" {
+		return nil, coded("P09", "missing audit submission")
+	}
+	m, _ := module(cl.Snapshot, c.Module)
+	specs := map[string]string{}
+	for _, it := range moduleSpecs(m) {
+		specs[it.ID] = it.Body
+	}
+	prior := map[string]bool{}
+	for _, x := range findingRE.FindAllStringSubmatch(section(cl.Approved, "Audit"), -1) {
+		prior[x[2]] = true
+	}
+	kept := []string{}
+	for _, x := range findingRE.FindAllStringSubmatch(body, -1) {
+		if !strings.Contains(specs[x[2]], x[3]) {
+			continue
+		}
+		if frontInt(c.Document, "audit_rounds") > 0 && len(prior) > 0 && !prior[x[2]] {
+			continue
+		}
+		kept = append(kept, strings.TrimSpace(x[0]))
+	}
+	if len(kept) > 0 {
+		return kept, nil
+	}
+	if !strings.Contains(body, "No findings") {
+		return nil, coded("P09", "audit submission needs No findings or valid findings")
+	}
+	match := checkedRE.FindStringSubmatch(body)
+	if len(match) < 2 {
+		return nil, coded("P09", "No findings requires checked IDs")
+	}
+	checked := map[string]bool{}
+	for _, part := range strings.FieldsFunc(match[1], func(r rune) bool { return r == ',' || r == ' ' || r == '\t' }) {
+		checked[part] = true
+	}
+	for _, id := range targetIDs(c) {
+		if !checked[id] {
+			return nil, coded("P09", "No findings missing checked ID %s", id)
+		}
+	}
+	return nil, nil
+}
+func normalizeAudit(c *project.Change, findings []string) {
+	if len(findings) > 0 {
+		c.Document.Body = contracts.ReplaceSection(c.Document.Body, "Audit", strings.Join(findings, "\n")+"\n")
+	} else {
+		body := section(c.Document, "Audit")
+		lines := []string{}
+		for _, line := range strings.Split(body, "\n") {
+			if strings.HasPrefix(strings.TrimSpace(line), "-") {
+				continue
+			}
+			lines = append(lines, line)
+		}
+		c.Document.Body = contracts.ReplaceSection(c.Document.Body, "Audit", strings.Join(lines, "\n")+"\n")
+	}
+}
+func provenance(c *project.Change, req model.Request, phase string, reports map[string]checks.Report) {
+	agent := req.Agent
+	if agent == "" {
+		agent = "manual"
+	}
+	book, _ := assets.Playbook(phase)
+	if phase == "impl" && frontBool(c.Document, "regenerate") {
+		book, _ = assets.Playbook("regenerate")
+	}
+	h := sha256.Sum256([]byte(book))
+	total, passing, failing := 0, 0, 0
+	for _, r := range reports {
+		for _, tc := range r.Cases {
+			total++
+			if tc.Result == "pass" {
+				passing++
+			} else if tc.Result == "fail" || tc.Result == "error" {
+				failing++
+			}
+		}
+	}
+	line := fmt.Sprintf("- %s %s agent=%s fireweed=%s playbook=%s tests=%d failing=%d passing=%d", phase, nowUTC().Format("2006-01-02T15:04:05Z07:00"), agent, assets.Version(), hex.EncodeToString(h[:]), total, failing, passing)
+	old := section(c.Document, "Provenance")
+	if old != "" {
+		old += "\n"
+	}
+	c.Document.Body = contracts.ReplaceSection(c.Document.Body, "Provenance", old+line+"\n")
+}
+func applySpec(root string, c project.Change) error {
+	path := filepath.Join(root, "packages", c.Module, "SPEC.md")
+	for _, m := range mustModules(root) {
+		if m.Name == c.Module {
+			path = filepath.Join(root, m.Dir, "SPEC.md")
+		}
+	}
+	b, e := os.ReadFile(path)
+	if e != nil {
+		return e
+	}
+	doc, e := contracts.ParseDocument(string(b))
+	if e != nil {
+		return e
+	}
+	items, e := contracts.ParseItems(section(doc, "Specs"))
+	if e != nil {
+		return e
+	}
+	byID := map[string]contracts.Item{}
+	order := []string{}
+	for _, it := range items {
+		byID[it.ID] = it
+		order = append(order, it.ID)
+	}
+	for _, it := range c.Removed {
+		delete(byID, it.ID)
+	}
+	for _, it := range c.Modified {
+		byID[it.ID] = it
+	}
+	for _, it := range c.Added {
+		if _, ok := byID[it.ID]; !ok {
+			order = append(order, it.ID)
+		}
+		byID[it.ID] = it
+	}
+	rendered := []string{}
+	for _, id := range order {
+		if it, ok := byID[id]; ok {
+			rendered = append(rendered, strings.TrimSpace(contracts.RenderItem(it)))
+		}
+	}
+	doc.Body = contracts.ReplaceSection(doc.Body, "Specs", strings.Join(rendered, "\n\n")+"\n")
+	if set := mapAt(c.Document.Frontmatter, "set"); set != nil {
+		for k, v := range set {
+			doc.Frontmatter[k] = v
+		}
+	}
+	decisions := section(doc, "Decisions")
+	for _, line := range strings.Split(section(c.Document, "Removed decisions"), "\n") {
+		line = strings.TrimSpace(line)
+		if line != "" {
+			decisions = strings.ReplaceAll(decisions, line, "")
+		}
+	}
+	decisions = strings.TrimSpace(decisions)
+	for _, line := range strings.Split(section(c.Document, "Decisions"), "\n") {
+		line = strings.TrimSpace(line)
+		if line != "" {
+			if decisions != "" {
+				decisions += "\n"
+			}
+			decisions += "- " + c.Slug + ": " + strings.TrimPrefix(line, "- ")
+		}
+	}
+	doc.Body = contracts.ReplaceSection(doc.Body, "Decisions", decisions+"\n")
+	out, e := contracts.RenderDocument(doc)
+	if e != nil {
+		return e
+	}
+	return os.WriteFile(path, []byte(out), 0644)
+}
+func mustModules(root string) []project.Module { s, _ := project.Load(root); return s.Modules }
+func commitAll(root, subject string) (string, error) {
+	_, e := runGit(root, "add", "-A")
+	if e != nil {
+		return "", e
+	}
+	return gitstore.Commit(root, subject, []string{"."})
+}
+func Done(ctx context.Context, req model.Request) (model.Result, error) {
+	c, cl, oid, e := owned(req.Root, req.Change)
+	if e != nil {
+		return model.Result{}, e
+	}
+	req.Quick = false
+	r, e := evaluate(ctx, req, c, cl, oid)
+	if e != nil {
+		return r, e
+	}
+	phase := cl.Phase
+	var findings []string
+	if phase == "audit" {
+		findings, e = auditSubmission(c, cl)
+		if e != nil {
+			return r, e
+		}
+		normalizeAudit(&c, findings)
+	}
+	if phase == "evals" {
+		if cfgBool(cl.Snapshot, "audit", "enabled", true) {
+			c.Document.Frontmatter["phase"] = "audit"
+		} else {
+			c.Document.Frontmatter["phase"] = "impl"
+		}
+	}
+	if phase == "audit" {
+		if len(findings) == 0 {
+			c.Document.Frontmatter["phase"] = "impl"
+		} else {
+			limit := cfgInt(cl.Snapshot, "audit", "max_rounds", 2)
+			if frontInt(c.Document, "audit_rounds") >= limit || strings.Contains(section(c.Document, "Audit"), "[untestable]") {
+				c.Document.Frontmatter["phase"] = "blocked"
+				c.Document.Frontmatter["blocked"] = "audit findings"
+				c.Document.Body = contracts.ReplaceSection(c.Document.Body, "Questions", strings.Join(findings, "\n")+"\n")
+			} else {
+				c.Document.Frontmatter["phase"] = "evals"
+				c.Document.Frontmatter["audit_rounds"] = frontInt(c.Document, "audit_rounds") + 1
+			}
+		}
+	}
+	var previousSpec []byte
+	var specPath string
+	if phase == "impl" {
+		if m, ok := module(cl.Snapshot,c.Module); ok { specPath=filepath.Join(cl.Owner,m.Dir,"SPEC.md"); previousSpec,_=os.ReadFile(specPath) }
+		if e = applySpec(cl.Owner, c); e != nil { return r, e }
+		c.Document.Frontmatter["phase"] = "applied"
+	}
+	provenance(&c, req, phase, r.Reports)
+	if e = renderChange(cl.Owner, c); e != nil {
+		return r, e
+	}
+	if phase == "impl" {
+		archive := filepath.Join(cl.Owner, "changes/archive", filepath.Base(c.Path))
+		if e = os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(archive), 0755); e != nil {
+			return r, e
+		}
+		if e = os.Rename(filepath.Join(cl.Owner, c.Path), archive); e != nil {
+			return r, e
+		}
+		c.Path = filepath.ToSlash(filepath.Join("changes/archive", filepath.Base(c.Path)))
+		if e=diagnosticsError(project.Check(cl.Owner));e!=nil {
+			_ = os.Rename(archive,filepath.Join(cl.Owner,"changes",filepath.Base(c.Path)))
+			_ = renderOriginal(cl.Owner,"changes/"+filepath.Base(c.Path),cl.Approved)
+			if specPath!="" { _ = os.WriteFile(specPath,previousSpec,0644) }
+			return r,e
+		}
+	}
+	newHead, e := commitAll(cl.Owner, fmt.Sprintf("fireweed: %s %s", c.Slug, phase))
+	if e != nil {
+		return r, e
+	}
+	cl.Phase = frontString(c.Document, "phase")
+	cl.Base = newHead
+	cl.Approved = c.Document
+	if cl.Phase == "applied" || cl.Phase == "blocked" {
+		if e = gitstore.CASRef(cl.Owner, claimRef(c.Slug), oid, ""); e != nil {
+			return r, e
+		}
+		r.State = state(cl.Owner, c, cl, "")
+		if cl.Phase == "blocked" {
+			return r, coded("P06", "change blocked: audit findings")
+		}
+		return r, nil
+	}
+	newOID, e := saveClaim(cl.Owner, cl, oid)
+	if e != nil {
+		return r, e
+	}
+	r.State = state(cl.Owner, c, cl, newOID)
+	return r, nil
+}
+func specIDs(c project.Change) []string { ids := targetIDs(c); sort.Strings(ids); return ids }

+package lifecycle
+
+import (
+ "context"
+ "encoding/json"
+ "os"
+ "path/filepath"
+ "sort"
+ "strconv"
+ "strings"
+ "time"
+
+ "github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/gitstore"
+ "github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/project"
+ "github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/workflow/model"
+)
+
+func GC(ctx context.Context,req model.GCRequest) (model.GCResult,error) {info,e:=rootInfo(req.Root);if e!=nil{return model.GCResult{},e};snap,e:=project.Load(info.Root);if e!=nil{return model.GCResult{},e};maxAge:=720*time.Hour;if v:=cfgString(snap,"gc","drill_max_age");v!=""{maxAge,e=time.ParseDuration(v);if e!=nil||maxAge<=0{return model.GCResult{},coded("C01","invalid gc.drill_max_age %q",v)}};now:=req.Now;if now.IsZero(){now=nowUTC()};refs,e:=gitRefList(info.Root,"refs/fireweed");if e!=nil{return model.GCResult{},e};registered:=map[string]bool{};list,_:=runGit(info.Root,"worktree","list","--porcelain");for _,line:=range strings.Split(list,"\n") {if strings.HasPrefix(line,"worktree "){p:=strings.TrimPrefix(line,"worktree ");if resolved,e:=filepath.EvalSymlinks(p);e==nil {registered[resolved]=true}}};archives:=map[string]bool{};for _,c:=range archiveChanges(info.Root){archives[c.Slug]=true};deleted:=[]string{};for _,ref:=range refs {prune:=false;parts:=strings.Split(ref,"/");if len(parts)<4{continue};switch parts[2] {case "claims":oid,ok,_:=gitstore.Ref(info.Root,ref);if !ok{continue};b,e:=gitstore.ReadBlob(info.Root,oid);if e!=nil{continue};var payload map[string]any;if json.Unmarshal(b,&payload)!=nil{continue};owner,_:=payload["worktree"].(string);if owner==""{owner,_=payload["Owner"].(string)};if resolved,e:=filepath.EvalSymlinks(owner);e==nil{owner=resolved};if _,e:=os.Stat(owner);e!=nil||!registered[owner]{prune=true};case "attempts":if len(parts)==5&&archives[parts[3]]{if n,e:=strconv.Atoi(parts[4]);e==nil&&n>0{prune=true}};case "drills":if len(parts)==5 {t,e:=time.Parse("20060102T150405.000000000",parts[4]);if e==nil&&t.Before(now.Add(-maxAge)){prune=true}}};if prune {oid,ok,e:=gitstore.Ref(info.Root,ref);if e==nil&&ok {if e=gitstore.CASRef(info.Root,ref,oid,"");e==nil{deleted=append(deleted,ref)}}}};sort.Strings(deleted);return model.GCResult{Pruned:deleted},nil}

+++ b/packages/workflow/internal/lifecycle/history.go
@@ -0,0 +1,22 @@
+package lifecycle
+
+import (
+ "fmt"
+ "os"
+ "path/filepath"
+ "sort"
+ "strings"
+
+ "github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/contracts"
+ "github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/gitstore"
+ "github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/project"
+)
+
+func allChanges(root string) ([]project.Change,error) {q,e:=queue(root);if e!=nil{return nil,e};return append(q,archiveChanges(root)...),nil}
+func selectedAny(root,selector string) (project.Change,error) {all,e:=allChanges(root);if e!=nil{return project.Change{},e};return selectChange(all,selector)}
+func phaseAt(root,revision,path string) string {b,e:=gitstore.ReadAt(root,revision,path);if e!=nil{return ""};d,e:=contracts.ParseDocument(string(b));if e!=nil{return ""};return frontString(d,"phase")}
+func Commits(root,selector string) ([]string,error) {info,e:=rootInfo(root);if e!=nil{return nil,e};c,e:=selectedAny(info.Root,selector);if e!=nil{return nil,e};names:=[]string{"changes/"+filepath.Base(c.Path),"changes/archive/"+filepath.Base(c.Path)};list,e:=runGit(info.Root,"rev-list","HEAD");if e!=nil{return nil,e};out:=[]string{};for _,oid:=range strings.Fields(list) {parent,_:=runGit(info.Root,"rev-parse",oid+"^");newPhase,oldPhase:="","";for _,p:=range names {if x:=phaseAt(info.Root,oid,p);x!="" {newPhase=x};if parent!="" {if x:=phaseAt(info.Root,parent,p);x!="" {oldPhase=x}}};if newPhase!=""&&newPhase!=oldPhase{out=append(out,oid)}};return out,nil}
+func Abandon(root,selector string) (string,error) {info,e:=rootInfo(root);if e!=nil{return "",e};c,e:=selectedAny(info.Root,selector);if e!=nil{return "",e};if strings.HasPrefix(c.Path,"changes/archive/")&&frontString(c.Document,"phase")=="applied" {return "",coded("P01","cannot abandon applied change")};d,e:=dirty(info.Root);if e!=nil{return "",e};if d{return "",coded("P01","abandon requires clean worktree")};cl,oid,exists,e:=readClaim(info.Root,c.Slug);if e!=nil{return "",e};if exists&&cl.Owner!=info.Root{return "",coded("P02","claim belongs to another worktree")};commits,e:=Commits(info.Root,c.Path);if e!=nil{return "",e};for _,commit:=range commits {if _,e=runGit(info.Root,"revert","--no-commit",commit);e!=nil{return "",e}};if e=os.Remove(filepath.Join(info.Root,filepath.FromSlash(c.Path)));e!=nil{return "",e};newHead,e:=commitAll(info.Root,"fireweed: abandon "+c.Slug);if e!=nil{return "",e};if exists {if e=gitstore.CASRef(info.Root,claimRef(c.Slug),oid,"");e!=nil{return "",e}};return newHead,nil}
+func resolveAttempt(root,slug string,n int) (string,string,error) {if n<=0{return "","",coded("P01","attempt must be positive")};name:=fmt.Sprintf("refs/fireweed/attempts/%s/%d",slug,n);oid,ok,e:=gitstore.Ref(root,name);if e!=nil{return "","",e};if !ok{return "","",coded("P01","attempt %d missing",n)};return name,oid,nil}
+func nextAttempt(root,slug string) int {for n:=1;;n++ {_,ok,_:=gitstore.Ref(root,fmt.Sprintf("refs/fireweed/attempts/%s/%d",slug,n));if !ok{return n}}}
+func changedPaths(root,from,to string) []string {s,_:=runGit(root,"diff","--name-only",from,to);out:=strings.Fields(s);sort.Strings(out);return out}
diff --git a/packages/workflow/internal/lifecycle/prbody.go b/packages/workflow/internal/lifecycle/prbody.go
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..1dd4065a00f13885ced0d4ecd6a9d2d26e535ab8
--- /dev/null
+++ b/packages/workflow/internal/lifecycle/prbody.go
@@ -0,0 +1,216 @@
+package lifecycle
+
+import (
+	"errors"
+	"fmt"
+	"path/filepath"
+	"sort"
+	"strings"
+
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/contracts"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/gitstore"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/project"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/workflow/model"
+)
+
+type endpointConfigError struct{ cause error }
+
+func (e endpointConfigError) Error() string { return e.cause.Error() }
+func (e endpointConfigError) Unwrap() error { return e.cause }
+func IsEndpointConfigError(err error) bool {
+	var target endpointConfigError
+	return errors.As(err, &target)
+}
+func endpointChanges(root, rev string) []project.Change {
+	out := []project.Change{}
+	s, e := runGit(root, "ls-tree", "-r", "--name-only", rev, "changes")
+	if e != nil {
+		return out
+	}
+	for _, p := range strings.Fields(s) {
+		if !strings.HasSuffix(p, ".md") || !(strings.HasPrefix(p, "changes/archive/") || strings.Count(p, "/") == 1) {
+			continue
+		}
+		b, e := gitstore.ReadAt(root, rev, p)
+		if e != nil {
+			continue
+		}
+		d, e := contracts.ParseDocument(string(b))
+		if e != nil {
+			continue
+		}
+		out = append(out, project.Change{Path: p, Slug: strings.TrimPrefix(strings.TrimSuffix(filepath.Base(p), ".md"), numberPrefix(filepath.Base(p))), Module: frontString(d, "module"), Document: d})
+	}
+	return out
+}
+func PRBody(root, revisionRange string) (model.PRBodyReport, error) {
+	info, e := rootInfo(root)
+	if e != nil {
+		return model.PRBodyReport{}, e
+	}
+	parts := strings.Split(revisionRange, "..")
+	if len(parts) != 2 || parts[0] == "" || parts[1] == "" {
+		return model.PRBodyReport{}, coded("P01", "invalid range %q", revisionRange)
+	}
+	start, e := runGit(info.Root, "rev-parse", "--verify", parts[0]+"^{commit}")
+	if e != nil {
+		return model.PRBodyReport{}, coded("P01", "resolve %q: %v", revisionRange, e)
+	}
+	end, e := runGit(info.Root, "rev-parse", "--verify", parts[1]+"^{commit}")
+	if e != nil {
+		return model.PRBodyReport{}, coded("P01", "resolve %q: %v", revisionRange, e)
+	}
+	snap, e := project.LoadAt(info.Root, end)
+	if e != nil {
+		return model.PRBodyReport{}, endpointConfigError{e}
+	}
+	changed, _ := runGit(info.Root, "diff", "--name-only", start, end)
+	touched := map[string]bool{}
+	for _, p := range strings.Fields(changed) {
+		if strings.HasPrefix(p, "changes/") && strings.HasSuffix(p, ".md") {
+			touched[filepath.Base(p)] = true
+		}
+	}
+	selected := []project.Change{}
+	for _, c := range endpointChanges(info.Root, end) {
+		if touched[filepath.Base(c.Path)] {
+			selected = append(selected, c)
+		}
+	}
+	sort.Slice(selected, func(i, j int) bool { return selected[i].Path < selected[j].Path })
+	var b strings.Builder
+	fmt.Fprintf(&b, "# PR range\n\n%s..%s\n\n## Changes\n", start, end)
+	if len(selected) == 0 {
+		b.WriteString("None selected.\n")
+	}
+	for _, c := range selected {
+		kind := "spec"
+		if len(listFront(c.Document, "eval_fix")) > 0 {
+			kind = "eval_fix"
+		} else if frontBool(c.Document, "regenerate") {
+			kind = "regenerate"
+		} else if section(c.Document, "Added") == "" && section(c.Document, "Modified") == "" && section(c.Document, "Removed") == "" {
+			kind = "maintenance"
+		}
+		fmt.Fprintf(&b, "\n### %s\n\nmodule: %s; kind: %s; audit_rounds: %d\n", c.Path, c.Module, kind, frontInt(c.Document, "audit_rounds"))
+		fmt.Fprintf(&b, "\nProvenance: %s\n", section(c.Document, "Provenance"))
+		fmt.Fprintf(&b, "\nDecisions added: %s\nDecisions removed: %s\n", section(c.Document, "Decisions"), section(c.Document, "Removed decisions"))
+		for _, name := range []string{"Added", "Modified"} {
+			items, _ := contracts.ParseItems(section(c.Document, name))
+			for _, it := range items {
+				if strings.Contains(it.Tag, "review") {
+					fmt.Fprintf(&b, "\n%s %s\n", it.ID, it.Body)
+				}
+			}
+		}
+		history, _ := runGit(info.Root, "rev-list", end)
+		for _, oid := range strings.Fields(history) {
+			for _, p := range []string{"changes/" + filepath.Base(c.Path), "changes/archive/" + filepath.Base(c.Path)} {
+				data, e := gitstore.ReadAt(info.Root, oid, p)
+				if e != nil {
+					continue
+				}
+				d, e := contracts.ParseDocument(string(data))
+				if e != nil {
+					continue
+				}
+				audit := section(d, "Audit")
+				if strings.Contains(audit, "FINDING") || strings.Contains(audit, "untestable") {
+					fmt.Fprintf(&b, "\nAudit finding: %s\n", audit)
+				}
+				break
+			}
+		}
+		contextBase:=start
+		log,_:=runGit(info.Root,"rev-list","--reverse",end)
+		for _,oid:=range strings.Fields(log) {parent,_:=runGit(info.Root,"rev-parse",oid+"^");if parent==""{continue};before,after:="","";for _,path:=range []string{"changes/"+filepath.Base(c.Path),"changes/archive/"+filepath.Base(c.Path)} {if p:=phaseAt(info.Root,parent,path);p!=""{before=p};if p:=phaseAt(info.Root,oid,path);p!=""{after=p}};if after!=""&&after!=before {contextBase=parent;break}}
+		files, _ := runGit(info.Root, "diff", "--name-only", contextBase, end)
+		for _, p := range strings.Fields(files) {
+			if strings.HasPrefix(p, "packages/"+c.Module+"/") || strings.HasSuffix(p, ".lock") {
+				fmt.Fprintf(&b, "\nFile: %s\n", p)
+			}
+		}
+	}
+	b.WriteString("\n## Exceptions\n")
+	for _, m := range snap.Modules {
+		for _, it := range moduleSpecs(m) {
+			if x := quarantineRE.FindStringSubmatch(it.Tag); len(x) > 1 {
+				fmt.Fprintf(&b, "\nQuarantine %s %s: %s\n", m.Name, it.ID, strings.TrimSpace(x[1]))
+			}
+		}
+		if reason := frontString(m.Document, "boundaries_opt_out"); reason != "" {
+			fmt.Fprintf(&b, "\nBoundary opt-out %s: %s\n", m.Name, reason)
+		}
+	}
+	for _, c := range endpointChanges(info.Root, end) {
+		if !strings.Contains(c.Path, "archive/") && frontString(c.Document, "blocked") != "" {
+			fmt.Fprintf(&b, "\nBlocked %s: %s\n", c.Path, frontString(c.Document, "blocked"))
+		}
+	}
+	diagnostics := []project.Diagnostic{}
+	costs, _ := Costs(info.Root)
+	latest := map[string]model.ModuleCost{}
+	times := map[string]int64{}
+	saved := map[string][]project.Diagnostic{}
+	for _, s := range costs {
+		for _, c := range s.Modules {
+			if s.RecordedAt.UnixNano() >= times[c.Module] {
+				latest[c.Module] = c
+				times[c.Module] = s.RecordedAt.UnixNano()
+				saved[c.Module] = s.Diagnostics
+			}
+		}
+	}
+	b.WriteString("\n## Costs\n\n| Module | Seconds | Cases per spec | Eval lines | Disposable lines |\n|---|---:|---|---:|---:|\n")
+	names := []string{}
+	for name := range latest {
+		names = append(names, name)
+	}
+	sort.Strings(names)
+	seen := map[string]bool{}
+	for _, name := range names {
+		c := latest[name]
+		ids := []string{}
+		for id := range c.CasesPerSpec {
+			ids = append(ids, id)
+		}
+		sort.Strings(ids)
+		counts := []string{}
+		for _, id := range ids {
+			counts = append(counts, fmt.Sprintf("%s: %d", id, c.CasesPerSpec[id]))
+		}
+		fmt.Fprintf(&b, "| %s | %g | %s | %d | %d |\n", name, c.Seconds, strings.Join(counts, ", "), c.EvalLines, c.DisposableLines)
+		for _, d := range saved[name] {
+			key := d.Code + d.Message
+			if !seen[key] {
+				diagnostics = append(diagnostics, d)
+				fmt.Fprintf(&b, "\n%s: %s\n", d.Code, d.Message)
+				seen[key] = true
+			}
+		}
+	}
+	additions, _ := runGit(info.Root, "diff", "--name-only", "--diff-filter=A", start, end)
+	for _, p := range strings.Fields(additions) {
+		for _, m := range snap.Modules {
+			if !strings.HasPrefix(p, m.Dir+"/") {
+				continue
+			}
+			rel := strings.TrimPrefix(p, m.Dir+"/")
+			if contracts.ResolveZone(rel, m.Zones) != "disposable" {
+				continue
+			}
+			data, e := gitstore.ReadAt(info.Root, end, p)
+			if e != nil {
+				continue
+			}
+			numstat,_:=runGit(info.Root,"diff","--numstat",start,end,"--",p)
+			binary:=strings.HasPrefix(numstat,"-\t-\t")
+			if len(data) > 262144 || binary {
+				d := project.Diagnostic{Code: "B04", Message: fmt.Sprintf("%s %d bytes", p, len(data)), Warning: true}
+				diagnostics = append(diagnostics, d)
+				fmt.Fprintf(&b, "\nB04: %s\n", d.Message)
+			}
+		}
+	}
+	return model.PRBodyReport{Body: b.String(), Diagnostics: diagnostics}, nil
+}

+func Context(root,selector string,full bool) (string,error) {c,cl,_,e:=owned(root,selector);if e!=nil{return "",e};m,ok:=module(cl.Snapshot,c.Module);if !ok{return "",fmt.Errorf("module %s missing",c.Module)};name:=cl.Phase;if name=="impl"&&frontBool(c.Document,"regenerate"){name="regenerate"};book,e:=assets.Playbook(name);if e!=nil{return "",e};var b strings.Builder;fmt.Fprintf(&b,"# Change\n%s\n\n# Projected spec\n%s\n\n# SYSTEM\n",c.Document.Body,m.Document.Body);system,_:=os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(cl.Owner,"SYSTEM.md"));b.Write(system);fmt.Fprintf(&b,"\n# Playbook\n%s\n\n# Interface\n",book);_ = filepath.WalkDir(filepath.Join(cl.Owner,m.Dir),func(path string,d os.DirEntry,e error) error {if e!=nil||d.IsDir(){return nil};rel,_:=filepath.Rel(filepath.Join(cl.Owner,m.Dir),path);zone:=contracts.ResolveZone(filepath.ToSlash(rel),m.Zones);if zone!="interface" {return nil};data,_:=os.ReadFile(path);fmt.Fprintf(&b,"\n%s\n%s\n",filepath.ToSlash(filepath.Join(m.Dir,rel)),data);return nil});fmt.Fprintf(&b,"\n# Other files\n");_ = filepath.WalkDir(filepath.Join(cl.Owner,m.Dir),func(path string,d os.DirEntry,e error) error {if e!=nil||d.IsDir(){return nil};rel,_:=filepath.Rel(filepath.Join(cl.Owner,m.Dir),path);zone:=contracts.ResolveZone(filepath.ToSlash(rel),m.Zones);if zone=="interface"||rel=="SPEC.md"{return nil};info,_:=d.Info();if info==nil{return nil};fmt.Fprintf(&b,"%s %d bytes\n",filepath.ToSlash(filepath.Join(m.Dir,rel)),info.Size());if full {data,_:=os.ReadFile(path);b.Write(data);b.WriteString("\n")};return nil});return b.String(),nil}
+var quarantineRE=regexp.MustCompile(`(?i)quarantine:\s*([^\]]+)`)
+func archiveChanges(root string) []project.Change {paths,_:=filepath.Glob(filepath.Join(root,"changes/archive/*.md"));out:=[]project.Change{};for _,p:=range paths {b,e:=os.ReadFile(p);if e!=nil{continue};doc,e:=contracts.ParseDocument(string(b));if e!=nil{continue};rel,_:=filepath.Rel(root,p);out=append(out,project.Change{Slug:strings.TrimPrefix(strings.TrimSuffix(filepath.Base(p),".md"),numberPrefix(filepath.Base(p))),Path:filepath.ToSlash(rel),Module:frontString(doc,"module"),Document:doc})};return out}
+func numberPrefix(s string) string {i:=strings.IndexByte(s,'-');if i<0{return ""};return s[:i+1]}
+func implDate(c project.Change) time.Time {for _,line:=range strings.Split(section(c.Document,"Provenance"),"\n") {f:=strings.Fields(line);if len(f)>=3&&f[0]=="-"&&f[1]=="impl" {t,_:=time.Parse(time.RFC3339Nano,f[2]);return t}};return time.Time{}}
+func Status(root string) (model.StatusReport,error) {info,e:=rootInfo(root);if e!=nil{return model.StatusReport{},e};snap,e:=project.Load(info.Root);if e!=nil{return b,e:=os.ReadFile(p);e==nil {if d,e:=contracts.ParseDocument(string(b));e==nil {reportDate,_=time.Parse(time.RFC3339Nano,frontString(d,"date"))}};n:=0;for _,c:=range archives {if
