	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/project"
	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/workflow/model"
)

func module(s project.Snapshot, name string) (project.Module, bool) {
	for _, m := range s.Modules {
		if m.Name == name {
			return m, true
		}
	}
	return project.Module{}, false
}
func moduleSpecs(m project.Module) []contracts.Item {
	items, _ := contracts.ParseItems(section(m.Document, "Specs"))
	return items
}
func activeSpecs(items []contracts.Item) []contracts.Item {
	out := []contracts.Item{}
	for _, it := range items {
		if !strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(it.Tag), "quarantine") {
			out = append(out, it)
		}
	}
	return out
}
func listFront(d contracts.Document, key string) []string {
	out := []string{}
	switch v := d.Frontmatter[key].(type) {
	case []any:
		for _, x := range v {
			out = append(out, fmt.Sprint(x))
		}
	case []string:
		return v
	case string:
		if v != "" {
			out = append(out, v)
		}
	}
	return out
}
func targetIDs(c project.Change) []string {
	ids := []string{}
	for _, it := range c.Added {
		ids = append(ids, it.ID)
	}
	for _, it := range c.Modified {
		ids = append(ids, it.ID)
	}
	ids = append(ids, listFront(c.Document, "fixes")...)
	ids = append(ids, listFront(c.Document, "eval_fix")...)
	return ids
}
func validateZone(root string, c project.Change, cl claim) error {
	changes, e := gitChanges(root, cl.Base)
	if e != nil {
		return e
	}
	declared := section(cl.Approved, "Interface") != ""
	ds := checks.Zones(checks.ZoneRequest{Snapshot: cl.Snapshot, Module: c.Module, Phase: cl.Phase, ChangePath: c.Path, Base: cl.Base, InterfaceDeclared: declared, Changes: changes})
	if e = diagnosticsError(ds); e != nil {
		return e
	}
	if len(listFront(cl.Approved, "eval_fix")) > 0 {
		m, _ := module(cl.Snapshot, c.Module)
		for _, ch := range changes {
			if ch.Path == c.Path {
				continue
			}
			rel := strings.TrimPrefix(ch.Path, m.Dir+"/")
			zone := contracts.ResolveZone(rel, m.Zones)
			if cl.Phase == "impl" || zone != "evals" {
				return fmt.Errorf("Z01: eval_fix forbids edit to %s", ch.Path)
			}
		}
	}
	return nil
}
func validateBeforeHooks(root string, c project.Change, cl claim) error {
	if cl.Phase != "evals" && cl.Phase != "impl" && cl.Phase != "audit" {
		return coded("P01", "unsupported phase %s", cl.Phase)
	}
	if head(root) != cl.Base {
		return coded("P05", "stale phase base: HEAD changed from %s to %s", cl.Base, head(root))
	}
	if e := sameApproved(cl.Approved, c.Document, cl.Phase); e != nil {
		return e
	}
	if e := checkStale(root, c); e != nil {
		return e
	}
	return validateZone(root, c, cl)
}
func selectDependents(s project.Snapshot, target, mode string) []string {
	out := []string{}
	if mode == "none" {
		return out
	}
	for _, m := range s.Modules {
		if m.Name == target {
			continue
		}
		direct := false
		for _, d := range m.DependsOn {
			if d == target {
				direct = true
			}
		}
		if direct || (mode == "all" && dependency(s.Modules, m.Name, target, map[string]bool{})) {
			out = append(out, m.Name)
		}
	}
	sort.Strings(out)
	return out
}
func evaluate(ctx context.Context, req model.Request, c project.Change, cl claim, oid string) (model.Result, error) {
	result := model.Result{State: state(cl.Owner, c, cl, oid), Reports: map[string]checks.Report{}}
	if e := validateBeforeHooks(cl.Owner, c, cl); e != nil {
		return result, e
	}
	if cl.Phase == "audit" {
		_, e := auditSubmission(c, cl)
		return result, e
	}
	names := []string{c.Module}
	if cl.Phase == "impl" && !req.Quick {
		mode := frontConfig(cl.Snapshot, "verify_dependents", "direct")
		names = append(names, selectDependents(cl.Snapshot, c.Module, mode)...)
	}
	var firstErr error
	for _, name := range names {
		report, e := checks.Evaluate(ctx, checks.HookRequest{Snapshot: cl.Snapshot, Module: name, Bin: req.Bin, Timeout: req.Timeout})
		result.Reports[name] = report
		_ = retainReport(cl.Owner, cl.Run, cl.Phase, name, report)
		m, _ := module(cl.Snapshot, name)
		specs := activeSpecs(moduleSpecs(m))
		if name == c.Module {
			if ce := checks.RequireCoverage(report, specs); ce != nil && firstErr == nil {
				firstErr = ce
			}
			if cl.Phase == "evals" {
				if len(listFront(c.Document, "eval_fix")) > 0 {
					if ce := checks.RequirePass(report, specs); ce != nil && firstErr == nil {
						firstErr = ce
					}
					for _, id := range listFront(c.Document, "eval_fix") {
						found := false
						for _, tc := range report.Cases {
							for _, ref := range tc.IDs {
								if ref == id {
									found = true
								}
							}
						}
						if !found && firstErr == nil {
							firstErr = fmt.Errorf("E01: eval_fix ID %s lacks testcase", id)
						}
					}
				} else if ce := checks.RequireFailFirst(report, targetIDs(c), listFront(c.Document, "already_satisfied")); ce != nil && firstErr == nil {
					firstErr = ce
				}
			} else if ce := checks.RequirePass(report, specs); ce != nil && firstErr == nil {
				firstErr = ce
			}
		} else {
			if ce := checks.RequirePass(report, specs); ce != nil && firstErr == nil {
				firstErr = ce
			}
		}
		if e != nil && firstErr == nil && !(cl.Phase == "evals" && len(listFront(c.Document, "eval_fix")) == 0 && len(report.Cases) > 0) {
			firstErr = e
		}
	}
	costs := make([]model.ModuleCost, 0, len(names))
	for _, name := range names {
		m, _ := module(cl.Snapshot, name)
		costs = append(costs, measureModule(cl.Owner, m, result.Reports[name]))
	}
	result.Costs = costs
	ds := budgetWarnings(cl.Snapshot, costs)
	result.Diagnostics = append(result.Diagnostics, ds...)
	_ = saveCosts(cl.Owner, model.CostSnapshot{Run: cl.Run, Phase: cl.Phase, RecordedAt: nowUTC(), Modules: costs, Diagnostics: ds})
	if cl.Phase == "impl" && !req.Quick {
		d, e := checks.Boundaries(ctx, checks.BoundaryRequest{Snapshot: cl.Snapshot, Bin: req.Bin, Timeout: req.Timeout})
		result.Diagnostics = append(result.Diagnostics, d...)
		if e != nil && firstErr == nil {
			firstErr = e
		}
		if de := diagnosticsError(d); de != nil && firstErr == nil {
			firstErr = de
		}
	}
	return result, firstErr
}
func retainReport(root, run, phase, name string, report checks.Report) error {
	dir := filepath.Join(root, ".fireweed/runs", run, phase)
	if e := os.MkdirAll(dir, 0755); e != nil {
		return e
	}
	b, e := json.MarshalIndent(report, "", "  ")
	if e != nil {
		return e
	}
	if e = os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(dir, name+".json"), b, 0644); e != nil {
		return e
	}
	return os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(dir, name+".output.txt"), []byte(report.Stdout+"\n"+report.Stderr), 0644)
}
func Verify(ctx context.Context, req model.Request) (model.Result, error) {
	c, cl, oid, e := owned(req.Root, req.Change)
	if e != nil {
		return model.Result{}, e
	}
	return evaluate(ctx, req, c, cl, oid)
}
func measureModule(root string, m project.Module, r checks.Report) model.ModuleCost {
	v := model.ModuleCost{Module: m.Name, CasesPerSpec: map[string]int{}}
	for _, tc := range r.Cases {
		v.Seconds += tc.Seconds
		seen := map[string]bool{}
		for _, id := range tc.IDs {
			if !seen[id] {
				v.CasesPerSpec[id]++
				seen[id] = true
			}
		}
	}
	_ = filepath.WalkDir(filepath.Join(root, m.Dir), func(path string, d os.DirEntry, e error) error {
		if e != nil || d.IsDir() {
			return nil
		}
		info, e := d.Info()
		if e != nil || !info.Mode().IsRegular() {
			return nil
		}
		rel, _ := filepath.Rel(filepath.Join(root, m.Dir), path)
		zone := contracts.ResolveZone(filepath.ToSlash(rel), m.Zones)
		if zone != "evals" && zone != "disposable" {
			return nil
		}
		b, e := os.ReadFile(path)
		if e != nil {
			return nil
		}
		lines := strings.Count(string(b), "\n")
		if len(b) > 0 && b[len(b)-1] != '\n' {
			lines++
		}
		if zone == "evals" {
			v.EvalLines += lines
		} else {
			v.DisposableLines += lines
		}
		return nil
	})
	return v
}
func budgetWarnings(s project.Snapshot, costs []model.ModuleCost) []project.Diagnostic {
	ds := []project.Diagnostic{}
	timeLimit := 15 * time.Minute
	if v := cfgString(s, "budgets", "verify_time"); v != "" {
		if d, e := time.ParseDuration(v); e == nil {
			timeLimit = d
		}
	}
	cases := cfgInt(s, "budgets", "cases_per_spec", 15)
	ratio := 4.0
	if v := cfgString(s, "budgets", "eval_ratio"); v != "" {
		_, _ = fmt.Sscan(v, &ratio)
	}
	total := 0.0
	for _, c := range costs {
		total += c.Seconds
	}
	if total > timeLimit.Seconds() {
		ds = append(ds, project.Diagnostic{Code: "B01", Message: fmt.Sprintf("verify seconds %.3f exceeds limit %.3f", total, timeLimit.Seconds()), Warning: true})
	}
	for _, c := range costs {
		for id, n := range c.CasesPerSpec {
			if n > cases {
				ds = append(ds, project.Diagnostic{Code: "B02", Message: fmt.Sprintf("%s: %d cases exceeds limit %d", id, n, cases), Warning: true})
			}
		}
		if c.EvalLines > 0 && (c.DisposableLines == 0 || float64(c.EvalLines)/float64(c.DisposableLines) > ratio) {
			ds = append(ds, project.Diagnostic{Code: "B03", Message: fmt.Sprintf("%s: eval/disposable ratio %d/%d exceeds limit %g", c.Module, c.EvalLines, c.DisposableLines, ratio), Warning: true})
		}
	}
	return ds
}
func saveCosts(root string, s model.CostSnapshot) error {
	p := filepath.Join(root, ".fireweed/runs", s.Run, s.Phase, "costs.json")
	if e := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(p), 0755); e != nil {
		return e
	}
	b, e := json.MarshalIndent(s, "", "  ")
	if e != nil {
		return e
	}
	return os.WriteFile(p, b, 0644)
}
func Costs(root string) ([]model.CostSnapshot, error) {
	info, e := rootInfo(root)
	if e != nil {
		return nil, e
	}
	out := []model.CostSnapshot{}
	_ = filepath.WalkDir(filepath.Join(info.Root, ".fireweed/runs"), func(p string, d os.DirEntry, e error) error {
		if e != nil {
			return nil
		}
		if d.IsDir() || d.Name() != "costs.json" {
			return nil
		}
		b, e := os.ReadFile(p)
		if e != nil {
			return nil
		}
		var s model.CostSnapshot
		if json.Unmarshal(b, &s) == nil {
			out = append(out, s)
		}
		return nil
	})
	sort.Slice(out, func(i, j int) bool { return out[i].RecordedAt.Before(out[j].RecordedAt) })
	return out, nil
}

package lifecycle

import (
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"regexp"
	"sort"
	"strings"
	"time"

	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/assets"
	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/contracts"
	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/project"
	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/workflow/model"
)

func Context(root, selector string, full bool) (string, error) {
	c, cl, _, e := owned(root, selector)
	if e != nil {
		return "", e
	}
	m, ok := module(cl.Snapshot, c.Module)
	if !ok {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("module %s missing", c.Module)
	}
	name := cl.Phase
	if name == "impl" && frontBool(c.Document, "regenerate") {
		name = "regenerate"
	}
	book, e := assets.Playbook(name)
	if e != nil {
		return "", e
	}
	var b strings.Builder
	fmt.Fprintf(&b, "# Change\n%s\n\n# Projected spec\n%s\n\n# SYSTEM\n", c.Document.Body, m.Document.Body)
	system, _ := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(cl.Owner, "SYSTEM.md"))
	b.Write(system)
	fmt.Fprintf(&b, "\n# Playbook\n%s\n\n# Interface\n", book)
	_ = filepath.WalkDir(filepath.Join(cl.Owner, m.Dir), func(path string, d os.DirEntry, e error) error {
		if e != nil || d.IsDir() {
			return nil
		}
		rel, _ := filepath.Rel(filepath.Join(cl.Owner, m.Dir), path)
		zone := contracts.ResolveZone(filepath.ToSlash(rel), m.Zones)
		if zone != "interface" {
			return nil
		}
		data, _ := os.ReadFile(path)
		fmt.Fprintf(&b, "\n%s\n%s\n", filepath.ToSlash(filepath.Join(m.Dir, rel)), data)
		return nil
	})
	fmt.Fprintf(&b, "\n# Other files\n")
	_ = filepath.WalkDir(filepath.Join(cl.Owner, m.Dir), func(path string, d os.DirEntry, e error) error {
		if e != nil || d.IsDir() {
			return nil
		}
		rel, _ := filepath.Rel(filepath.Join(cl.Owner, m.Dir), path)
		zone := contracts.ResolveZone(filepath.ToSlash(rel), m.Zones)
		if zone == "interface" || rel == "SPEC.md" {
			return nil
		}
		info, _ := d.Info()
		if info == nil {
			return nil
		}
		fmt.Fprintf(&b, "%s %d bytes\n", filepath.ToSlash(filepath.Join(m.Dir, rel)), info.Size())
		if full {
			data, _ := os.ReadFile(path)
			b.Write(data)
			b.WriteString("\n")
		}
		return nil
	})
	return b.String(), nil
}

var quarantineRE = regexp.MustCompile(`(?i)quarantine:\s*([^\]]+)`)

func archiveChanges(root string) []project.Change {
	paths, _ := filepath.Glob(filepath.Join(root, "changes/archive/*.md"))
	out := []project.Change{}
	for _, p := range paths {
		b, e := os.ReadFile(p)
		if e != nil {
			continue
		}
		doc, e := contracts.ParseDocument(string(b))
		if e != nil {
			continue
		}
		rel, _ := filepath.Rel(root, p)
		out = append(out, project.Change{Slug: strings.TrimPrefix(strings.TrimSuffix(filepath.Base(p), ".md"), numberPrefix(filepath.Base(p))), Path: filepath.ToSlash(rel), Module: frontString(doc, "module"), Document: doc})
	}
	return out
}
func numberPrefix(s string) string {

	r := model.StatusReport{Modules: snap.Modules, Queue: []model.StatusEntry{}, Quarantines: []model.Quarantine{}, BoundaryOptOuts: []model.BoundaryOptOut{}, DriftSinceDrill: map[string]int{}, PhaseCommits: map[string]int{}, Costs: []model.ModuleCost{}}
	for i, c := range q {

		if phase == "" {
			phase = "queued"
		}
		blocked := frontString(c.Document, "blocked")

		if blocked == "" {
			entry.WaitingOn, entry.WaitingRule = waitingFor(info.Root, q, i)

			if x := quarantineRE.FindStringSubmatch(it.Tag); len(x) > 1 {
				r.Quarantines = append(r.Quarantines, model.Quarantine{Module: m.Name, ID: it.ID, Reason: strings.TrimSpace(x[1])})
			}
		}

				reportDate, _ = time.Parse(time.RFC3339Nano, frontString(d, "date"))
			}
		}
		n := 0

			if c.Module == m.Name && frontString(c.Document, "phase") == "applied" && (reportDate.IsZero() || implDate(c).After(reportDate)) {
				n++

		}
		r.DriftSinceDrill[m.Name] = n

	sort.Slice(archives, func(i, j int) bool {
		a, b := implDate(archives[i]), implDate(archives[j])
		if a.Equal(b) {
			return archives[i].Path < archives[j].Path
		}
		return a.After(b)
	})
	if len(archives) >= 3 {
		name := archives[0].Module
		n := 0
		for _, c := range archives {
			if c.Module != name {
				break
			}
			n++
		}
		if n >= 3 {
			r.Diagnostics = append(r.Diagnostics, project.Diagnostic{Code: "P08", Message: fmt.Sprintf("%s has %d consecutive applied changes", name, n), Warning: true})
		}
	}
	baseCount, _, _ := unapprovedCount(info.Root, snap)
	r.Unapproved = baseCount
	for _, c := range archives {
		commits, _ := Commits(info.Root, c.Path)
		r.PhaseCommits[strings.TrimSuffix(filepath.Base(c.Path), ".md")] = len(commits)
	}
	snapshots, _ := Costs(info.Root)
	latest := map[string]model.CostSnapshot{}
	latestCost := map[string]model.ModuleCost{}
	for _, s := range snapshots {
		for _, cost := range s.Modules {
			if old, ok := latest[cost.Module]; !ok || !s.RecordedAt.Before(old.RecordedAt) {
				latest[cost.Module] = s
				latestCost[cost.Module] = cost
			}
		}
	}
	names := []string{}
	for name := range latestCost {
		names = append(names, name)
	}
	sort.Strings(names)
	seen := map[string]bool{}
	for _, name := range names {
		r.Costs = append(r.Costs, latestCost[name])
		for _, d := range latest[name].Diagnostics {
			key := d.Code + "|" + d.Message
			if !seen[key] {
				r.Diagnostics = append(r.Diagnostics, d)
				seen[key] = true
			}
		}
	}
	return r, nil
}
package lifecycle

import (
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"path/filepath"
	"sort"
	"strings"

	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/contracts"
	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/gitstore"
	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/project"
	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/workflow/model"
)

type endpointConfigError struct{ cause error }

func (e endpointConfigError) Error() string { return e.cause.Error() }
func (e endpointConfigError) Unwrap() error { return e.cause }
func IsEndpointConfigError(err error) bool {
	var target endpointConfigError
	return errors.As(err, &target)
}
func endpointChanges(root, rev string) []project.Change {
	out := []project.Change{}
	s, e := runGit(root, "ls-tree", "-r", "--name-only", rev, "changes")
	if e != nil {
		return out
	}
	for _, p := range strings.Fields(s) {
		if !strings.HasSuffix(p, ".md") || !(strings.HasPrefix(p, "changes/archive/") || strings.Count(p, "/") == 1) {
			continue
		}
		b, e := gitstore.ReadAt(root, rev, p)
		if e != nil {
			continue
		}
		d, e := contracts.ParseDocument(string(b))
		if e != nil {
			continue
		}
		out = append(out, project.Change{Path: p, Slug: strings.TrimPrefix(strings.TrimSuffix(filepath.Base(p), ".md"), numberPrefix(filepath.Base(p))), Module: frontString(d, "module"), Document: d})
	}
	return out
}
func PRBody(root, revisionRange string) (model.PRBodyReport, error) {
	info, e := rootInfo(root)
	if e != nil {
		return model.PRBodyReport{}, e
	}
	parts := strings.Split(revisionRange, "..")
	if len(parts) != 2 || parts[0] == "" || parts[1] == "" {
		return model.PRBodyReport{}, coded("P01", "invalid range %q", revisionRange)
	}
	start, e := runGit(info.Root, "rev-parse", "--verify", parts[0]+"^{commit}")
	if e != nil {
		return model.PRBodyReport{}, coded("P01", "resolve %q: %v", revisionRange, e)
	}
	end, e := runGit(info.Root, "rev-parse", "--verify", parts[1]+"^{commit}")
	if e != nil {
		return model.PRBodyReport{}, coded("P01", "resolve %q: %v", revisionRange, e)
	}
	snap, e := project.LoadAt(info.Root, end)
	if e != nil {
		return model.PRBodyReport{}, endpointConfigError{e}
	}
	changed, _ := runGit(info.Root, "log", "--format=", "--name-only", start+".."+end, "--", "changes")
	touched := map[string]bool{}
	for _, p := range strings.Fields(changed) {
		if strings.HasPrefix(p, "changes/") && strings.HasSuffix(p, ".md") {
			touched[filepath.Base(p)] = true
		}
	}
	selected := []project.Change{}
	for _, c := range endpointChanges(info.Root, end) {
		if touched[filepath.Base(c.Path)] {
			selected = append(selected, c)
		}
	}
	sort.Slice(selected, func(i, j int) bool { return selected[i].Path < selected[j].Path })
	var b strings.Builder
	fmt.Fprintf(&b, "# PR range\n\n%s..%s\n\n## Changes\n", start, end)
	if len(selected) == 0 {
		b.WriteString("None selected.\n")
	}
	for _, c := range selected {
		kind := "spec"
		if len(listFront(c.Document, "eval_fix")) > 0 {
			kind = "eval_fix"
		} else if frontBool(c.Document, "regenerate") {
			kind = "regenerate"
		} else if section(c.Document, "Added") == "" && section(c.Document, "Modified") == "" && section(c.Document, "Removed") == "" {
			kind = "maintenance"
		}
		fmt.Fprintf(&b, "\n### %s\n\nmodule: %s; kind: %s; audit_rounds: %d\n", c.Path, c.Module, kind, frontInt(c.Document, "audit_rounds"))
		fmt.Fprintf(&b, "\nProvenance: %s\n", section(c.Document, "Provenance"))
		fmt.Fprintf(&b, "\nDecisions added: %s\nDecisions removed: %s\n", section(c.Document, "Decisions"), section(c.Document, "Removed decisions"))
		for _, name := range []string{"Added", "Modified"} {
			items, _ := contracts.ParseItems(section(c.Document, name))
			for _, it := range items {
				if strings.Contains(it.Tag, "review") {
					fmt.Fprintf(&b, "\n%s %s\n", it.ID, it.Body)
				}
			}
		}
		history, _ := runGit(info.Root, "rev-list", end)
		for _, oid := range strings.Fields(history) {
			for _, p := range []string{"changes/" + filepath.Base(c.Path), "changes/archive/" + filepath.Base(c.Path)} {
				data, e := gitstore.ReadAt(info.Root, oid, p)
				if e != nil {
					continue
				}
				d, e := contracts.ParseDocument(string(data))
				if e != nil {
					continue
				}
				audit := section(d, "Audit")
				if strings.Contains(audit, "FINDING") || strings.Contains(audit, "untestable") {
					fmt.Fprintf(&b, "\nAudit finding: %s\n", audit)
				}
				break
			}
		}
		contextBase := start
		log, _ := runGit(info.Root, "rev-list", "--reverse", end)
		for _, oid := range strings.Fields(log) {
			parent, _ := runGit(info.Root, "rev-parse", oid+"^")
			if parent == "" {
				continue
			}
			before, after := "", ""
			for _, path := range []string{"changes/" + filepath.Base(c.Path), "changes/archive/" + filepath.Base(c.Path)} {
				if p := phaseAt(info.Root, parent, path); p != "" {
					before = p
				}
				if p := phaseAt(info.Root, oid, path); p != "" {
					after = p
				}
			}
			if after != "" && after != before {
				contextBase = parent
				break
			}
		}
		files, _ := runGit(info.Root, "diff", "--name-only", contextBase, end)
		for _, p := range strings.Fields(files) {
			if strings.HasPrefix(p, "packages/"+c.Module+"/") || strings.HasSuffix(p, ".lock") {
				fmt.Fprintf(&b, "\nFile: %s\n", p)
			}
		}
	}
	b.WriteString("\n## Exceptions\n")
	for _, m := range snap.Modules {
		for _, it := range moduleSpecs(m) {
			if x := quarantineRE.FindStringSubmatch(it.Tag); len(x) > 1 {
				fmt.Fprintf(&b, "\nQuarantine %s %s: %s\n", m.Name, it.ID, strings.TrimSpace(x[1]))
			}
		}
		if reason := frontString(m.Document, "boundaries_opt_out"); reason != "" {
			fmt.Fprintf(&b, "\nBoundary opt-out %s: %s\n", m.Name, reason)
		}
	}
	for _, c := range endpointChanges(info.Root, end) {
		if !strings.Contains(c.Path, "archive/") && frontString(c.Document, "blocked") != "" {
			fmt.Fprintf(&b, "\nBlocked %s: %s\n", c.Path, frontString(c.Document, "blocked"))
		}
	}
	diagnostics := []project.Diagnostic{}
	costs, _ := Costs(info.Root)
	latest := map[string]model.ModuleCost{}
	times := map[string]int64{}
	saved := map[string][]project.Diagnostic{}
	for _, s := range costs {
		for _, c := range s.Modules {
			if s.RecordedAt.UnixNano() >= times[c.Module] {
				latest[c.Module] = c
				times[c.Module] = s.RecordedAt.UnixNano()
				saved[c.Module] = s.Diagnostics
			}
		}
	}
	b.WriteString("\n## Costs\n\n| Module | Seconds | Cases per spec | Eval lines | Disposable lines |\n|---|---:|---|---:|---:|\n")
	names := []string{}
	for name := range latest {
		names = append(names, name)
	}
	sort.Strings(names)
	seen := map[string]bool{}
	for _, name := range names {
		c := latest[name]
		ids := []string{}
		for id := range c.CasesPerSpec {
			ids = append(ids, id)
		}
		sort.Strings(ids)
		counts := []string{}
		for _, id := range ids {
			counts = append(counts, fmt.Sprintf("%s: %d", id, c.CasesPerSpec[id]))
		}
		fmt.Fprintf(&b, "| %s | %g | %s | %d | %d |\n", name, c.Seconds, strings.Join(counts, ", "), c.EvalLines, c.DisposableLines)
		for _, d := range saved[name] {
			key := d.Code + d.Message
			if !seen[key] {
				diagnostics = append(diagnostics, d)
				fmt.Fprintf(&b, "\n%s: %s\n", d.Code, d.Message)
				seen[key] = true
			}
		}
	}
	additions, _ := runGit(info.Root, "diff", "--name-only", "--diff-filter=A", start, end)
	for _, p := range strings.Fields(additions) {
		for _, m := range snap.Modules {
			if !strings.HasPrefix(p, m.Dir+"/") {
				continue
			}
			rel := strings.TrimPrefix(p, m.Dir+"/")
			if contracts.ResolveZone(rel, m.Zones) != "disposable" {
				continue
			}
			data, e := gitstore.ReadAt(info.Root, end, p)
			if e != nil {
				continue
			}
			numstat, _ := runGit(info.Root, "diff", "--numstat", start, end, "--", p)
			binary := strings.HasPrefix(numstat, "-\t-\t")
			if len(data) > 262144 || binary {
				d := project.Diagnostic{Code: "B04", Message: fmt.Sprintf("%s %d bytes", p, len(data)), Warning: true}
				diagnostics = append(diagnostics, d)
				fmt.Fprintf(&b, "\nB04: %s\n", d.Message)
			}
		}
	}
	return model.PRBodyReport{Body: b.String(), Diagnostics: diagnostics}, nil
}
package lifecycle

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"sort"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
	"time"

	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/gitstore"
	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/project"
	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/workflow/model"
)

func GC(ctx context.Context, req model.GCRequest) (model.GCResult, error) {
	info, e := rootInfo(req.Root)
	if e != nil {
		return model.GCResult{}, e
	}
	snap, e := project.Load(info.Root)
	if e != nil {
		return model.GCResult{}, e
	}
	maxAge := 720 * time.Hour
	if v := cfgString(snap, "gc", "drill_max_age"); v != "" {
		maxAge, e = time.ParseDuration(v)
		if e != nil || maxAge <= 0 {
			return model.GCResult{}, coded("C01", "invalid gc.drill_max_age %q", v)
		}
	}
	now := req.Now
	if now.IsZero() {
		now = nowUTC()
	}
	refs, e := gitRefList(info.Root, "refs/fireweed")
	if e != nil {
		return model.GCResult{}, e
	}
	registered := map[string]bool{}
	list, _ := runGit(info.Root, "worktree", "list", "--porcelain")
	for _, line := range strings.Split(list, "\n") {
		if strings.HasPrefix(line, "worktree ") {
			p := strings.TrimPrefix(line, "worktree ")
			if resolved, e := filepath.EvalSymlinks(p); e == nil {
				registered[resolved] = true
			}
		}
	}
	archives := map[string]bool{}
	for _, c := range archiveChanges(info.Root) {
		archives[c.Slug] = true
	}
	deleted := []string{}
	for _, ref := range refs {
		prune := false
		parts := strings.Split(ref, "/")
		if len(parts) < 4 {
			continue
		}
		switch parts[2] {
		case "claims":
			oid, ok, _ := gitstore.Ref(info.Root, ref)
			if !ok {
				continue
			}
			b, e := gitstore.ReadBlob(info.Root, oid)
			if e != nil {
				continue
			}
			var payload map[string]any
			if json.Unmarshal(b, &payload) != nil {
				continue
			}
			owner, _ := payload["worktree"].(string)
			if owner == "" {
				owner, _ = payload["Owner"].(string)
			}
			if resolved, e := filepath.EvalSymlinks(owner); e == nil {
				owner = resolved
			}
			if _, e := os.Stat(owner); e != nil || !registered[owner] {
				prune = true
			}
		case "attempts":
			if len(parts) == 5 && archives[parts[3]] {
				if n, e := strconv.Atoi(parts[4]); e == nil && n > 0 {
					prune = true
				}
			}
		case "drills":
			if len(parts) == 5 {
				t, e := time.Parse("20060102T150405.000000000", parts[4])
				if e == nil && t.Before(now.Add(-maxAge)) {
					prune = true
				}
			}
		}
		if prune {
			oid, ok, e := gitstore.Ref(info.Root, ref)
			if e == nil && ok {
				if e = gitstore.CASRef(info.Root, ref, oid, ""); e == nil {
					deleted = append(deleted, ref)
				}
			}
		}
	}
	sort.Strings(deleted)
	return model.GCResult{Pruned: deleted}, nil
}

package lifecycle

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"os/exec"
	"path/filepath"
	"sort"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
	"time"

	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/contracts"
	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/gitstore"
	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/project"
	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/workflow/model"
)

type claim struct {
	Owner    string
	Slug     string
	Path     string
	Run      string
	Phase    string
	Base     string
	Snapshot project.Snapshot
	Approved contracts.Document
}

func coded(code, format string, args ...any) error {
	return fmt.Errorf("%s: %s", code, fmt.Sprintf(format, args...))
}
func rootInfo(root string) (gitstore.Repository, error) { return gitstore.Inspect(root) }
func runGit(root string, args ...string) (string, error) {
	c := exec.Command("git", args...)
	c.Dir = root
	b, e := c.CombinedOutput()
	if e != nil {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("git %s: %w: %s", strings.Join(args, " "), e, strings.TrimSpace(string(b)))
	}
	return strings.TrimSpace(string(b)), nil
}
func gitBytes(root string, args ...string) ([]byte, error) {
	c := exec.Command("git", args...)
	c.Dir = root
	b, e := c.Output()
	return b, e
}
func dirty(root string) (bool, error) {
	s, e := runGit(root, "status", "--porcelain", "--untracked-files=all")
	return s != "", e
}
func claimRef(slug string) string { return "refs/fireweed/claims/" + slug }
func readClaim(root, slug string) (claim, string, bool, error) {
	oid, ok, e := gitstore.Ref(root, claimRef(slug))
	if e != nil || !ok {
		return claim{}, "", ok, e
	}
	b, e := gitstore.ReadBlob(root, oid)
	if e != nil {
		return claim{}, "", false, e
	}
	var c claim
	e = json.Unmarshal(b, &c)
	return c, oid, true, e
}
func saveClaim(root string, c claim, old string) (string, error) {
	b, e := json.Marshal(c)
	if e != nil {
		return "", e
	}
	oid, e := gitstore.WriteBlob(root, b)
	if e != nil {
		return "", e
	}
	if e = gitstore.CASRef(root, claimRef(c.Slug), old, oid); e != nil {
		return "", e
	}
	return oid, nil
}
func parseChange(root string, c project.Change) (project.Change, error) {
	b, e := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(root, filepath.FromSlash(c.Path)))
	if e != nil {
		return c, e
	}
	d, e := contracts.ParseDocument(string(b))
	if e != nil {
		return c, e
	}
	c.Document = d
	for _, part := range []struct {
		name string
		dst  *[]contracts.Item
	}{{"Added", &c.Added}, {"Modified", &c.Modified}, {"Removed", &c.Removed}} {
		s, _ := contracts.Section(d.Body, part.name)
		*part.dst, e = contracts.ParseItems(s)
		if e != nil {
			return c, e
		}
	}
	return c, nil
}
func queue(root string) ([]project.Change, error) { return project.Queue(root) }
func findPending(root, selector string) (project.Change, error) {
	q, e := queue(root)
	if e != nil {
		return project.Change{}, e
	}
	return selectChange(q, selector)
}
func selectChange(q []project.Change, selector string) (project.Change, error) {
	var found []project.Change
	for _, c := range q {
		if selector == c.Slug || selector == c.Path || selector == filepath.Base(c.Path) || selector == strings.TrimSuffix(filepath.Base(c.Path), ".md") {
			found = append(found, c)
		}
	}
	if len(found) == 1 {
		return found[0], nil
	}
	slugs := make([]string, 0, len(q))
	for _, c := range q {
		slugs = append(slugs, c.Slug)
	}
	sort.Strings(slugs)
	if len(found) > 1 {
		return project.Change{}, coded("U02", "change %q is ambiguous; valid slugs: %s", selector, strings.Join(slugs, ", "))
	}
	return project.Change{}, coded("U02", "change %q not found; valid slugs: %s", selector, strings.Join(slugs, ", "))
}
func frontString(d contracts.Document, key string) string {
	v := d.Frontmatter[key]
	if v == nil {
		return ""
	}
	return fmt.Sprint(v)
}
func frontInt(d contracts.Document, key string) int {
	v := d.Frontmatter[key]
	switch x := v.(type) {
	case int:
		return x
	case float64:
		return int(x)
	case string:
		n, _ := strconv.Atoi(x)
		return n
	}
	return 0
}
func frontBool(d contracts.Document, key string) bool {
	return d.Frontmatter[key] == true || frontString(d, key) == "true"
}
func mapAt(m map[string]any, key string) map[string]any { v, _ := m[key].(map[string]any); return v }
func cfgString(s project.Snapshot, section, key string) string {
	m := mapAt(s.Config, section)
	if v := m[key]; v != nil {
		return fmt.Sprint(v)
	}
	return ""
}
func cfgInt(s project.Snapshot, section, key string, def int) int {
	v := cfgString(s, section, key)
	if v == "" {
		return def
	}
	n, e := strconv.Atoi(v)
	if e != nil {
		return def
	}
	return n
}
func cfgBool(s project.Snapshot, section, key string, def bool) bool {
	v := cfgString(s, section, key)
	if v == "" {
		return def
	}
	return v == "true"
}
func renderChange(root string, c project.Change) error {
	s, e := contracts.RenderDocument(c.Document)
	if e != nil {
		return e
	}
	return os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(root, filepath.FromSlash(c.Path)), []byte(s), 0644)
}
func state(root string, c project.Change, cl claim, oid string) model.State {
	return model.State{Change: c, Snapshot: cl.Snapshot, Run: cl.Run, Phase: cl.Phase, PhaseBase: cl.Base, Head: head(root), ClaimOID: oid}
}
func head(root string) string {
	r, e := gitstore.Inspect(root)
	if e != nil {
		return ""
	}
	return r.Head
}
func owned(root, selector string) (project.Change, claim, string, error) {
	info, e := rootInfo(root)
	if e != nil {
		return project.Change{}, claim{}, "", e
	}
	if selector == "" {
		q, e := queue(info.Root)
		if e != nil {
			return project.Change{}, claim{}, "", e
		}
		for _, c := range q {
			cl, oid, ok, e := readClaim(info.Root, c.Slug)
			if e != nil {
				return project.Change{}, claim{}, "", e
			}
			if ok && cl.Owner == info.Root {
				c, e = parseChange(info.Root, c)
				return c, cl, oid, e
			}
		}
		return project.Change{}, claim{}, "", coded("P02", "worktree holds no change")
	}
	c, e := findPending(info.Root, selector)
	if e != nil {
		return c, claim{}, "", e
	}
	cl, oid, ok, e := readClaim(info.Root, c.Slug)
	if e != nil {
		return c, cl, oid, e
	}
	if !ok {
		return c, cl, "", coded("P02", "change has no claim")
	}
	if cl.Owner != info.Root {
		return c, cl, "", coded("P02", "claim belongs to another worktree")
	}
	c, e = parseChange(info.Root, c)
	return c, cl, oid, e
}
func Current(root, selector string) (model.State, error) {
	c, cl, oid, e := owned(root, selector)
	if e != nil {
		return model.State{}, e
	}
	return state(cl.Owner, c, cl, oid), nil
}
func Release(root, selector string) error {
	c, cl, oid, e := owned(root, selector)
	if e != nil {
		return e
	}
	return gitstore.CASRef(cl.Owner, claimRef(c.Slug), oid, "")
}
func section(d contracts.Document, name string) string {
	s, _ := contracts.Section(d.Body, name)
	return strings.TrimSpace(s)
}
func sameApproved(a, b contracts.Document, phase string) error {
	for k, v := range a.Frontmatter {
		if k == "phase" || k == "audit_rounds" || k == "blocked" || k == "run" {
			continue
		}
		if fmt.Sprint(v) != fmt.Sprint(b.Frontmatter[k]) {
			return coded("P03", "unapproved author field %s", k)
		}
	}
	for k := range b.Frontmatter {
		if _, ok := a.Frontmatter[k]; !ok && k != "phase" && k != "audit_rounds" && k != "blocked" && k != "run" {
			return coded("P03", "unapproved author field %s", k)
		}
	}
	for _, name := range []string{"Motivation", "Interface", "Added", "Modified", "Removed", "Decisions", "Removed decisions", "Set"} {
		if section(a, name) != section(b, name) {
			return coded("P03", "unapproved author section %s", name)
		}
	}
	for _, key := range []string{"phase", "audit_rounds", "blocked", "run"} {
		if frontString(a, key) != frontString(b, key) {
			return coded("P03", "unapproved runtime state %s", key)
		}
	}
	if phase != "audit" && section(a, "Audit") != section(b, "Audit") {
		return coded("P03", "unapproved audit state")
	}
	if section(a, "Provenance") != section(b, "Provenance") {
		return coded("P03", "unapproved provenance")
	}
	return nil
}
func checkStale(root string, c project.Change) error {
	stale, e := project.StaleSpecs(root, c.Slug)
	if e != nil {
		if strings.Contains(e.Error(), "stale base") {
			return coded("P05", "%v", e)
		}
		return e
	}
	for _, s := range stale {
		if !s.Recovered {
			return coded("P05", "stale base for %s", s.ID)
		}
	}
	return nil
}
func diagnosticsError(ds []project.Diagnostic) error {
	for _, d := range ds {

		}
	}

func nowUTC() time.Time                                       { return time.Now().UTC() }
func gitChanges(root, base string) ([]gitstore.Change, error) { return gitstore.Changes(root, base) }

	p := filepath.Join(root, filepath.FromSlash(path))
	if e := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(p), 0755); e != nil {
		return e
	}
	return os.WriteFile(p, []byte(s), 0644)
}
func gitRefList(root, prefix string) ([]string, error) {
	s, e := runGit(root, "for-each-ref", "--format=%(refname)", prefix)
	if e != nil {
		return nil, e
	}
	if s == "" {
		return []string{}, nil
	}
	return strings.Split(s, "\n"), nil
}
func ignoreMissing(err error) bool { return err == nil || errors.Is(err, os.ErrNotExist) }
func gitRun(ctx context.Context, root string, args ...string) (string, error) {
	r, e := gitstore.Run(ctx, gitstore.Request{Dir: root, Args: args})
	if e != nil {
		return "", e
	}
	if r.ExitCode != 0 {
		return r.Stdout, fmt.Errorf("git %s: %s", strings.Join(args, " "), r.Stderr)
	}
	return r.Stdout, nil
}

package lifecycle

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"

	"path/filepath"

	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/checks"

func module(s project.Snapshot, name string) (project.Module, bool) {
	for _, m := range s.Modules {
		if m.Name == name {
			return m, true
		}
	}
	return project.Module{}, false
}
func moduleSpecs(m project.Module) []contracts.Item {
	items, _ := contracts.ParseItems(section(m.Document, "Specs"))
	return items
}
func activeSpecs(items []contracts.Item) []contracts.Item {
	out := []contracts.Item{}
	for _, it := range items {
		if !strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(it.Tag), "quarantine") {
			out = append(out, it)
		}
	}
	return out
}
func listFront(d contracts.Document, key string) []string {
	out := []string{}
	switch v := d.Frontmatter[key].(type) {
	case []any:
		for _, x := range v {
			out = append(out, fmt.Sprint(x))
		}
	case []string:
		return v
	case string:
		if v != "" {
			out = append(out, v)
		}
	}
	return out
}
func targetIDs(c project.Change) []string {
	ids := []string{}
	for _, it := range c.Added {
		ids = append(ids, it.ID)
	}
	for _, it := range c.Modified {
		ids = append(ids, it.ID)
	}
	ids = append(ids, listFront(c.Document, "fixes")...)
	ids = append(ids, listFront(c.Document, "eval_fix")...)
	return ids
}
func validateZone(root string, c project.Change, cl claim) error {
	changes, e := gitChanges(root, cl.Base)
	if e != nil {
		return e
	}
	declared := section(cl.Approved, "Interface") != ""
	ds := checks.Zones(checks.ZoneRequest{Snapshot: cl.Snapshot, Module: c.Module, Phase: cl.Phase, ChangePath: c.Path, Base: cl.Base, InterfaceDeclared: declared, Changes: changes})
	if e = diagnosticsError(ds); e != nil {
		return e
	}
	if len(listFront(cl.Approved, "eval_fix")) > 0 {
		m, _ := module(cl.Snapshot, c.Module)
		for _, ch := range changes {
			if ch.Path == c.Path {
				continue
			}
			rel := strings.TrimPrefix(ch.Path, m.Dir+"/")
			zone := contracts.ResolveZone(rel, m.Zones)
			if cl.Phase == "impl" || zone != "evals" {
				return fmt.Errorf("Z01: eval_fix forbids edit to %s", ch.Path)
			}
		}
	}
	return nil
}
func validateBeforeHooks(root string, c project.Change, cl claim) error {
	if cl.Phase != "evals" && cl.Phase != "impl" && cl.Phase != "audit" {
		return coded("P01", "unsupported phase %s", cl.Phase)
	}
	if head(root) != cl.Base {
		return coded("P05", "stale phase base: HEAD changed from %s to %s", cl.Base, head(root))
	}
	if e := sameApproved(cl.Approved, c.Document, cl.Phase); e != nil {
		return e
	}
	if e := checkStale(root, c); e != nil {
		return e
	}
	return validateZone(root, c, cl)
}
func selectDependents(s project.Snapshot, target, mode string) []string {
	out := []string{}
	if mode == "none" {
		return out
	}
	for _, m := range s.Modules {
		if m.Name == target {
			continue
		}
		direct := false
		for _, d := range m.DependsOn {
			if d == target {
				direct = true
			}
		}
		if direct || (mode == "all" && dependency(s.Modules, m.Name, target, map[string]bool{})) {
			out = append(out, m.Name)
		}
	}
	sort.Strings(out)
	return out
}
func evaluate(ctx context.Context, req model.Request, c project.Change, cl claim, oid string) (model.Result, error) {
	result := model.Result{State: state(cl.Owner, c, cl, oid), Reports: map[string]checks.Report{}}
	if e := validateBeforeHooks(cl.Owner, c, cl); e != nil {
		return result, e
	}
	if cl.Phase == "audit" {
		_, e := auditSubmission(c, cl)
		return result, e
	}
	names := []string{c.Module}
	if cl.Phase == "impl" && !req.Quick {
		mode := frontConfig(cl.Snapshot, "verify_dependents", "direct")
		names = append(names, selectDependents(cl.Snapshot, c.Module, mode)...)
	}
	var firstErr error
	for _, name := range names {
		report, e := checks.Evaluate(ctx, checks.HookRequest{Snapshot: cl.Snapshot, Module: name, Bin: req.Bin, Timeout: req.Timeout})
		result.Reports[name] = report
		_ = retainReport(cl.Owner, cl.Run, cl.Phase, name, report)
		m, _ := module(cl.Snapshot, name)
		specs := activeSpecs(moduleSpecs(m))
		if name == c.Module {
			if ce := checks.RequireCoverage(report, specs); ce != nil && firstErr == nil {
				firstErr = ce
			}
			if cl.Phase == "evals" {
				if len(listFront(c.Document, "eval_fix")) > 0 {
					if ce := checks.RequirePass(report, specs); ce != nil && firstErr == nil {
						firstErr = ce
					}
					for _, id := range listFront(c.Document, "eval_fix") {
						found := false
						for _, tc := range report.Cases {
							for _, ref := range tc.IDs {
								if ref == id {
									found = true
								}
							}
						}
						if !found && firstErr == nil {
							firstErr = fmt.Errorf("E01: eval_fix ID %s lacks testcase", id)
						}
					}
				} else if ce := checks.RequireFailFirst(report, targetIDs(c), listFront(c.Document, "already_satisfied")); ce != nil && firstErr == nil {
					firstErr = ce
				}
			} else if ce := checks.RequirePass(report, specs); ce != nil && firstErr == nil {
				firstErr = ce
			}
		} else {
			if ce := checks.RequirePass(report, specs); ce != nil && firstErr == nil {
				firstErr = ce
			}
		}
		if e != nil && firstErr == nil && !(cl.Phase == "evals" && len(listFront(c.Document, "eval_fix")) == 0 && len(report.Cases) > 0) {
			firstErr = e
		}
	}
	costs := make([]model.ModuleCost, 0, len(names))
	for _, name := range names {
		m, _ := module(cl.Snapshot, name)
		costs = append(costs, measureModule(cl.Owner, m, result.Reports[name]))
	}
	result.Costs = costs
	ds := budgetWarnings(cl.Snapshot, costs)
	result.Diagnostics = append(result.Diagnostics, ds...)
	_ = saveCosts(cl.Owner, model.CostSnapshot{Run: cl.Run, Phase: cl.Phase, RecordedAt: nowUTC(), Modules: costs, Diagnostics: ds})
	if cl.Phase == "impl" && !req.Quick {
		d, e := checks.Boundaries(ctx, checks.BoundaryRequest{Snapshot: cl.Snapshot, Bin: req.Bin, Timeout: req.Timeout})
		result.Diagnostics = append(result.Diagnostics, d...)
		if e != nil && firstErr == nil {
			firstErr = e
		}
		if de := diagnosticsError(d); de != nil && firstErr == nil {
			firstErr = de
		}
	}
	return result, firstErr
}
func retainReport(root, run, phase, name string, report checks.Report) error {
	dir := filepath.Join(root, ".fireweed/runs", run, phase)
	if e := os.MkdirAll(dir, 0755); e != nil {
		return e
	}
	b, e := json.MarshalIndent(report, "", "  ")
	if e != nil {
		return e
	}
	if e = os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(dir, name+".json"), b, 0644); e != nil {
		return e
	}
	return os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(dir, name+".output.txt"), []byte(report.Stdout+"\n"+report.Stderr), 0644)
}
func Verify(ctx context.Context, req model.Request) (model.Result, error) {
	c, cl, oid, e := owned(req.Root, req.Change)
	if e != nil {
		return model.Result{}, e
	}
	return evaluate(ctx, req, c, cl, oid)
}
func measureModule(root string, m project.Module, r checks.Report) model.ModuleCost {
	v := model.ModuleCost{Module: m.Name, CasesPerSpec: map[string]int{}}
	for _, tc := range r.Cases {
		v.Seconds += tc.Seconds
		seen := map[string]bool{}
		for _, id := range tc.IDs {
			if !seen[id] {
				v.CasesPerSpec[id]++
				seen[id] = true
			}
		}
	}
	_ = filepath.WalkDir(filepath.Join(root, m.Dir), func(path string, d os.DirEntry, e error) error {
		if e != nil || d.IsDir() {
			return nil
		}
		info, e := d.Info()
		if e != nil || !info.Mode().IsRegular() {
			return nil
		}
		rel, _ := filepath.Rel(filepath.Join(root, m.Dir), path)
		zone := contracts.ResolveZone(filepath.ToSlash(rel), m.Zones)
		if zone != "evals" && zone != "disposable" {
			return nil
		}
		b, e := os.ReadFile(path)
		if e != nil {
			return nil
		}
		lines := strings.Count(string(b), "\n")
		if len(b) > 0 && b[len(b)-1] != '\n' {
			lines++
		}
		if zone == "evals" {
			v.EvalLines += lines
		} else {
			v.DisposableLines += lines
		}
		return nil
	})
	return v
}
func budgetWarnings(s project.Snapshot, costs []model.ModuleCost) []project.Diagnostic {
	ds := []project.Diagnostic{}
	timeLimit := 15 * time.Minute
	if v := cfgString(s, "budgets", "verify_time"); v != "" {
		if d, e := time.ParseDuration(v); e == nil {
			timeLimit = d
		}
	}
	cases := cfgInt(s, "budgets", "cases_per_spec", 15)
	ratio := 4.0
	if v := cfgString(s, "budgets", "eval_ratio"); v != "" {
		_, _ = fmt.Sscan(v, &ratio)
	}
	total := 0.0
	for _, c := range costs {
		total += c.Seconds
	}
	if total > timeLimit.Seconds() {
		ds = append(ds, project.Diagnostic{Code: "B01", Message: fmt.Sprintf("verify seconds %.3f exceeds limit %.3f", total, timeLimit.Seconds()), Warning: true})
	}
	for _, c := range costs {
		for id, n := range c.CasesPerSpec {
			if n > cases {
				ds = append(ds, project.Diagnostic{Code: "B02", Message: fmt.Sprintf("%s: %d cases exceeds limit %d", id, n, cases), Warning: true})
			}
		}
		if c.EvalLines > 0 && (c.DisposableLines == 0 || float64(c.EvalLines)/float64(c.DisposableLines) > ratio) {
			ds = append(ds, project.Diagnostic{Code: "B03", Message: fmt.Sprintf("%s: eval/disposable ratio %d/%d exceeds limit %g", c.Module, c.EvalLines, c.DisposableLines, ratio), Warning: true})
		}
	}
	return ds
}
func saveCosts(root string, s model.CostSnapshot) error {
	p := filepath.Join(root, ".fireweed/runs", s.Run, s.Phase, "costs.json")
	if e := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(p), 0755); e != nil {
		return e
	}
	b, e := json.MarshalIndent(s, "", "  ")
	if e != nil {
		return e
	}
	return os.WriteFile(p, b, 0644)
}
func Costs(root string) ([]model.CostSnapshot, error) {
	info, e := rootInfo(root)
	if e != nil {
		return nil, e
	}
	out := []model.CostSnapshot{}
	_ = filepath.WalkDir(filepath.Join(info.Root, ".fireweed/runs"), func(p string, d os.DirEntry, e error) error {
		if e != nil {
			return nil
		}
		if d.IsDir() || d.Name() != "costs.json" {
			return nil
		}
		b, e := os.ReadFile(p)
		if e != nil {
			return nil
		}
		var s model.CostSnapshot
		if json.Unmarshal(b, &s) == nil {
			out = append(out, s)
		}
		return nil
	})
	sort.Slice(out, func(i, j int) bool { return out[i].RecordedAt.Before(out[j].RecordedAt) })
	return out, nil
}

package lifecycle

import (
	"context"
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/hex"
	"fmt"

	"path/filepath"
	"regexp"
	"sort"
	"strings"

	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/assets"
	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/checks"
	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/contracts"
	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/gitstore"
	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/project"
	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/workflow/model"
)

var findingRE = regexp.MustCompile(`(?m)^\s*-\s*(\[untestable\]\s*)?([A-Z][A-Z0-9]*-[0-9]+):\s*"([^"]+)"[^\n]*`)
var checkedRE = regexp.MustCompile(`(?mi)^Checked IDs:\s*([^\n]*)`)

func auditSubmission(c project.Change, cl claim) ([]string, error) {
	body := section(c.Document, "Audit")
	if body == "" {
		return nil, coded("P09", "missing audit submission")
	}
	m, _ := module(cl.Snapshot, c.Module)
	specs := map[string]string{}
	for _, it := range moduleSpecs(m) {
		specs[it.ID] = it.Body
	}
	prior := map[string]bool{}
	for _, x := range findingRE.FindAllStringSubmatch(section(cl.Approved, "Audit"), -1) {
		prior[x[2]] = true
	}
	kept := []string{}
	for _, x := range findingRE.FindAllStringSubmatch(body, -1) {
		if !strings.Contains(specs[x[2]], x[3]) {
			continue
		}
		if frontInt(c.Document, "audit_rounds") > 0 && len(prior) > 0 && !prior[x[2]] {
			continue
		}
		kept = append(kept, strings.TrimSpace(x[0]))
	}
	if len(kept) > 0 {
		return kept, nil
	}
	if !strings.Contains(body, "No findings") {
		return nil, coded("P09", "audit submission needs No findings or valid findings")
	}
	match := checkedRE.FindStringSubmatch(body)
	if len(match) < 2 {
		return nil, coded("P09", "No findings requires checked IDs")
	}
	checked := map[string]bool{}
	for _, part := range strings.FieldsFunc(match[1], func(r rune) bool { return r == ',' || r == ' ' || r == '\t' }) {
		checked[part] = true
	}
	for _, id := range targetIDs(c) {
		if !checked[id] {
			return nil, coded("P09", "No findings missing checked ID %s", id)
		}
	}
	return nil, nil
}
func normalizeAudit(c *project.Change, findings []string) {
	if len(findings) > 0 {
		c.Document.Body = contracts.ReplaceSection(c.Document.Body, "Audit", strings.Join(findings, "\n")+"\n")
	} else {
		body := section(c.Document, "Audit")
		lines := []string{}
		for _, line := range strings.Split(body, "\n") {
			if strings.HasPrefix(strings.TrimSpace(line), "-") {
				continue
			}
			lines = append(lines, line)
		}
		c.Document.Body = contracts.ReplaceSection(c.Document.Body, "Audit", strings.Join(lines, "\n")+"\n")
	}
}
func provenance(c *project.Change, req model.Request, phase string, reports map[string]checks.Report) {
	agent := req.Agent
	if agent == "" {
		agent = "manual"
	}
	book, _ := assets.Playbook(phase)
	if phase == "impl" && frontBool(c.Document, "regenerate") {
		book, _ = assets.Playbook("regenerate")
	}
	h := sha256.Sum256([]byte(book))
	total, passing, failing := 0, 0, 0
	for _, r := range reports {
		for _, tc := range r.Cases {
			total++
			if tc.Result == "pass" {
				passing++
			} else if tc.Result == "fail" || tc.Result == "error" {
				failing++
			}
		}
	}
	line := fmt.Sprintf("- %s %s agent=%s fireweed=%s playbook=%s tests=%d failing=%d passing=%d", phase, nowUTC().Format("2006-01-02T15:04:05Z07:00"), agent, assets.Version(), hex.EncodeToString(h[:]), total, failing, passing)
	old := section(c.Document, "Provenance")
	if old != "" {
		old += "\n"
	}
	c.Document.Body = contracts.ReplaceSection(c.Document.Body, "Provenance", old+line+"\n")
}
func applySpec(root string, c project.Change) error {
	path := filepath.Join(root, "packages", c.Module, "SPEC.md")
	for _, m := range mustModules(root) {
		if m.Name == c.Module {
			path = filepath.Join(root, m.Dir, "SPEC.md")
		}
	}
	b, e := os.ReadFile(path)
	if e != nil {
		return e
	}
	doc, e := contracts.ParseDocument(string(b))
	if e != nil {
		return e
	}
	items, e := contracts.ParseItems(section(doc, "Specs"))
	if e != nil {
		return e
	}
	byID := map[string]contracts.Item{}
	order := []string{}
	for _, it := range items {
		byID[it.ID] = it
		order = append(order, it.ID)
	}
	for _, it := range c.Removed {
		delete(byID, it.ID)
	}
	for _, it := range c.Modified {
		byID[it.ID] = it
	}
	for _, it := range c.Added {
		if _, ok := byID[it.ID]; !ok {
			order = append(order, it.ID)
		}
		byID[it.ID] = it
	}
	rendered := []string{}
	for _, id := range order {
		if it, ok := byID[id]; ok {
			rendered = append(rendered, strings.TrimSpace(contracts.RenderItem(it)))
		}
	}
	doc.Body = contracts.ReplaceSection(doc.Body, "Specs", strings.Join(rendered, "\n\n")+"\n")
	if set := mapAt(c.Document.Frontmatter, "set"); set != nil {
		for k, v := range set {
			doc.Frontmatter[k] = v
		}
	}

func allChanges(root string) ([]project.Change, error) {

	if e != nil {
		return nil, e
	}
	return append(q, archiveChanges(root)...), nil
}
func selectedAny(root, selector string) (project.Change, error) {
	all, e := allChanges(root)
	if e != nil {
		return project.Change{}, e
	}
	return selectChange(all, selector)
}
func phaseAt(root, revision, path string) string {
	b, e := gitstore.ReadAt(root, revision, path)
	if e != nil {
		return ""
	}
	d, e := contracts.ParseDocument(string(b))
	if e != nil {
		return ""
	}
	return frontString(d, "phase")
}
func Commits(root, selector string) ([]string, error) {
	info, e := rootInfo(root)
	if e != nil {
		return nil, e
	}
	c, e := selectedAny(info.Root, selector)
	if e != nil {
		return nil, e
	}
	names := []string{"changes/" + filepath.Base(c.Path), "changes/archive/" + filepath.Base(c.Path)}
	list, e := runGit(info.Root, "rev-list", "HEAD")
	if e != nil {
		return nil, e
	}

		newPhase, oldPhase := "", ""
		for _, p := range names {
			if x := phaseAt(info.Root, oid, p); x != "" {
				newPhase = x
			}
			if parent != "" {
				if x := phaseAt(info.Root, parent, p); x != "" {
					oldPhase = x
				}
			}
		}
		if newPhase != "" && newPhase != oldPhase {
			out = append(out, oid)
		}
	}

}
func Abandon(root, selector string) (string, error) {
	info, e := rootInfo(root)
	if e != nil {
		return "", e
	}
	c, e := selectedAny(info.Root, selector)
	if e != nil {
		return "", e
	}
	if strings.HasPrefix(c.Path, "changes/archive/") && frontString(c.Document, "phase") == "applied" {
		return "", coded("P01", "cannot abandon applied change")
	}
	d, e := dirty(info.Root)
	if e != nil {
		return "", e
	}
	if d {
		return "", coded("P01", "abandon requires clean worktree")
	}
	cl, oid, exists, e := readClaim(info.Root, c.Slug)
	if e != nil {
		return "", e
	}
	if exists && cl.Owner != info.Root {
		return "", coded("P02", "claim belongs to another worktree")
	}
	commits, e := Commits(info.Root, c.Path)
	if e != nil {
		return "", e
	}
	for _, commit := range commits {
		if _, e = runGit(info.Root, "revert", "--no-commit", commit); e != nil {
			return "", e
		}
	}
	if e = os.Remove(filepath.Join(info.Root, filepath.FromSlash(c.Path))); e != nil {
		return "", e
	}
	newHead, e := commitAll(info.Root, "fireweed: abandon "+c.Slug)
	if e != nil {
		return "", e
	}
	if exists {
		if e = gitstore.CASRef(info.Root, claimRef(c.Slug), oid, ""); e != nil {
			return "", e
		}
	}
	return newHead, nil
}
func resolveAttempt(root, slug string, n int) (string, string, error) {
	if n <= 0 {
		return "", "", coded("P01", "attempt must be positive")
	}
	name := fmt.Sprintf("refs/fireweed/attempts/%s/%d", slug, n)
	oid, ok, e := gitstore.Ref(root, name)
	if e != nil {
		return "", "", e
	}
	if !ok {
		return "", "", coded("P01", "attempt %d missing", n)
	}
	return name, oid, nil
}
func nextAttempt(root, slug string) int {
	for n := 1; ; n++ {
		_, ok, _ := gitstore.Ref(root, fmt.Sprintf("refs/fireweed/attempts/%s/%d", slug, n))
		if !ok {
			return n
		}
	}
}
func changedPaths(root, from, to string) []string {
	s, _ := runGit(root, "diff", "--name-only", from, to)
	out := strings.Fields(s)
	sort.Strings(out)
	return out
}

func Test_FLOW_077_MaintenanceStartsInImplAndArchivesDirectly(t *testing.T) {
	root := fixture(t, "", "", "", "", "")
	write(t, root, "changes/0001-manual.md", `---
module: alpha
bases: {}
---

## Motivation
Simplify the existing alpha implementation while keeping its behavior.

## Interface

## Added

## Modified

## Removed

## Decisions

`)
	write(t, root, "packages/alpha/internal/ready", "original implementation\n")
	write(t, root, "packages/alpha/evals/alpha_test.go", "package alpha_test\n\n// Retained coverage fixture.\n")
	marker := hookMarker(t, root)
	for _, d := range project.Check(root) {
		if !d.Warning {
			t.Fatalf("invalid maintenance fixture: %#v", d)
		}
	}
	retained := map[string]string{}
	for _, name := range []string{"packages/alpha/SPEC.md", "packages/alpha/api.go", "packages/alpha/evals/alpha_test.go"} {
		b, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(root, name))
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		retained[name] = string(b)
	}
	before := head(t, root)
	s := start(t, root)
	if s.Phase != "impl" || s.Run == "" || s.ClaimOID == "" || s.PhaseBase != before || head(t, root) != before {
		t.Fatalf("maintenance Start state = %#v; HEAD before %s after %s", s, before, head(t, root))
	}
	if _, err := os.Stat(marker); !os.IsNotExist(err) {
		t.Errorf("Start ran an eval hook: %v", err)
	}
	current, err := workflow.Current(root, "manual")
	if err != nil || current.Phase != "impl" || current.Run != s.Run || current.ClaimOID != s.ClaimOID {
		t.Fatalf("persisted maintenance state = %#v, %v", current, err)
	}
	pending, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(root, "changes/0001-manual.md"))
	if err != nil || !strings.Contains(string(pending), "phase: impl") {
		t.Fatalf("pending maintenance phase = %q, %v", pending, err)
	}
	write(t, root, "packages/alpha/internal/ready", "simplified implementation\n")
	checked, err := verify(root, false)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("full maintenance Verify: %v, reports: %#v", err, checked.Reports)
	}
	if len(checked.Reports["alpha"].Cases) != 2 || len(checked.Reports["beta"].Cases) != 1 {
		t.Errorf("full Verify did not run current and direct dependent coverage: %#v", checked.Reports)
	}
	if head(t, root) != before {
		t.Fatal("Verify changed HEAD")
	}
	applied, err := done(root)
	if err != nil || applied.State.Phase != "applied" {
		t.Fatalf("maintenance Done = %#v, %v", applied, err)
	}
	after := head(t, root)
	if after == before || git(t, root, "rev-parse", "HEAD^") != before {
		t.Errorf("maintenance archive was not one commit: before %s after %s", before, after)
	}
	if _, err := os.Stat(filepath.Join(root, "changes/0001-manual.md")); !os.IsNotExist(err) {
		t.Errorf("pending maintenance change remains: %v", err)
	}
	archive, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(root, "changes/archive/0001-manual.md"))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if !strings.Contains(string(archive), "phase: applied") || !strings.Contains(string(archive), "- impl ") || strings.Contains(string(archive), "- evals ") || strings.Contains(string(archive), "- audit ") {
		t.Errorf("maintenance archive has unexpected phase history: %s", archive)
	}
	for name, want := range retained {
		got, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(root, name))
		if err != nil || string(got) != want {
			t.Errorf("retained %s changed: %q, %v", name, got, err)
		}
	}

func Test_FLOW_034_FLOW_036_FLOW_041_FLOW_046_AuditAcceptsOnlyExactClauseFindingsAndCheckedNoFindings(t *testing.T) {
	root := fixture(t, "", "", "", "", "")
	toAudit(t, root)
	audit(t, root, "- ALP-999: \"Missing MUST clause.\" — invalid ID\n- ALP-001: \"Alpha MUST do something else.\" — invalid quote\nChecked IDs: ALP-001\nNo findings\n")
	r, err := done(root)
	if err != nil || r.State.Phase != "impl" || r.State.PhaseBase != head(t, root) {
		t.Errorf("invalid findings were retained: %#v, %v", r, err)
	}
	b, _ := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(root, "changes/0001-manual.md"))
	if strings.Contains(string(b), "ALP-999") || strings.Contains(string(b), "something else") || !strings.Contains(string(b), "No findings") {
		t.Errorf("audit normalization = %s", b)
	}
	missing := fixture(t, "", "", "", "", "")
	toAudit(t, missing)
	audit(t, missing, "No findings\n")
	before := head(t, missing)
	if _, err := done(missing); err == nil || head(t, missing) != before {
		t.Error("No findings without checked IDs accepted or committed")
	}
}

func Test_FLOW_035_FLOW_037_FLOW_038_FLOW_039_FLOW_042_FLOW_043_FLOW_046_AuditFindingsConvergeAndPersistTwoRoundBound(t *testing.T) {
	root := fixture(t, "", "", "### new:extra [review]\nExtra MUST be visible.\n", "", "")
	toAudit(t, root)
	finding := "- ALP-001: \"" + newClause + "\" — missing assertion\n"
	for round := 1; round <= 2; round++ {
		body := finding
		if round == 2 {
			body += "- ALP-003: \"Extra MUST be visible.\" — new finding on re-audit\n"
		}
		audit(t, root, body)
		r, err := done(root)
		if err != nil || r.State.Phase != "evals" || r.State.PhaseBase != head(t, root) {
			t.Fatalf("finding round %d = %#v, %v", round, r, err)
		}
		current, err := workflow.Current(root, "manual")
		if err != nil || current.Change.Document.Frontmatter["audit_rounds"] != round {
			t.Errorf("persistent rounds %d = %#v, %v", round, current, err)
		}
		if round == 2 {
			b, _ := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(root, "changes/0001-manual.md"))
			if strings.Contains(string(b), "new finding on re-audit") {
				t.Error("new re-audit ID retained")
			}
		}
		if _, err := done(root); err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("revised evals Done round %d: %v", round, err)
		}
	}
	audit(t, root, finding)
	beforeBlock := head(t, root)
	_, _ = done(root)
	b, _ := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(root, "changes/0001-manual.md"))
	questions, hasQuestions := contracts.Section(string(b), "Questions")
	if !strings.Contains(string(b), "blocked:") || !hasQuestions || !strings.Contains(questions, newClause) {
		t.Errorf("third finding did not block with question: %s", b)
	}
	if head(t, root) == beforeBlock || !strings.Contains(string(b), "audit_rounds: 2") {
		t.Error("two-round bound was not committed with persistent count")
	}
	if _, err := workflow.Current(root, "manual"); err == nil {
		t.Error("blocked claim remained held")
	}
	configured := fixture(t, "audit:\n  max_rounds: 1\n", "", "", "", "")
	toAudit(t, configured)
	audit(t, configured, finding)
	first, err := done(configured)
	if err != nil || first.State.Phase != "evals" || first.State.PhaseBase != head(t, configured) {
		t.Fatalf("configured first finding = %#v, %v", first, err)
	}
	firstCurrent, err := workflow.Current(configured, "manual")
	if err != nil || firstCurrent.Change.Document.Frontmatter["audit_rounds"] != 1 {
		t.Errorf("configured round count = %#v, %v", firstCurrent, err)
	}
	if _, err := done(configured); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("configured revised evals Done: %v", err)
	}
	audit(t, configured, finding)
	_, _ = done(configured)
	change, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(configured, "changes/0001-manual.md"))
	configuredQuestions, configuredHasQuestions := contracts.Section(string(change), "Questions")
	if err != nil || !strings.Contains(string(change), "blocked:") || !strings.Contains(string(change), "audit_rounds: 1") || !configuredHasQuestions || !strings.Contains(configuredQuestions, newClause) {
		t.Errorf("configured max_rounds did not block after one return: %s, %v", change, err)
	}
	if _, err := workflow.Current(configured, "manual"); err == nil {
		t.Error("configured bound retained claim")
	}
}

func Test_FLOW_004_FLOW_028_FLOW_044_FLOW_045_FLOW_046_FLOW_047_FLOW_050_ImplDoneAppliesSpecsSetAndDecisionsAndArchives(t *testing.T) {
	root := fixture(t, "audit:\n  enabled: false\nverify_dependents: none\n", "set:\n  interface: [api.go, extra.go]\n  hooks:\n    eval: [sh, .fireweed/eval.sh, \"{module}\", \"{report}\"]\n", "### new:extra [review]\nExtra MUST be visible.\n", "", "### ALP-002\n")
	p := filepath.Join(root, ".fireweed/eval.sh")
	b, _ := os.ReadFile(p)
	script := strings.Replace(string(b), `<testcase name="ALP-002" classname="fixture">%s</testcase>`, "", 1)
	script = strings.Replace(script, `"$result" "$other" > "$report"`, `"$result" > "$report"`, 1)
	write(t, root, ".fireweed/eval.sh", script)
	write(t, root, ".fireweed/global-eval.sh", "#!/bin/sh\nexit 1\n")
	configPath := filepath.Join(root, "fireweed.yaml")
	config, err := os.ReadFile(configPath)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	write(t, root, "fireweed.yaml", strings.Replace(string(config), "eval: [sh, .fireweed/eval.sh,", "eval: [sh, .fireweed/global-eval.sh,", 1))
	commit(t, root, "report only projected spec IDs")
	start(t, root)
	evalsHead := head(t, root)
	r, err := done(root)
	if err != nil || r.State.Phase != "impl" || head(t, root) == evalsHead || r.State.PhaseBase != head(t, root) {
		t.Fatalf("evals transition = %#v, %v", r, err)
	}
	implBase := head(t, root)
	otherClaim := []byte(`{"worktree":"independent","change":"other"}`)
	otherOID, err := gitstore.WriteBlob(root, otherClaim)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	otherRef := "refs/fireweed/claims/other"
	if err := gitstore.CASRef(root, otherRef, "", otherOID); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	write(t, root, "packages/alpha/internal/ready", "ready\n")
	r, err = done(root)
	if err != nil || r.State.Phase != "applied" || head(t, root) == implBase || r.State.PhaseBase != head(t, root) {
		t.Fatalf("impl transition = %#v, %v", r, err)
	}
	if _, err := os.Stat(filepath.Join(root, "changes/0001-manual.md")); !os.IsNotExist(err) {
		t.Errorf("pending change remains: %v", err)
	}
	archive, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(root, "changes/archive/0001-manual.md"))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	spec, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(root, "packages/alpha/SPEC.md"))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	appliedHead := head(t, root)
	archiveAtHead, err := gitstore.ReadAt(root, appliedHead, "changes/archive/0001-manual.md")
	if err != nil || string(archiveAtHead) != string(archive) {
		t.Errorf("applied HEAD lacks archived change: %q, %v", archiveAtHead, err)
	}
	specAtHead, err := gitstore.ReadAt(root, appliedHead, "packages/alpha/SPEC.md")
	if err != nil || string(specAtHead) != string(spec) {
		t.Errorf("applied HEAD lacks applied spec: %q, %v", specAtHead, err)
	}
	moduleDoc, err := contracts.ParseDocument(string(spec))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	wantInterface := []any{"api.go", "extra.go"}
	wantHooks := map[string]any{"eval": []any{"sh", ".fireweed/eval.sh", "{module}", "{report}"}}
	if !reflect.DeepEqual(moduleDoc.Frontmatter["interface"], wantInterface) || !reflect.DeepEqual(moduleDoc.Frontmatter["hooks"], wantHooks) {
		t.Errorf("set values missing from module metadata: %#v", moduleDoc.Frontmatter)
	}
	for _, want := range []string{"phase: applied", "## Provenance"} {
		if !strings.Contains(string(archive), want) {
			t.Errorf("archive misses %q", want)
		}
	}
	for _, want := range []string{newClause, "### ALP-003", "extra.go", "Use the revised policy."} {
		if !strings.Contains(string(spec), want) {
			t.Errorf("applied spec misses %q: %s", want, spec)
		}
	}
	if strings.Contains(string(spec), "### ALP-002") || strings.Contains(string(spec), "Retain old policy.") {
		t.Errorf("removed spec/decision remains: %s", spec)
	}
	if !strings.Contains(string(spec), "- manual: Use the revised policy.") {
		t.Errorf("decision attribution missing: %s", spec)
	}
	if _, err := workflow.Current(root, "manual"); err == nil {
		t.Error("applied claim remained held")
	}
	if got, exists, err := gitstore.Ref(root, otherRef); err != nil || !exists || got != otherOID {
		t.Errorf("application changed independent claim ref: %q, %v, %v", got, exists, err)
	}
	if got, err := gitstore.ReadBlob(root, otherOID); err != nil || string(got) != string(otherClaim) {
		t.Errorf("application changed independent claim blob: %q, %v", got, err)
	}
}

func Test_FLOW_073_FLOW_074_FLOW_075_StartFromAttemptRestoresEvalsStepAndRetainsCurrentApproval(t *testing.T) {
	root, started, saved := savedEvalsAttempt(t)
	write(t, root, "later-independent.txt", "later independent commit\n")
	commit(t, root, "later independent work")
	unblockAttempt(t, root)
	beforeHead := head(t, root)
	before := readFile(t, root, "changes/0001-manual.md")
	if strings.Contains(before, "Saved worker decision.") || strings.Contains(before, "Saved worker question.") {
		t.Fatal("blocked fixture leaked saved worker body")
	}
	got, err := workflow.StartFromAttempt(root, "manual", 1)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("StartFromAttempt(%s): %v", saved.AttemptRef, err)
	}
	if got.Run != started.Run || got.Phase != started.Phase || len(got.Change.Added) != 1 || got.Change.Added[0].ID != started.Change.Added[0].ID {
		t.Errorf("resume changed run, phase or assigned ID: %#v", got)
	}
	if got.Head != beforeHead || got.PhaseBase != beforeHead || head(t, root) != beforeHead {
		t.Errorf("resume changed HEAD or phase base: state=%#v, HEAD=%s", got, head(t, root))
	}
	current, currentErr := workflow.Current(root, "manual")
	if got.ClaimOID == "" || currentErr != nil || current.ClaimOID != got.ClaimOID || got.Snapshot.Root != root {
		t.Errorf("resume did not return an owned held claim: state=%#v, Current=%#v, %v", got, current, currentErr)
	}
	if text := readFile(t, root, "packages/alpha/evals/current_test.go"); text != "saved modified eval\n" {
		t.Errorf("modified eval = %q", text)
	}
	if _, err := os.Stat(filepath.Join(root, "packages/alpha/evals/retired_test.go")); !os.IsNotExist(err) {
		t.Errorf("saved deletion was not restored: %v", err)
	}
	if text := readFile(t, root, "packages/alpha/evals/new_test.go"); text != "saved new eval\n" {
		t.Errorf("new eval = %q", text)
	}
	if text := readFile(t, root, "later-independent.txt"); text != "later independent commit\n" {
		t.Errorf("later independent work = %q", text)
	}
	resumed, err := contracts.ParseDocument(readFile(t, root, "changes/0001-manual.md"))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	approved, err := contracts.ParseDocument(before)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	for _, name := range []string{"Motivation", "Interface", "Added", "Modified", "Removed", "Removed decisions"} {
		want, _ := contracts.Section(approved.Body, name)
		actual, _ := contracts.Section(resumed.Body, name)
		if actual != want {
			t.Errorf("current approved %s changed: got %q, want %q", name, actual, want)
		}
	}
	if !reflect.DeepEqual(resumed.Frontmatter, approved.Frontmatter) {
		t.Errorf("current runtime/author frontmatter changed: got %#v, want %#v", resumed.Frontmatter, approved.Frontmatter)
	}
	for name, want := range map[string]string{"Decisions": "Saved worker decision.", "Questions": "Saved worker question."} {
		body, ok := contracts.Section(resumed.Body, name)
		if !ok || !strings.Contains(body, want) {
			t.Errorf("saved worker %s absent: %q", name, body)
		}
	}
}

func Test_FLOW_073_FLOW_074_FLOW_075_StartFromAttemptImplRetainsCommittedEvalsAuditAndProvenance(t *testing.T) {
	root := blockFixture(t, "", "", "", "", "")
	start(t, root)
	write(t, root, "packages/alpha/evals/committed_test.go", "committed eval\n")
	evals, err := done(root)
	if err != nil || evals.State.Phase != "audit" {
		t.Fatalf("evals Done: %#v, %v", evals, err)
	}
	audit(t, root, "Checked IDs: ALP-001\nNo findings\n")
	impl, err := done(root)
	if err != nil || impl.State.Phase != "impl" {
		t.Fatalf("audit Done: %#v, %v", impl, err)
	}
	write(t, root, "packages/alpha/internal/attempt.go", "saved implementation\n")
	path := "changes/0001-manual.md"
	doc, err := contracts.ParseDocument(readFile(t, root, path))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	doc.Body = contracts.ReplaceSection(doc.Body, "Decisions", "\nSaved impl decision.\n")
	rendered, err := contracts.RenderDocument(doc)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	write(t, root, path, rendered)
	saved := block(t, root, "impl attempts exhausted")
	if saved.AttemptRef != "refs/fireweed/attempts/manual/1" {
		t.Fatalf("wrong impl attempt ref: %s", saved.AttemptRef)
	}
	unblockAttempt(t, root)
	beforeHead := head(t, root)
	before, err := contracts.ParseDocument(readFile(t, root, path))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	provenance, hasProvenance := contracts.Section(before.Body, "Provenance")
	auditBody, hasAudit := contracts.Section(before.Body, "Audit")
	if !hasProvenance || strings.TrimSpace(provenance) == "" || !hasAudit || !strings.Contains(auditBody, "No findings; checked ALP-001") {
		t.Fatalf("fixture lacks committed controller provenance or audit: %#v", before)
	}
	got, err := workflow.StartFromAttempt(root, "manual", 1)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("impl StartFromAttempt: %v", err)
	}
	if got.Run != impl.State.Run || got.Phase != "impl" || got.Head != beforeHead || head(t, root) != beforeHead || got.ClaimOID == "" {
		t.Errorf("impl resume lost run/phase/claim or changed HEAD: %#v", got)
	}
	if text := readFile(t, root, "packages/alpha/evals/committed_test.go"); text != "committed eval\n" {
		t.Errorf("committed eval changed: %q", text)
	}
	if text := readFile(t, root, "packages/alpha/internal/attempt.go"); text != "saved implementation\n" {
		t.Errorf("impl step work = %q", text)
	}
	resumed, err := contracts.ParseDocument(readFile(t, root, path))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	for _, name := range []string{"Audit", "Provenance", "Motivation", "Interface"} {
		want, _ := contracts.Section(before.Body, name)
		actual, _ := contracts.Section(resumed.Body, name)
		if actual != want {
			t.Errorf("committed/current %s changed: got %q, want %q", name, actual, want)
		}
	}
	if !reflect.DeepEqual(resumed.Frontmatter, before.Frontmatter) {
		t.Errorf("impl resume changed runtime/author frontmatter: %#v, want %#v", resumed.Frontmatter, before.Frontmatter)
	}
	if body, _ := contracts.Section(resumed.Body, "Decisions"); !strings.Contains(body, "Saved impl decision.") {
		t.Errorf("saved impl decision missing: %q", body)
	}
}

func Test_FLOW_074_StartFromAttemptSelectsRequestedSavedRef(t *testing.T) {
	root, _, first := savedEvalsAttempt(t)
	unblockAttempt(t, root)
	start(t, root)

}

func Test_FLOW_073_StartFromAttemptRequiresCleanEligibleUnblockedAndUnclaimedChange(t *testing.T) {
	t.Run("dirty", func(t *testing.T) {
		root, _, _ := savedEvalsAttempt(t)
		unblockAttempt(t, root)
		write(t, root, "uncommitted.txt", "dirty\n")
		if _, err := workflow.StartFromAttempt(root, "manual", 1); err == nil || !strings.HasPrefix(err.Error(), "P01") {
			t.Errorf("dirty resume = %v, want P01", err)
		}
		if got := git(t, root, "for-each-ref", "--format=%(objectname)", "refs/fireweed/claims/manual"); got != "" {
			t.Errorf("dirty resume created claim: %s", got)
		}
	})
	t.Run("still blocked", func(t *testing.T) {
		root, _, _ := savedEvalsAttempt(t)
		beforeHead, before := head(t, root), readFile(t, root, "changes/0001-manual.md")
		if _, err := workflow.StartFromAttempt(root, "manual", 1); err == nil || !strings.HasPrefix(err.Error(), "P01") {
			t.Errorf("blocked resume = %v, want P01", err)
		}
		assertNoResumeMutation(t, root, beforeHead, before)
	})
	t.Run("not first eligible", func(t *testing.T) {
		root, _, _ := savedEvalsAttempt(t)
		unblockAttempt(t, root)
		write(t, root, "changes/0000-first.md", "---\nmodule: alpha\n---\n## Motivation\nEarlier approved work.\n\n## Interface\n\n## Added\n\n## Modified\n\n## Removed\n\n## Decisions\n")
		commit(t, root, "earlier eligible change")
		beforeHead, before := head(t, root), readFile(t, root, "changes/0001-manual.md")
		if _, err := workflow.StartFromAttempt(root, "manual", 1); err == nil || !strings.HasPrefix(err.Error(), "P01") {
			t.Errorf("waiting resume = %v, want P01", err)
		}
		assertNoResumeMutation(t, root, beforeHead, before)
	})
	t.Run("foreign claim", func(t *testing.T) {
		root, _, _ := savedEvalsAttempt(t)
		unblockAttempt(t, root)
		other := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "linked")
		git(t, root, "worktree", "add", "-b", "linked", other, "HEAD")
		owner := start(t, root)
		beforeHead, before := head(t, other), readFile(t, other, "changes/0001-manual.md")
		if _, err := workflow.StartFromAttempt(other, "manual", 1); err == nil || !strings.HasPrefix(err.Error(), "P02") {
			t.Errorf("foreign claim resume = %v, want P02", err)
		}
		if head(t, other) != beforeHead || readFile(t, other, "changes/0001-manual.md") != before {
			t.Error("foreign resume changed other worktree")
		}
		if current, err := workflow.Current(root, "manual"); err != nil || current.ClaimOID != owner.ClaimOID {
			t.Errorf("foreign resume changed owner's claim: %#v, %v", current, err)
		}
	})
}

func Test_FLOW_057_VerifyAndDoneRejectApprovedStateEditsBeforeHooks(t *testing.T) {
	for _, edit := range []string{"author", "runtime", "audit"} {
		t.Run(edit, func(t *testing.T) {
			root := fixture(t, "", "", "", "", "")
			marker := hookMarker(t, root)
			start(t, root)
			p := filepath.Join(root, "changes/0001-manual.md")
			b, err := os.ReadFile(p)
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			want := ""
			switch edit {
			case "author":
				write(t, root, "changes/0001-manual.md", strings.Replace(string(b), "Users need a revised alpha value.", "Unapproved changed purpose.", 1))
				want = "P03: approved author metadata changed"
			case "runtime":
				write(t, root, "changes/0001-manual.md", strings.Replace(string(b), "phase: evals", "phase: impl", 1))
				want = "P03: approved run or phase changed"
			case "audit":
				write(t, root, "changes/0001-manual.md", strings.Replace(string(b), "phase: evals", "audit_rounds: 1\nphase: evals", 1))
				want = "P03: approved audit state changed"
			}
			before := head(t, root)
			if _, err := verify(root, true); err == nil || !strings.HasPrefix(err.Error(), want) {
				t.Errorf("%s Verify = %v", edit, err)
			}
			if _, err := done(root); err == nil || !strings.HasPrefix(err.Error(), want) || head(t, root) != before {
				t.Errorf("%s Done = %v", edit, err)
			}
			if _, err := os.Stat(marker); !os.IsNotExist(err) {
				t.Errorf("hook ran before %s rejection: %v", edit, err)
			}
		})
	}
}

	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}

func assertNoResumeMutation(t *testing.T, root, beforeHead, beforeChange string) {

	}
	if got := git(t, root, "status", "--porcelain", "-uall"); got != "" {
		t.Errorf("rejected resume dirtied checkout: %s", got)
	}
}

func block(t *testing.T, root, reason string) workflow.BlockResult {
	t.Helper()
	r, err := workflow.Block(workflow.BlockRequest{Root: root, Change: "manual", Reason: reason})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("Block: %v", err)
	}
	return r
}

func blockFixture(t *testing.T, configExtra, changeFront, added, modified, removed string) string {
	t.Helper()
	root := fixture(t, configExtra, changeFront, added, modified, removed)
	git(t, root, "config", "user.name", "Fixture")
	git(t, root, "config", "user.email", "fixture@example.invalid")
	return root
}

func readFile(t *testing.T, root, name string) string {
	t.Helper()
	b, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(root, name))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	return string(b)
}

func assertBlockDocumentOnlyAddsReason(t *testing.T, approved, blocked, reason string) {
	t.Helper()
	before, err := contracts.ParseDocument(approved)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("parse approved change: %v", err)
	}
	after, err := contracts.ParseDocument(blocked)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("parse blocked change: %v", err)
	}
	if _, exists := before.Frontmatter["blocked"]; exists {
		t.Fatal("fixture change was already blocked")
	}
	want := make(map[string]any, len(before.Frontmatter)+1)
	for key, value := range before.Frontmatter {
		want[key] = value
	}
	want["blocked"] = reason
	if !reflect.DeepEqual(after.Frontmatter, want) {
		t.Errorf("block changed approved frontmatter: got %#v, want %#v", after.Frontmatter, want)
	}
	if strings.TrimSpace(after.Body) != strings.TrimSpace(before.Body) {
		t.Errorf("block changed approved Markdown body: got %q, want %q", after.Body, before.Body)
	}
}

func assertBlockReleased(t *testing.T, root string, r workflow.BlockResult, reason string) {
	t.Helper()
	if r.State.Phase == "" || r.State.ClaimOID != "" || r.State.Head != head(t, root) || r.State.PhaseBase != head(t, root) {
		t.Errorf("returned blocked state = %#v", r.State)
	}
	if got := r.State.Change.Document.Frontmatter["blocked"]; got != reason {
		t.Errorf("returned blocked reason = %#v, want %q", got, reason)
	}
	if got := git(t, root, "for-each-ref", "--format=%(objectname)", "refs/fireweed/claims/manual"); got != "" {
		t.Errorf("claim still exists: %s", got)
	}
	if _, err := workflow.Current(root, "manual"); err == nil {
		t.Error("Current still found a held claim")
	}
	if got := git(t, root, "status", "--porcelain", "-uall"); got != "" {
		t.Errorf("checkout is not clean: %s", got)
	}
	if index, tree := git(t, root, "write-tree"), git(t, root, "rev-parse", "HEAD^{tree}"); index != tree {
		t.Errorf("index tree %s differs from blocked HEAD tree %s", index, tree)
	}
}
